At the same time, Base roof photovoltaic power generation has done a large-scale promotion and development of accumulated experience for the follow-up project to provide design reference scheme for photovoltaic grid-connected power generation project has an important pioneering significance.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Dynamic Line Rating System for Distribution Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, the load level of Pudong Power Grid is increasing year by year. In the summer peak period, the allowable capacity of the distribution line is the bottleneck of the power distribution network. In order to improve the power supply capacity of the existing heavy load distribution lines and the utilization efficiency of the line equipment assets, a dynamic line rating system, this can be applied to the insulated conductors and bare wires of the distribution lines. The system is designed and applied to the 35kV and 10kV overhead distribution lines in the Pudong power grid. Through the operation of last year's summer peak, the system can increase the capacity of the distribution line by about 20%. It can provide a scientific reference for the dispatching and inspection personnel to take the instantaneous safety measures at the peak time of the power consumption, and reduce and even eliminate the unnecessary load reduction operation in some cases.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Characteristics Optimization and Analysis of DFIG- VSG Based on Rotor Inertia Control
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: DFIG-VSG (doubly-fed induction generator-virtual synchronous generator) based on rotor inertia control has gained popularity in engineering application. This approach can guarantee the economical operation of wind turbine and provide effective frequency support to the grid meanwhile. The adaptation of frequency regulation by DFIG-VSG is analyzed and speed restoration methods which are suitable for engineering application are studied. First, influencing factors on support time of DFIG-VSG utilizing rotor inertia control is analyzed. Thus general range of support time of wind turbines are given. Second, constant-value and comprehensive speed restoration methods are proposed, followed by comparing them with conventional MPPT curve restoration. Comprehensive speed restoration can inhibit second frequency drop significantly. Frequency regulation characteristics of DFIG-VSG is simulated in Simulink where wind turbines are connected with synchronous generator. Comprehensive restoration method is then testified.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Oscillating Wave Partial Discharge Defects in Two 35kV Cable Joints with Different Processes
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the distribution grid of large cities, the wide application of power cables plays an important role in the development of urban power grids. This paper introduces the application and basic principle of the partial discharge detection technology of the oscillating wave in the distribution network cable, and selects two cases of the partial discharge defects in 35kV cable joints with different processes which were found in the national sports meeting in 2017. The causes of partial discharge, partial discharge initiation voltage and partial discharge capacity are compared and analyzed. It is found that the process has an obvious influence on the type of partial discharge and the parameters of the partial discharge. It provides a reference for the popularization and application of the partial discharge detection technology and the scientific evaluation of the defect state.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Regional Power Grid Planning Based on The Collaborative Optimization Efficiency of Power Grid Project
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper establish collaborative optimization effectiveness evaluation based on power grid project evaluation system of the regional power grid planning, into account both regional capability, reliability of power supply and power grid planning project economics. The paper establish the project collaborative optimization ratio model, considering the construction investment, power supply capacity and land resource utilization ratio and reliability level of the unit power supply area under different load levels of each scheme. A comprehensive quantitative economic and technological comparison calculation for regional power grid planning schemes is carried out, to establish the efficiency evaluation coefficient of power grid planning scheme. The evaluation model based on the collaborative optimization efficiency evaluation of power grid project is established to guide the selection of power grid planning scheme. Therefore, the comprehensive benefit of regional grid planning is improved.

articleTitle: Study on the Construction Plan of Wuqiangxi Intelligent Hydropower Plant
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Application of intelligent technology in transformer substations is relatively mature. As the hydropower plant equipments are more complex, the intelligentization of hydropower plant is still at an exploratory stage. This paper investigated the construction of domestic smart hydropower plants, researched the development and application of smart devices and intelligent monitoring systems for major domestic manufacturers; the construction plan of the Wuqiangxi expansion generator project smart hydropower plant was designed; solution was proposed to solve the compatibility problems of the new and old equipments in the monitoring system, providing experience for the future intelligent reconstruction of similar hydropower plants and the construction of smart power plants.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Implementation Model of Tianjin's Winter Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: It is an inevitable requirement to adapt demand response (DR) into the development of the electricity market. Tianjin implemented the first winter demand response (WDR) project in the country, which ensured the heating of residents and realized the balance between supply and demand of power grids. This paper gives a comprehensive description of the implementation mode of Tianjin's WDR, including the implementation background, project implementation plan, response evaluation and subsidy distribution, platform construction and emergency safeguard measures, implementation effect and benefit analysis, existing problems and improvement measures. This paper also presents a dual user potential assessment model (DUPAM) and a response quantity and the subsidy calculation model. Those models have been applied in the winter demand response project and achieved good results.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Evaluation System Based on Ladder-based Comprehensive Assessment Method
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, China's power energy efficiency monitoring business has rapidly developed along with the rise of smart grids to establish an effective power energy efficiency monitoring system, timely master power consumption data of power companies and residents, achieve scientific energy efficiency analysis, and based on internal operating equipment data, Conduct user energy efficiency diagnosis analysis, provide users with energy use guidance, reduce user energy costs, provide accurate enterprise energy efficiency benchmarking and assessment services, analyze customer electricity usage behavior based on electricity usage, and generate and push customer energy analysis reports. It is necessary for users to adjust their electricity habits and promote the development of energy-saving businesses in enterprises for power companies, residents, and power grid companies. In this paper, the evaluation model is established using the ladder-based comprehensive energy efficiency assessment method, and the algorithm in the model is introduced in detail.

articleTitle: New Recognition Method of Lightning Interference in Long Distance VSC-HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increase of voltage level and transmission capacity, flexible DC systems have put forward higher requirements for line protection. Especially for long-distance, large-capacity flexible DC systems, the protection of the line plays a key role in the stability of the entire system. Lightning strikes and other disturbances have a great influence on the protection of the line. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of the additional component line mode current under the conditions of normal and lightning strikes in the VSC-HVDC transmission system, it is found that the energy difference between the positive and negative values of the additional component line mode current has some relationship with the ratio. According to this feature, this paper proposes a new energy ratio-type non-fault lightning strike and fault lightning strike and short-circuit fault identification criteria. The method effectively solves the influence of the high-frequency interference source generated when the line is struck by lightning on the protection. The principle is simple, the calculation is simple, and it has a high speed of action. Simulations with pscad demonstrate the reliability of the method.

articleTitle: Research on the Voltage Regulation Strategy of Photovoltaic Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) is an effective method to address the environmental issues and energy problems. However, with the increasing of PV penetration, it poses a greater influence on the stability of power grid. In this paper, the issue of voltage stability caused by PV power plants is studied. Firstly, the power losses of collecting power lines and the voltage sensitivity of reactive power units in PV power plant are analyzed, which determines the optimization strategy of reactive power distribution. Then, a control strategy for PV power plants to participate in the voltage regulation of power grid is proposed based on the droop curve of reactive power unit. Finally, the simulation model of PV power station is built in Matlab/Simunlink, and simulation results demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on power demand forecasting based on the relationship Between economic development and power demand
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Taking Tianjin power grid as an example, this paper analyzes the characteristics of power demand growth in different stages of economic development in recent 20 years, uses Granger causality test to verify the causality between economy and power demand, and sums up the main factors that affect the growth of power demand. This paper uses ARMIR model to forecast the economic gross of Tianjin, and forecasts the power demand by using the vector autoregressive model based on the economic forecast. The rationality of power demand growth is verified by the H-p filter theory from the angle of economic cycle and power cycle.

articleTitle: Load Forecasting Based on Improved K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the data density of the data, select the initial cluster center to fully reflect the distribution characteristics of the data; In the iterative calculation of the new cluster center, the average distance between the data and the center of the class is used as the cluster center of the new iteration to eliminate the influence of the noise point. The cluster evaluation Index Hubert Index and D Index select the optimal cluster number to reflect the spatial distribution of data more accurately. By using the improved k-means algorithm to cluster the data of a variable table, the typical daily load characteristic data of four quarters were obtained, and the short-term load prediction was carried out on this basis. The analysis shows that the load modeling method based on improved k-means is feasible and effective for grid simulation analysis.

articleTitle: A Centralized Frequency Regulation Strategy of PV Power Plant Based Equal Adjustable Capacity Proportion Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A centralized frequency regulation strategy of PV plant based on equal adjustable capacity proportion mode is proposed in this paper. When the system frequency changes due to some disturbances, the requirement of adjust active power value is calculated according to the frequency changing, then original active power reference is added with this adjust value to obtain the final active power reference as to change the active power output of PV units to participate in system primary frequency regulation. On this basis, in order to allow all PV units in same PV plant to coordinate with each other, also to prevent some PV units from excessive regulation, a proportional regulation of power method (PROP) is implemented to allocate active power reference to each PV unit more reasonable, namely, each PV unit's output is according to equal adjustable capacity proportion. Finally, an actual PV plant model is established on DIgSILENT PowerFactory platform to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Power Quality Based on State Variable Weight and Normal Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Objective and accurate comprehensive evaluation on power quality is an important evidence for power pricing and power quality assessment. Considering the shortcomings existing in current methods, state variable weight and normal cloud model are used to improve the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method of power quality. The state variable weight vector is applied to consider the influence of the actual condition of evaluation indicators on the indicator weights, and the normal cloud model is applied to construct the membership function. The asymmetric proximity criterion is used to obtain the quantitative and qualitative assessment results. Finally, the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by a practical example.

articleTitle: An Impedance-based Protection Principle for Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to address the problems encountered by the protection in active distribution network, particularly the absence of the selectivity and reliability, an impedance-based protection principle is proposed. After defining the differential impedance and restraint impedance, this paper establishes a novel protection criterion according to the significant differences between the differential impedance and restraint impedance when normal operation, external fault or internal fault. Furthermore, the auxiliary criterion is constructed only by the amplitude characteristic of fault current to overcome the existing dead-zone of impedance differential protection. The proposed protection principle is verified by digital simulation. Compared with current differential principle, the impedance-based principle can effectively compromise the level of data synchronization and the band-width of data transmission. These characteristics play an important role in adapting to the communication infrastructure of distribution network.

articleTitle: VMD-S Traveling Wave Signal Extraction Method Under Strong Noise
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the problem that the traveling wave signal is very difficult to extract in the noisy environment, a method of extracting the VMD-S traveling wave signal under the strong noise background is proposed. The time of arrival time of the fault traveling wave is accurately judged by the variable mode algorithm and the S transform to decompose and transform the fault catastrophe points. The simulation results show that the VMD-S traveling wave signal extraction method can extract the traveling wave signal under strong noise.

articleTitle: Research on Architecture of Automatic Demand Response System Based on OpenADR
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Automatic demand response is one of the core technologies in the development of smart power grid, which relies on advanced communication, measurement and internet technology to instruct users to change the original power consumption by using price signal or incentive signal, so as to realize the optimal allocation of power resources in user side. The Open Automated Demand Response Communications Specification, also called OpenADR, released by the OpenADR Alliance, provides the communication data model for automatic demand response project, and provides technical specification for implementing automatic demand response. Based on OpenADR 2.0 specification, this article studies the layered architecture applied to automatic demand response system and presents an automatic demand response hierarchical management system with VTN-VEN information interaction pair as basic unit. The system has the characteristics of standardization, universality and high expansibility, and has wide application foreground in the future large-scale automatic demand response system.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method of 10k V Distribution Network Line Loss Based on Improved BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A novel method of calculating 10kV distribution network line loss is proposed and realized by programming, which is improved BP neural network model based on adaptive genetic algorithm. Firstly, the characteristic index system is established according to electric characteristic parameters of samples. Then, through leaning the training samples by improved model of BPNN, the line loss evaluation model is obtained. After that,10kV line loss of test samples can be evaluated actually. The improved algorithm of BPNN is adopted to fit complex nonlinear relation between line loss and electric characteristic parameters. The 10kV distribution network in a real system is taken as an example. The accuracy of the proposed method is verified by simulation and calculation of the example. Compared with traditional BPNN, This method has the advantages of fast convergence and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Calculation of Electric Vehicle Charging Power Based on Spatial - Temporal Activity Model
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Analyzed the electric vehicle's travel activity model, considered the spatial -temporal distribution characteristics of electric vehicles, based on the actual data, obtained the distribution model of the key influencing factors of electric vehicle charging. The Monte Carlo and binomial distribution methods were used to obtain the charging power curve of a single electric vehicle on working days and non-working days, and then it is possible to quickly calculate the charging load of a large-scale electric vehicle and analyze its demand response potential. This set of algorithms can calculate the charging power of electric vehicles simply and quickly on the basis of taking into account the space-time distribution of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Study on Rise of Transient Ground Potential Caused by Switching and Closing Operation in 330kV GIS Substation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a model of the 330kV GIS substation shell in transient state is established, a simulation calculation about transient enclosure voltage (TEV) generated during switching of disconnector is carried out, and the TEV waveforms and spectral distributions were obtained throughout the shell. The simulation results are compared with the actual experimental data of the substation, and on the basis of verifying the correctness of the simulation calculation, the possible hazards caused by transient elevation of potential to ground are analyzed. The study shows that the maximum value of TEV always appears on the shell of the bushing, which can reach tens kV voltage level and contain complex frequency. At the same time, the transient potential difference between the grounding wire and the grounding terminal of the control room is up to 1000V.

articleTitle: Capacity Configuration and Economic Evaluation of Grid-Connected PV and Energy Storage Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the gradual application of new energy electric vehicles to real life, whether they will be able to achieve sustainable development has become a hot research topic. Photovoltaic power generation has the characteristics of randomness, volatility and intermittence, and the introduction of energy storage to mitigate, while improving the utilization ratio of photovoltaic power generation. The energy storage capacity and types determines the ability to store photovoltaic power and energy storage costs. Because of the high energy storage costs, merging the surplus photovoltaic power into the grid can better coordinate the PV and energy storage capacity and reduce the energy storage costs. In this paper, the grid connected PV and energy storage charging station is studied. Firstly, based on the daily operation strategy proposed in this paper, setting the maximum net income of the station as the goal and the constraints of energy storage battery SOC, charge and discharge power of the energy storage batteries, charge and discharge power conservation of batteries, system power balance and power fluctuation limit of PV connected grid are considered. Configuration capacity of energy storage battery is solved by genetic algorithm. Secondly, the economic evaluation indexes of PV and energy storage charging station are established and their values are calculated when lithium iron phosphate battery(LiFePO4, LFP), vanadium redox flow battery(VRB), Valve regulated lead acid battery(VRLA) and Natrium Sulfur battery(NSB) are used as the energy storage respectively. Finally, the analytic hierarchy process is applied to evaluate the overall economy of the station. The simulation results show that when VRLA is used as the energy storage system, the grid connected PV and energy storage charging station has the best overall economic performance.

Author Keywords: Grid-connected PV and energy storage charging station
Economy of Grid connected PV and energy storage charging station

articleTitle: Study on Non-Fundamental Frequency Components in the Output Current of DFIG-Based Wind Turbines During Faults
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large-scale centralized development and utilization of wind energy are widely adopted in China. Therefore, the output current of wind farm is generally very large during faults. The current characteristics play an important role in the setting calculation and reliable operation of the relay protection. In the period of faults, the output current is related to the operating status of DFIGs, low voltage ride-through (LVRT) and control strategies. The current frequency characteristics of DFIG-based wind turbines are discussed in this paper. When the crowbar works with the voltage severely dropped, the interharmonic component appears in the output current. The initial amplitude of the interharmonic component is related to the voltage drop, the crowbar resistance, the slip and the initial active power and the decay speed is rapid. When the converter works with the voltage slightly dropped, the second harmonic appears. The initial amplitude is related to the initial value of the fundamental frequency component and the PI controller coefficient. The decay speed is slower than the interharmonic component. In the case of an asymmetric fault, the negative sequence component makes the third harmonic appear. The third harmonic component always exists until the fault cleared. The main non-fundamental frequency components in the output current are studied by the quantitative calculation method of DFIG models in order to be made full use of, which helps the relay protection to improve the protection criteria. As a consequence, we can improve the performance and applicability of relay protection effectively, which has important guiding significance for the development of new relay protection principles.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model for World-Class Distribution Network Management
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The distribution network has been a weak link in China's power industry for a long time, there is an urgent need to optimize distribution network management based on benchmarking world's first class level. Characteristics of advanced distribution network management in the world was systematically researched in this paper, the connotation of world-class distribution network management was summarized, and evaluation index system was proposed. Drawing on the international comparison of horizontal practices, the evaluation was carried out by method of weight and standard score. Finally, through an example, this paper diagnosed the gap between first tier cities in China and world's first-class distribution network management, and put forward improvement strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of the 10kV Wide Range and Arcless on-Load Automatic Voltage Regulation Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, a small number of distribution transformers with on-load tapping mode are used, which still adopts the combination of traditional mechanical devices and electric operating mechanisms. The moving speed is slow, the number of voltage regulation is limited, and the mechanical and electric parts have high failure rate. The arc generated by the switch causes the insulation of the transformer oil to age, which greatly affects the reliability of the power supply of the grid. Aiming at the above problems, an arcless on-load voltage regulation scheme using power electronic devices as OLTC auxiliary contacts is proposed, and the control hardware and software control flow design of the arcless on-load automatic voltage regulation module is completed, and the arcless switching of the power electronic switch is utilized. The use of the power electronic switcher has the advantages of arcless turn on or off and controllability of turn on or off time, which reliably triggers the turn on or off of the switcher. Thereby achieving the purpose of fast and frequent phase separation of the transformer and precise wide amplitude regulation.

articleTitle: Novel and Necessary Structure of Overall On-Line Monitoring for Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Concept and application of on-line monitoring technology and corresponding system was booming for recent decades, however, there was no overall top-level design for on-line monitoring even though it has been researched and applied for a long time. In this paper, we offered a novel and necessary top-level design for overall on-line monitoring system, including the structure, the layer and the function, which would possibly bridge scientific research with technology management. A three-layer design with seven sections at top layer was brought up. The design of top layer was conceived of seven separate yet connected sections, including terminology and definition, general specification, structure, measurement link, information interface, evaluation and stabilization. Contents, roles and ranges of different sections were demonstrated while logical relationships, supports and connections between these sections were also carefully illustrated. Admittedly, the top layer was focus of the whole top-level design, functions and utility of the second and the third layer was also specifically introduced.

articleTitle: Research on the Top Design and Implementation Mode of Intelligent Power Distribution Room
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The existing power distribution patrols, detection and control mainly rely on the operation and maintenance personnel to the site to complete the operation, management inefficiency, monitoring is not in place, the basic can not achieve remote Internet control; With the development of Internet of Things technology and power equipment Security performance requirements, a remote control based on the remote control of intelligent remote control power distribution room design of the top line with the future development of smart grid direction, the realization of intelligent distribution room should have a remote view and control, automatic inspection, automatic control, No human intervention, etc., can achieve artificial intelligence management, high-precision robot patrolling the robot, the risk of power distribution equipment room pre-fault to ensure that the power distribution equipment failure risk controllable in the control, reduce electrical equipment failure, Improve the reliability of distribution network operation; at the same time, can greatly improve the efficiency and quality of operation and maintenance, can achieve downsizing and efficiency, provide strong support for regional economic development and quality electricity service.

articleTitle: Design of Power Supply State Monitoring System for Active Electronic Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This article designs a power supply status monitoring system in order to verify the reliability of the active electronic current transformer's power supply switching and monitor its power supply status. It is proposed that analyzing the merged unit IEC61850-9-2LE message to obtain primary current and analyzing the merger unit TCP/IP protocol to get the laser power and photo-voltaic cell output voltage. While using a high-power optical splitter to monitor the laser power output directly, thus enabling the active electronic current transformer power supply status monitoring according to its working principle. Through this monitoring system, a certain type of active electronic current transformer is energized state monitoring test verification; the monitoring data can display the current energy status in real time, and gives several common power supply failure alarms. Experiments show that the monitoring system can verify the reliability of power supply switching and realize the alarm of power supply status so as to improve the quality testing capability of active electronic current transformer.

articleTitle: Research on Coordinated Control Strategies of Hybrid PV/CSP Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The integration of different types of solar power plants and energy storage systems is an innovative option to mitigate the impacts of the variability and intermittency of solar energy. In this paper, a coordinated control strategy of the hybrid PV/CSP plant during symmetrical voltage sag is proposed. First, the simplified mathematical model of the plant is developed. Moreover, the power control of inverter based on the synchronous reference frame is presented to guarantee satisfactory performances of reactive power and voltage outputs of PV due to the depth of sag. Meanwhile, an improved AVR-PSS based on nonlinear PID is established to not only enhance the terminal voltage transient stability and damping oscillations, but also improve the dynamic response and robustness of the system compared with the traditional control method. The simulation results based on Matlab/Simulink show that the proposed control strategy can support voltage recovery effectively when the grid voltage drops and achieve the low voltage ride through capability based on the grid code.

articleTitle: Damping Control Strategy for Reducing Voltage Unbalance in Three-Phase Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In view of single-phase and three-phase load coexist in low-voltage distribution network, causing unbalance of the three phase voltages, this paper proposed a damping control strategy based on three-phase inverter to reduce voltage unbalance factor. The mathematical model of the active power damping control strategy of the inverter is established based on the sequential component method. By analyzing the principle of active power output and voltage unbalance suppression, the active and reactive power cooperative damping control strategy for three phase inverters was deduced. Case studies are carried out on a 10 bus asymmetric distribution network. The results verify that the control strategy proposed of the inverter in this paper which can realize power output and reduce the voltage unbalance of the network.

articleTitle: Assessment Method of Wind Farm Harmonic Emission Level Based on Improved Covariance Characteristic of Random Vectors
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The wind farm side harmonic impedance could not be neglected when assessing the wind farm harmonic emission level. Because of the low impedance characteristic of the wind turbine filter. This paper presents a new method to estimate the wind farm harmonic emission level at the point of common coupling (pee) based on improved covariance characteristic of random vectors. According to the topological structure of the wind farm, the equivalent harmonic impedance of the wind farm is calculated, with the measured data at pee the wind farm harmonic source is obtained. Since the system side harmonic source and wind farm side harmonic source are approximately independent, the background harmonic related term can be eliminated by using the covariance characteristic, then the system side harmonic impedance can be calculated. We can calculate the wind farm harmonic emission level. The harmonic impedances of wind turbines are aggregated to simplify the calculation of the wind farm side harmonic impedance. Based on the results of simulation and measured data, it verifies that the proposed method is effective to eliminate the background interference when evaluate wind farm harmonic emission level, and the proposed method is also effective when the background harmonic is large.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Point Tracking of PV System Under Partial Shading Through a Novel Flower Pollination
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the maximum utilization of solar energy, photovoltaic (PV) power systems are operated at the maximum power point (MPPT) under changing environmental conditions, and maximum power point is generally achieved using traditional methods. However, the occurrence of multi-peak due to partially shaded conditions increase complexity of the tracking prosses and conventional technique can't guarantee convergence to global maximum power point always. This paper proposed a MPPT method for solar energy system using a novel flower pollination (FP) algorithm. This paper reports the conception of FP algorithm by emphasizing the importance of the Levy flight in affecting the proposed method's convergence. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, the MPPT control model of the PV system is established in MATLAB and compared with two well established techniques. The simulation results indicate that the proposed MPPT technique can very quickly track the varies of external environment and effectively handle the partially shaded condition.

articleTitle: Dynamic Rotor Speed Protection for DFIG Based Wind Turbines with Virtual Inertia Control
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Through virtual inertia control, doubly fed induction generator (DFIG)-based wind turbines (WTs) can participate into frequency regulation of the power system by increasing the output active power and releasing the kinetic energy stored in the rotor for a period of time. However, it will cause secondary frequency drop of the system when the WT terminates virtual inertia control. In this paper, the characteristics of the WT's rotor speed trajectory during virtual inertia control are investigated. Then a dynamic rotor speed protection (DRSP) strategy is proposed to guarantee the stable operation of the WT during frequency regulation and avoid the secondary frequency drop. Simulations under different wind speed conditions are conducted in DIgSILENT/PowerFactory and the results validate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Life-cycle Management and Interact Evaluation of Distribution Cables Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, SGCC accelerate the establishment of distribution power networks. The quality management of distribution cables devices directly affects the reliability of power grid operation. This paper proposes a new system about the quality evaluation and management of distribution network cables and accessories based on life-cycle quality evaluation model, which includes access quality quantitative evaluation, operating performance quantitative evaluation and interact overall process quantitative evaluation. It aims to establish the quality evaluation and control platform based on data fusion analysis of life-cycle operation and maintenance data to provide solution of the interact operational process quality evaluation and control of distribution cables and accessories and improve the reliability of power grid operation.

articleTitle: Large-disturbance Stability Analysis of DC Microgrid with Constant Power Load and its Transient Voltage Stability Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the important part of future AC/DC hybrid distribution networks, maintaining the voltage stability of DC microgrid is very important for the safe operation of the distribution network. Based on Brayton-Moser's mixed potential theory, this paper first studies the large disturbance stability of a DC microgrid with constant power load. Then, the stability criterion of the analytic form of the system under large disturbance is obtained, which the effects of parameters such as AC side inductance, resistance, controller control parameters, and constant power load power values on the system stability are taken into account. According to the criterion, a stability control strategy for energy storage system is proposed. This strategy can avoid the unnecessary switching between the master and slave source, ensure the system stable under large disturbances and help the system quickly return to the stable state. The criterion and stability control strategy are simple and can be easily implemented. Simulation results demonstrate that the stability criterion and the control strategy are effective.

articleTitle: Load Aggregator Bidding Strategy in Peak Regulation Market Based on Selective Combination Game
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Facing to the peak regulation market, a load aggregator should bid price and capacity to participant in market competition. Considering different loads demand response abilities, the selective combinatorial game mathematical model is built in this paper, so as to acquire optimal bidding schedule. The objective function minimizes demand response costs of the load aggregator. Meanwhile, constraints include peak regulation capacity, demand response potential, power usage demand, and so on. Load user in the load aggregator would provide its own reduction capacity via demand response function, and consider other loads' demand response through learning factors. The load aggregator would select optimal load combination to bid optimal price and capacity for peak regulation market. Simulation cases numerically prove the effectiveness of the selective combinatorial game model presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Node Voltage Sag Severity Considering the Power Grid Side and the User Side
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The current comprehensive evaluation methods of voltage sags generally only consider the voltage sag level of the node, ignore the effect of the actual load of node connection and the importance of the load on the voltage sag evaluation results, and the description of the node voltage sag severity can not reflect the objective reality. In order to evaluate the effects of voltage sag events reasonably, considering the importance of load, a method for evaluating the severity of voltage sag considering the power grid side and the user side is proposed. First, analytic hierarchy process is used to calculate the weight coefficient of voltage sag of different kinds of load. The power grid side index is determined by the node voltage sag characteristics and weight coefficient of voltage sag of load. Then, according to the fault probability function of the sensitive equipment, the comprehensive failure rate of the typical sensitive equipments is calculated as the user side index based on entropy weight method. Finally, the gray relational grade between the comparison sequence composed of evaluation indexes of nodes and reference sequence is calculated by using the grey relational analysis. The node sag severity is determined by comparing the size of the gray relational grade of each node. This method is used to evaluate the voltage sags of a city grid, the results show that the proposed method can reasonably modify the effect of load on the severity of the sag assessment, and the ranking of the node voltage sag severity is more realistic.

articleTitle: The Robust Coordinated Control Strategy for Isolated Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Frequency is the key indicator for island microgrid, but it can be affected by the renewable energy fluctuation and the load variation. The robust coordinated control strategy is proposed for the photovoltaic (PV) -diesel-battery isolated microgrid. Based on different frequency deviation ranges, PV systems and diesel generator (DG) systems are prioritized for frequency regulation. When the frequency deviation exceeds the set frequency threshold, the battery system begins to response quickly. Furthermore, the sliding mode (SM) load frequency control (LFC) is designed to improve the dynamic characteristics of the coordinated strategy and restrain the randomness and volatility of the source and load. The results of Matlab/Simulink prove that the proposed coordinated strategy can make full use of renewable energy and improve the frequency quality.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment on Switchgear and its Controller Based on Time-Spatial-Source Dimension
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The switchgear and its controller are one of the most widely used components in the electric distribution system and it is necessary to ensure their reliability. This paper proposes a Time-Spatial-Source dimension coordinated reliability evaluation model for switchgear and its controller. It aims to build a more systematic reliability evaluation of switchgear and its controller from the source of its fault and the spatial structures. In the spatial dimension, the fault type is divided into many parts according to the location of the switchgear and its controller's components. And then the defect database which can guide the maintenance of operation and maintenance is established on the basis of space dimension. Meanwhile the reliability evaluation of switchgear and its controller adopts Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) model to reduce the maintenance cost. In the source dimension, the qualitative and quantitative reliability analysis of the switchgear and its controller are carried out based on Fault Tree Analysis(FTA). Then the reliability improvement measures based on Product Lifecycle Management is offered from the time dimension. Finally, the proposed method is verified on the vacuum load switch cabinet in Guangzhou, China. Demonstration shows that the method presented in this paper can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of failure analysis for switchgear and its controller, cut down occurrence of failure and improve the switchgear and its controller utilization.

articleTitle: The Model and Methodology of Avoidable Costs in Demand Side Management
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power Demand Side Management (DSM) has now become the main means of energy conservation and load regulation, whose main income is from the power investment costs which is called avoidable costs. The processes of evaluating the benefits of DSM projects are also the processes of evaluating the avoidable costs of power system. This paper establishes a comprehensive unit avoidable cost model of power system in which the transmission and distribution unit avoidable cost takes the allocation factor into consideration to reflect the different value of the load reduced in different time. This paper also establishes the avoidable costs model of the generation company, the grid corporation and society, and uses the case to analysis the profit of the generation company, the grid corporation and society in different DSM investment projects.

articleTitle: Research on Minimum Effective Insulation Length of Live Working Tools on Distribution Line at High Altitudes
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Live-working is an important method in ensuring the safe operation of distribution network. Although live-working has been widely applied in many low-altitude distribution lines., there is still some technology problems of live-working in high-altitude areas., such as the lack of safe insulation operating tools. With increasing altitude., the insulation tool flashover voltage will decrease., which is the key factor on researching minimum effective insulation length and developing high altitude work tools. In this paper., experimental study on minimum effective insulation length was implemented in high-altitude areas. Frequency discharge tests of operating and protective tools in different insulation lengths were performed in Yangbajing., Tibet (4300m)., Lhasa., Tibet (3600m)., Nyingchi., Tibet (2900m)., Wuhan., Hubei (28m) respectively. The frequency discharge characteristic curves under different live-working tools were given. According to the above test results and the existing research in low altitude areas., the required minimum effective insulation length of live working tools within the range of altitude 3000m-4500m are calculated using the relative air pressure altitude correction method.

articleTitle: Reconfiguration of distribution network based on basic loop matrix considering new energy access
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the construction of the mathematical model and constraint conditions of the distribution network, this paper proposed an automatic generation basic loop matrix algorithm to encode the distribution network with new energy access, thereby avoiding the generation of infeasible solutions. The novel self-adaption chaos harmony search algorithm was used to solve the distribution network reconfiguration model, this method introduced the chaotic sequence to optimize the initial population at initializing the harmony memory, improved the determination method to considering probability and trimming probability of the harmony bank, thus both probabilities are adaptive with particle information changes. The simulation results of 33-node system indicate that the proposed method can keep the voltage relatively stable with new energy access, which also has better feasibility and optimization. It also verifies the effectiveness of the proposed reconfiguration model.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Benefit Evaluation of Distribution Network Planning Based on Extended C-OWA Operators
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: First, considering the characteristics of the distribution network, the economic, effectiveness and environmental protection of the distribution network planning scheme are taken into account. Secondly, based on the comprehensive consideration of the performance and risk of the distribution network, a comprehensive benefit evaluation index system for distribution network planning is established. In view of the complexity and uncertainty of the problems in the evaluation process of distribution network and the fuzziness of thinking in the evaluation process, a comprehensive evaluation benefit model of distribution network planning based on the extended C-OWA operator is established. This model takes full account of the democracy and rationality of decision-making in group decision making process. Finally, the actual project case analysis shows that the model is scientific and effective.

articleTitle: Effect of the Surface State of the Insulating Stick on the Discharge Voltage Along The Surface
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Insulating stick is an important safety tool for live working in the maintenance of distribution network system. The insulation performance of the insulating stick will decrease obviously under wet, defects and pollution conditions. Therefore., an effective and reliable method to evaluate the insulation performance is proposed by studying the influence of the surface state of the insulating stick on the flashover voltage along the stick surface., which is very important to ensure the safety of maintenance personnel and equipment. IDAX-300 was used to detect the dielectric loss factor of insulating stick. The insulated stick samples wrap around copper foil paper at a distance of 2cm between the two sides were tested to attain the surface flashover voltage in a closed environment. The oscilloscope was used to record the flashover voltage waveform during the flashover along the stick surface., and Xviewer software was used to analysis the data after the tests. The results show that the insulation performance of the insulating stick will decrease with the process of pressurization due to the gradual drying of filth under the same closed condition. When the defect is not completely distributed between two test electrodes., the defect has little effect on the insulation performance at different positions between two electrodes.

articleTitle: A Novel Super Capacitor Voltage Recovery in Virtual Capacitor Control
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, with more integration of distributed generator(DG) and large number of DC loads into the power grid, DC microgrid has attracted more and more attention in the research field of micro-grid. Due to the inevitable volatility and randomness of renewable energy, battery is an essential element of DC microgrid, especially in islanded mode. To prevent the damage to battery caused by frequent and rapid charge and discharge, and consider the high power density of super capacitor(SC), some research combine battery and SC as hybrid energy storage system(HESS). In HESS, battery is under conventional droop control, and virtual capacitor control is also implemented in SC to simulate the output characteristics of DC bus capacitor and absorb transient power. This paper studies the equivalent leak current of SC and DC/DC convertor, and a novel SC voltage recovery method is proposed based on traditional virtual capacitor control. Finally, a simulation model was established in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: The Space Charge Characteristics of XLPE Cable Peelings Under Power Frequency Voltage
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The reliability of the cable plays an important role in the stable operation of the power system. However, the dielectric strength of cables declines under the effect of AC electrical and thermal stresses when in operation. The gradual degradation processes caused by composite stress on dielectrics, known as electrical aging, have a close relationship with the reliability of electrical equipment, though are not completely recognized. During operation, alternating voltage will lead to the change of internal charge distribution of cable insulation, resulting in local electric field distortion and aging of insulation materials. At present, the most widely used cable insulation material is XLPE, so it is necessary to study the space charge distribution of XLPE high AC voltage.

articleTitle: Analyze and Research on Improving Capacity of Clean Power Integration
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analyzes the output characteristics of clean energy, then a calculation method of clean power integration capacity based on power balance is proposed through all-round analysis of load peak valley differential rate, system spare capacity, ability of various powers peak load regulation and ability of connect lines regulation, main factors that affecting the receptivity are analyzed furtherly. Through the analysis of the foreign clean energy acceptance, this paper summarizes the typical methods of acceptance and the reference significance for our country. Finally, some measures to improve China's clean energy acceptance capacity are put forward in combination with the main problems existing in our country. The results of this study can provide a reference for the research and development of clean energy acceptance capacity.

articleTitle: Line Loss Management for Transformer Courts Based on Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a visualization technology which combines statistical data and graphic charts. This technology merges and manages the data of core business system such as SG186 system, power grid resources management information system, electricity information acquisition system, etc. Then, the abstract data information such as the line loss rate of transformer courts, the capacity of transformer courts, power supply, power consume and users power are converted into the form of statistical data and graph charts, which can visually display the core elements and indicators related to the line loss. It forms a “visual platform of line loss of transformer courts”. So, the overall line loss of the platform can be grasped intuitively in the management level and operation level. Through the graph charts we analyze typical unqualified transformer courts in line loss such as the transformer courts long-term negative but relatively stable, the transformer courts long-term high and changeable, the transformer courts in the same distribution room while some high and others negative but overall qualified, etc. We will find the cause of unqualified transformer courts in line loss and governance them. It will reduce line loss rate and comprehensively improve economic efficiency of power supply enterprise.

articleTitle: Lightning Overvoltage Identification in Distribution Line based on Relevance Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Realizing lightning overvoltage online identification is of great significance to improving the practical of the lightning online monitoring device in the failure analysis. Therefore, a method based on relevance vector machine (RVM) is attempted to be applied to lightning overvoltage identification. The Hilbert-Huang transform method was introduced to analyze the waveform characters of induced lightning, shield failure and back flashover. Characteristic quantity was generated and input into the RVM to construct the intelligent lightning overvoltage identification machine. The method integrated the feature information of lightning overvoltage, and outputted the probabilities of various lightning overvoltage. The PSCAD simulation results demonstrate that, the training time is low and the recognition rate is high. The identification method proposed can be well applied in identification of lightning overvoltage.

articleTitle: Studies on the Influence of Control Parameters of Under-Excitation Limiter in Brushless High-Initial-Response Excitation System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper invests the influence of the control parameters about superimposed under-excitation limiter (UEL), used in a brushless high initial response (HIR) excitation system. A single-machine infinite-bus model is derived by using the synchronous machine model with the brushless (HIR) excitation system model (IEEE Type AC2C) and a superimposed multisegment UEL. Based on the linearized model, the relation between the auxiliary damping torque (ΔMD2) provided by UEL and the pertinent parameters of UEL is extracted. With the damping torque analysis (DTA) technique, it is shown that the dynamic stability of the system can be affected by the value of the proportional gain (K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P</inf>) and the internal gain (K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I</inf>) of UEL. Then the time-domain simulations verify the conclusions of theoretical analysis.

Author Keywords: brushless high initial response (HIR) excitation system

articleTitle: Study on the Power Supply and Sale Mechanism of Onshore Power Supply Under the Background of Electric Power System Reform
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the background of electric power system reform, the power supply and sale mechanism of onshore power supply is studied. Firstly, the technical principle of onshore power supply is introduced. The general situation and influence of electric power system reform are also described. After that, the present situation and existing problems of onshore power supply are analyzed. To increase the economic benefit of onshore power supply, five methods have been proposed to establish a new power supply and sale mechanism of onshore power supply. At last, the feasibility of onshore power supply is analyzed based on an actual project at the port of Tianjin. Research shows that the improved power supply and sale mechanism of onshore power supply will helpful to reduce the application cost of onshore power supply. Port enterprises should be encouraged to purchase electric power in the power sale market, and electric power sellers should be encouraged to more participate in the projects of onshore power supply.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy of Load Virtual Energy Storage System for Improving Stochastic Power Absorption in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The randomness and volatility of stochastic power source such as PV and wind change the voltage, current and supply-demand of distribution network, thus affecting power absorption, safety and stability. This paper presents a new coordinated control strategy of load virtual energy storage system (LVESS), which is capable of improving stochastic power absorption in distribution network. First, the aggregation characteristics of typical temperature control loads (TCLs) which have good energy storage characteristics, such as air conditioners, refrigerators etc are studied and the aggregated power control models are established based on different characteristics. Refer to the state of charged of battery energy storage, the virtual state of charge (VSOC) and adjustable power which are used to describe and tag the regulation ability of LVESS are evaluated considering user comfort, load control signal and operation state. According to the model and VSOC, a two-level optimized coordination control strategy which takes into account both technical indexes of distribution network and user electricity costs is put forward. The strategy is verified to realize power coordination control and resolve the problems brought by stochastic power source.

articleTitle: Investigation of Distribution Network Equipment Quality Control based on Intrinsic Safety
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the popularization of “Intrinsic Safety”, the State Grid starts to establish a network of quality control which leads to a sharp increase in inspection business. This paper proposed a new information management model to make the inspection centers run more efficiently. Firstly, the information methods for inspection centers are introduced and the time-scale and space-scale status in the center are digitized. Secondly, the information methods for inspection network are illustrated. Via an app, the inspection workflow improves to be more concise and communicable. And a management system is used to keep the inspection network efficient, standardized and loop-closed.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration Approach for Multiple Competitive Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to face the unprecedented challenges in environmental sustainability, there is an increasingly attention regarding the adoption of distributed and renewable energy resources such as microgrids (MGs). However, the stochastic nature of the distributed energy resources (DERs) affect the reliability and sustainable energy utilization which delay the implementation of the microgrids. However, the DERs associate with energy storage systems have attracted increasing consideration due to the charging/discharging capabilities for renewable energy time shifting, smoothing and capacity firming. This study explores an intelligent system configuration method for multiple competitive microgrids considering the cost of system operation. The proposed method is designed to motivate the participation of the microgrids while guarantee the security and economic operation of the distribution systems.

articleTitle: The Application of Transient Calculation for Loop Closing of Distribution Network Based on The DSA
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Loop closing operation can reduce power outage, but it is dangerous. Real time security calculation is very necessary. Through the improved multi-balance buses power flow calculation and weighted robust state estimation, DSA technology is applied to real-time loop closing security check for distribution network. Applying the theory, the Tianjin electric power dispatching control center and Chengxi electric power dispatching control center have realized the synchronous online safety analysis under the DSA. And the power outage reduction and security is achieved.

articleTitle: Big Data and Advanced Analysis for Network Components Fault Diagnosing
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing number of sensors, PMUs, and smart meters deployed in power systems, especially in distribution utilities, the information flowed in the system is becoming more and more complicated, which leads to a challenging for dealing with large data sets. Therefore, it is imperative to the development of big data technology in distribution network, which can leads to better performance, higher reliability and flexibility of operating and monitoring of the power system. This paper strives to investigate the big data analysis methods in fault diagnosing of network components, such as transformer. This paper proposes a novel MRK-means algorithm to diagnose transformer fault with large set of historical data in transformer. In this algorithm, the mapper is used for assigning each training data to its closest center, and subsequent reducer is used for optimizing the new centers. This proposed algorithm is performed on 4-nodes Hadoop cluster by using a JAVA programming. And it has a good performance on transformer fault diagnosing, especially for dealing with large data sets. In addition, the accuracy expected meets the standard requirement of transformer fault diagnosing. And the performance of algorithm is assessed by comparison of speedup, scaleup, and sizeup. Results present the performance is satisfactory.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Planning Model for AC-DC Distribution System and Renewable Energy Integration with High Reliability
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The requirement for large-scale renewable energy integration promotes the upgrading of distribution system from single AC system to hybrid AC-DC system. In order to improve the penetration of renewable energy located in remote areas, this paper proposes an AC-DC configuration where the renewable energy generated by distributed generators is collected through a DC system and transmitted to the AC distribution system through several collection lines. The planning model aims to minimize the total investment and operating costs over the planning horizon. A second order conic programming is introduced to formulate the optimal power flow in AC-DC distribution system. The reliability of DC system in dealing with N−1 contingency is further improved from the aspect of topology. Numerical simulations on a test AC-DC distribution system demonstrate the validity of the proposed planning model.

articleTitle: Online Assessment and Application of the Provincial Power Grid Adequacy
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In power dispatching process, the adequacy judgment mainly depends on dispatcher's experience, which lacks tools to evaluate and early-warn the power system adequacy. on-line adequacy assessment method is proposed for the provincial power grid in this paper. The power system adequacy and area adequacy are analyzed, and decision-making is provided when the adequacy is insufficient. It can enhance dispatcher's abilities to aware, response and active control the power system adequacy, and improve the adequacy level to ensure safe and stable operation of the provincial power grid. The application on dispatching and control cloud shows that the proposed method is feasible, and it achieves on-line monitoring, early warning, and auxiliary decision-making for the adequacy of provincial power grid.

articleTitle: Analysis on Operation Characteristics of Grid - Connected Inverter in Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: These instructions give you guidelines for preparing papers for IEEE TRANSACTIONS and JOURNALS. Use this document as a template if you are using Microsoft Word 6.0 or later. Otherwise, use this document as an instruction set. The electronic file of your paper will be formatted further at IEEE. Define all symbols used in the abstract. Do not cite references in the abstract. Do not delete the blank line immediately above the abstract; it sets the footnote at the bottom of this column.

articleTitle: Quantitative Evaluation of Electric Vehicle Accommodation Capacity in Multiple Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electric vehicle (EV) charging load have different characteristics in different charging areas and under different charging strategies, therefore the accommodation capabilities of EVs will be different too. In this paper, a quantitative evaluation method of accommodation capacity of EVs in distribution networks under multiple scenarios is proposed. The EV users' charging behavior in different areas are analyzed firstly. Then, the Monte Carlo Method is used to calculate EV charging load. The maximum accommodation capacity of EVs in different ares is evaluated in term of load capacity of transformer and node voltage deviations. After that, a coordinated EV charging strategy is developed to improve the accommodation capacity. Finally, a local distribution network topology is used to verify the performance of the proposed method and strategy. The proposed quantitative evaluation method and coordinated EV charging strategy can provide a reference for the planning of charging facilities without expansion of transformer capacity.

articleTitle: Research on E-settlement System of Centralized Purchasing Material Based on Optical Character Recognition Technology and Electronic Signature Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The new idea of centralized purchasing material settlement under the three-level material intensive mode in provincial, city and County-level is researched. Through the application of advanced Optical Character Recognition technology and electronic signature technology, the E-settlement System of material is developed. The E-settlement system complete process Reengineering, eliminate payment risk and take the lead in realizing the electronic transfer and approval of the settlement documents, and visualization of settlement process, in The State Grid Corporation of China.

articleTitle: Fast Flexible Charging Strategy for Electric Vehicles Based on Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Lithium iron phosphate battery has the characteristics of long cycle life, high energy density and green environmental protection, so it is widely used in the field of electric vehicle power battery. In this paper, the temperature characteristics of the lithium iron phosphate battery, voltage characteristics are studied, and combined with the battery charged state (state of charge, SOC) put forward a kind of charging of battery life strategy, and realize the rapid and flexible charging the battery. Finally, in the model built on MATLAB simulation platform verification, results show that the proposed method to improve the service life of the battery has obvious effect, and to a certain extent, improve the charging efficiency.

articleTitle: Test Study on Noise of Filter Capacitors Based on Different Harmonic Injection Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to measure the noise of the ac filter capacitor accurately and reduce the requirement of the test power source and other equipment in the condition of accurately measurement. This paper is based on the noise test of filter capacitor in Changji-Guquan ±1100kV HVDC project, Based on the bridge circuit injected three different kind of current condition on three different filter capacitor. The three different kind of current condition are these: Full harmonic currents, the former three main harmonic currents and the 70% full harmonic currents of Changji-Guquan ±1100kV HVDC project. The test date show the sound press level and the sound power level are quite near on full harmonic currents inject condition and he former three main harmonic currents inject condition, the maximum difference is 0.4dB. Compare the sound level of full harmonic currents inject condition with the date calculated by the 70% full harmonic currents inject condition, the correctness of the formula is verified. Can use the former three main harmonic currents condition to do the noise test or lower the full harmonic currents ratio to do the test and use the formula calculate the sound power of the filter capacitor.

articleTitle: United Power Quality Conditioner Based on Supercapacitor in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a new energy storage element, supercapacitor not only could be used to meet the power balance in microgrid, but also could solve many power quality issues. However, its low energy density determines other energy source should be considered to compensate its performance. A supercapacitor based united power quality conditioner (UPQC) in microgird is proposed in this paper, which consists of supercapacitor, PV, bi-directional DC/DC converter, shunt inverter and boost-buck DC/DC converter. The structure and power flow model of this UPQC was analyzed. The control of the shunt inverters and the charging strategy of the supercapaciter were introduced. The simulation results verified the effectiveness of the proposed circuit and control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-objective Power Emergency Supplies Dispatch Model Considering Material and Time Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A scientific and reasonable power emergency supplies dispatch model is essential to speed up the restoration process after damage of a power system. Given this background, a multi-objective power emergency supplies dispatch model is presented. Firstly, optimization functions are presented with the objectives of maximizing the material satisfaction and time satisfaction of damaged nodes. Secondly, in order to solve the optimal value of the objective functions, weight parameters of emergency nodes are determined by considering the subjective and objective factors that affect the importance of emergency nodes. Finally, the IEEE 33-bus system and a power emergency supplies dispatch graph are employed for simulation analysis, and the scientificness and effectiveness of the developed model are verified comparing with the result of random scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on Self-Describing Method of Battery Energy Storage Station Interconnection With Distribution Grid Based onIEC 61850
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the standard IEC61850, which used to be applied in the field of intelligent substation for intelligent distribution network, this paper is to analyze the method of battery energy storage system (BESS) fast accessing smart distribution network. The object-oriented modeling concept is transplanted into the field of smart distribution power grid to research on battery energy storage station `plug-and-play' self-describing, so that the system model can be uploaded to the distribution network control center. Thus saving the effort of checking point tables during the debugging of BESS interconnection with the grid, and realize the quick plug-in of battery energy storage station.

articleTitle: Time Series Optimal Planning Model of Renewable Energy Power Generation Base
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Multi stage optimization planning of renewable energy power base is a multi-variable and nonlinear mixed integer optimization problem. Therefore, multi-stage optimization model of renewable energy power base is built by the dynamic programming method to make the decision of each stage. The planning results of the target annual are used as the basis for the expansion of the renewable energy power generation base in each stage. The economic effect of the various measures is solved by using the recursive algorithm of dynamic programming, and the whole economic cost is solved by the optimization function. The feasibility of the method is verified by the example.

articleTitle: A Field Testing Case of LV- BPL Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: N ew application developments in distribution network such as new energy resources, bidirectional interaction with end-users, electric vehicles, require for the safety, real-time, stability and reliability of power data collection. In the paper, the common communication technologies applied in low voltage distribution network and divied into three types (power line carrier, wireless and specific wire), are briefly discussed and compared. Then, a field testing case of BPL (broad power line carrier) application for meter reading in low-voltage networks is presented and analysised in detail.

articleTitle: Judging Discharge Type in Git by Gas Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution transformers are an important part of distribution networks. The gas-insulated transformer internally replaces the transformer oil with SF6. Due to this limitation, low-voltage, low-capacity gas-insulated transformers have more mature technology level and wider application field because of their low cost and difficulty in production. Due to its good safety, flexible installation methods, and no need for oil pits and clean oil equipment, it has broad application prospects in the field of distribution transformers. Different types of discharge occur in the solid insulation of gas-insulated transformers. In order to judge the type of discharge in the internal insulation of the gas-insulated transformer and the severity of the fault, three kinds of electrode models were used to simulate the corona discharge, internal discharge and external discharge of the insulation in the gas-insulated transformer. The corona discharge model is a needle plate electrode with 20mm distance, the needle-plate electrode against the surface of the intact insulation as the external surface discharge model. Artificially add a crack to the insulator and let the needle-plate electrode discharge along the crack. Use this method to simulate the internal surface discharge. The characteristic decomposition products of the specific discharge form were determined by comparing the different kinds of decomposition products and the content of the decomposition products in the SF6 environment.
