The discharge form of the gas-insulated transformer were determined for the on-line monitoring. At the same time, we can make sure whether a fault occurs or a crack is appeared on the insulation.

Author Keywords: gas-insulated transformer;gas composition analysis;corona discharge;outer-surface discharge;inter-surface discharge;fault diagnosis

articleTitle: Profit Model Analysis of Power Grid Company after Electricity Price Reform
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the deepening of power system reform, continuous adjustment of the transmission and distribution electricity price verification and reform pilot have a profound impact on the profitability of power grid companies. In this paper, the background of the transmission and distribution price reform is described firstly. Then this paper summarizes the comprehensive impact of the transmission and distribution electricity price reform on the profitability of power grid companies, and analyzes the traditional business and new business models of power grid companies at last.

Author Keywords: Transmission and Distribution Electricity Price Reform

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Rapid Assistant Decision Making for Distribution Power Dispatching
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper is about the technology of rapid decision support in distribution network. Firstly, this paper introduces the topological calculation method of standby automatic switching device in the on-line static security analysis of distribution network using depth search algorithm in graph theory. Secondly, the paper introduces searching algorithm, the steady-state current checking algorithm and the impulse current calculation method of the closed-loop switch. Finally, the paper shows the related R&D and engineering work of a dispatch in central China and a dispatch in North China.

articleTitle: The Effect of Annealing on XLPE and Consideration About Reusing of Retired Cables
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Replacement of the cables that have reached the designed operation period is seriously concerned. The effect of annealing is discussed in this paper, and a possible method for considering the reusing of retired cables is presented. XLPE samples were obtained from two retired 110 kV cables and their spare cable by a coaxial cutting method. Firstly, the samples were annealed at 85, 90, 95 and 100°C. Then, the differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) and DC current were measured. The analysis was mainly conducted by watching the annealing temperature dependence of thermal performance and DC current. The DSC results revealed that the crystallinity, melting point, and lamellar thickness changed monotonously as the annealing temperature increased from 85 to 95°C, and the highest values were observed. When the annealing temperature reached 100 °C, these quantities changed the opposite trend. Similarly, the change in DC current showed a same trend as the DSC results, the smallest value of current appeared as the sample annealed at 95°C. Importantly, annealing at 95 °C did not result in further degradation of these samples but morphology and electric performance improvement.

articleTitle: Efficiency Analysis of UHV Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering the safety and stability level of power grid, energy supply and energy saving and emission reduction, a method of efficiency analysis of UHV network is presented. In the aspect of safety and stability of power grid, this paper analyzes the level of short-circuit current of UHV network, the influence of the power flow distribution and the safety margin of the line. In the aspect of energy supply, the paper analyzes the effect of UHV electricity on the balance of power supply and demand. In the aspect of energy saving and emission reduction, this paper analyzes the UHV network how to economize the standard coal, reduce carbon dioxide, sulfur dioxide and NOx emission. The application in Tianjin power grid is analyzed. The research shows that this method can analyze the efficiency of UHV network in omni-directional and multi-angle, and it has important guiding significance for enhancing the foresight, scientificity and rationality of power grid planning scheme and improving the safety and stability of power grid operation.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Operating Characteristics of Urban Power Grid via MMC
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Urban grid system with high proportion of air conditioning load has the characteristics of unpredictability and uncontrollability. The sudden rise and drop of city load is becoming the norm. This has a negative impact on the system stability and the situation may get worse when fault occurs in such areas. The reinforcement of city network is restricted by high short-circuit current level and limited transmission corridors, thus the system operators seek more flexible and controllable operation methods. This paper analyses the application of VSC-HVDC technology in city center systems, focusing on providing flexible power support for the connected areas while improving the characteristics of air conditioning load. The effect of VSC-HVDC on the city center system voltage stability is revealed and the capability of MMC for voltage support at different operating conditions is discussed thoroughly.

articleTitle: Game Analysis on Bidding for Purchasing Power Grid Materials at a Low Price
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: On the basis of the bidding model of the lowest-price sealed bid and given the material quality and delivery schedule, this paper offers an analysis of the low price tender in the market of grid materials purchasing using incomplete information game theory. As the quality of materials from successful bidders cannot be fully recognized by grid companies, the low price winning suppliers, driven by interests, will run the risk of cheating on workmanship and materials, thus giving rise to adverse selection in the market of grid materials purchasing. The principal-agent model can generate the mechanism that overcomes the defects of low price tender system and the optimal bid invitation plan: the market supervisory organ is introduced as the third party independently participating in the game; the hierarchical evaluation mechanism for material suppliers is established through repeated game to advance the sound development of material purchase market.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Resonant Overvoltage of AC System at $\pm 800\mathrm{kV}$ Converter Station based on EMTS/EMTPE
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: There are a large number of ac filters, reactors and other reactive compensation equipment in the ±800kV converter station. Continuous switching of capacitive and inductive equipment may trigger resonant overvoltage. This article is based on power electronics and electromagnetic transient calculation program established ±800kV ac system for electromagnetic transient model, to start debugging infill transformer and the ac system for filter when possible resonance overvoltage are analyzed in the simulation. The results show that the transient voltage during the start-up and commissioning of ac system of ±800kV converter station is within the national standard limit and no resonant overvoltage is generated.

articleTitle: Development of On-line Monitoring System for Automation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The on-line monitoring system of automation equipment has developed. The on-line monitoring system for automation equipment includes the master station and the substation. The online monitoring system for automatic equipment is the hardware and software system that is installed in the control center. It is responsible for communicating with online monitoring substations. And it has completed information processing, analysis and distribution. The substation of the online monitoring for automation equipment is the hardware and software system installed at the plant, which has completed protocol conversion, information collection, processing, control and storage And it has send information to the master station according to requirements. The on-line monitoring system of automation equipments has improved the operation level of substation secondary equipments. The functions such as substation's on-line monitoring, abnormal analysis and centralized management of automation equipment have realized. It has provided reliable technical guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Fault Location of Voltage Sag Based on Optimal Allocation of Monitors
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to locate the fault position by the voltage sag monitors, a new fault location method using voltage sag state matching and the positive sequence voltage variation is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a linear programming model is constructed to determine the installation position of voltage sag monitors. It can ensure that voltage sag caused by short circuit can be monitored in a certain range of fault resistance. Then the fault position is located in two steps: the first is to determine the most probable fault line by state matching; the second is to use the positive sequence voltage variation to construct equation. The equation can solve the specific fault location of the fault line. The simulation results show that the method is of high accuracy and high speed in fault location calculation. It has practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on Controlling Method of Frequent Monitoring Signal in Regional Distribution Network Based on AI Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The frequent of the monitoring signal impact working efficiency of the dispatchers, which causes carelessness and endanger the security of power grids. This research proposed scheme of controlling methods. By using Dynamic-decision AI algorithm, alarm threshold is planned flexibly; By using Q-learning AI algorithm, the fundamental reason of the frequent monitoring signals is analyzed, and the solution is automatically given. Case shows the research is of great practical value, which will provide instructive reference for power grid dispatch.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Interconnected Integrated Energy System at User Side Based on Chance Constrained Programming
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Because of the situations that the uncertainty of system, the interconnection among multi integrated energy system (EIS) and interaction among electric, heating and cooling system are not given full consideration, optimal planning of EIS at user side based on bi-level programming is studied in this paper. A method generating multi-state of PV-load in different period is presented by adopting density clustering. Considering the interconnection of multi energy as well as multi-energy router coordination and the combined dispatch of multi energy flow, a bi-level programming model containing is then presented. The elitist strategy genetic algorithm is employed to solve the upper model and branch & bound algorithm is applied to optimizing lower model. The simulation results indicate: the proposed planning method of energy internet is effective.

Author Keywords: combined dispatch of multi energy flow

articleTitle: A Creditability-based Intrusion Tolerant Method for Protection Equipment in Transformer Substations
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of the interconnection of all things(IoT), a large number of mobile terminal devices with multiple users access the distribution network, and gradually form an open and interconnected network environment, which brings new challenges to the security and protection of the distribution network. In this paper, a method of analyzing the sensing data of the digital substation is proposed, which can prevent the abnormal data from causing the malfunction of the protective relays by calculating the creditability of the sensing data. Creditability calculation algorithm as well as the implementation of the intrusion tolerance strategy are studied throughout the paper. The simulation results show that the proposed creditability-based intrusion-tolerant(CIT) algorithm can ensure that the protective equipment have no protective malfunction from the false instructions or false data attacks, and the proposed intrusion tolerant algorithm has little affect on the real-time performance of the original protection algorithm, hence it has some practical value.

articleTitle: Research on a Dynamic Load Power Sharing Method for Distributed Energy Storage System Based on Consensus Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a distributed energy storage system in DC micro-grid is investigated and a hierarchical power sharing control strategy based on discrete consensus algorithm is proposed. First, the power output capacity and equivalent SOC evaluation criteria of the asymmetric energy storage units are given. Based on these criteria, dynamic droop control is proposed to allocate the output power of each energy storage unit at the bottom layer. At the same time, considering the weak communication in distributed energy storage system, discrete consensus algorithm is used in the upper layer to dynamically adjust output power of energy storage units in order to reduce the SOC difference between ESUs. Finally, a simulation model is built in Matlab/Simulink to verify the theoretical analysis. It is proved that the proposed method can achieve the optimal distribution of power in distributed energy storage system.

articleTitle: Research on the Abnormal Discontinuation of Active Distribution Network with Comprehensive Risk and Benefit
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The risk, cost and profit factors of the automatic distribution network are analyzed in this paper, based on which, the multi-objective optimization model is established by evaluating the risk of the restoration sub-process, the restoration control cost and the restoration benefit. The heuristic algorithm based on the greedy strategy is used to optimize the distribution network restoration problem. The simulation results show that the abnormal outage restoration strategy of this paper can take into account the uncertain risks in the process of distribution network restoration and maximize the power supply in the power loss area under the premise of maximizing the economic restoration benefit, Thereby improving the reliability of the distribution network and the economics of the restoration process.

articleTitle: Home Smart Energy Network Configuration Considerations for Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Customer demand-side management through the construction of advanced measurement infrastructure (AMI) and information communication network has been widely recognized. Based on the demand response policy such as electricity price and incentive, a smart energy source for city energy Internet Communication network and implementation plan was proposed in the paper, which combined with the related technical background of smart electricity and smart home. The demand response of home users based on the network scheme was analyzed. The case study shows that this scheme can realize the active participation of users and the interaction with the grid, so that the home intelligent energy source can respond to demand and improve the load curve.

articleTitle: Electric Power Line Insulator Fault Early Warning and Positioning System and Field Test
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Most of the power line faults are caused by insulation problems. And the current way to deal with insulation failures is passive overhaul after the accident. So the insulation fault early warning system of power line based on traveling wave technology was developed. It could eliminate the insulation fault in the early stage of fault. based on the insulation fault early warning principle, the insulation fault early warning system of the power line was designed. and the field test was carried out. The field tests results showed that the insulation fault early warning system of the power line can give early warning of insulator partial discharge with high sensitivity and precision of fault location is high with an average error Of 70 meters, which can meet the requirements of field operation.

articleTitle: Flashover test of insulating shielding cover for live working
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a supporting means for the safety protection of the live working in distribution network, the insulating equipment is of great importance to the safety of the workers due to its insulation characteristics along the surface. In this paper several common insulating shield appliance, surface discharge test was carried out. The surface discharge test uses a ball-rod electrode to simulate field operation conditions and observe the discharge path with a high-speed camera. The test results show that the material types of insulating masks have a great influence on the surface insulating properties, the insulating properties of rubber masks and plastic masks are close, and the surface insulating properties of resin masking utensils are lower. The structure of the thread umbrella skirt has no influence on the surface discharge voltage and does not enhance its insulation performance along the face. Considering the maximum operating voltage of 1OkV distribution line is 11.5kV, the effective protection area of the insulating shielding device is the range of 5cm from the center of the surface of the shielding appliance to the edge.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Compensation and Harmonic Elimination Based on Current Predictive Control Method
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As more and more photovoltaic power stations and wind farms are connected to the urban distribution network, the power quality problems that they caused are also becoming more and more prominent. Renewable energy power generation systems are connected to distribution networks through power electronic conversion devices, which bring a lot of harmonic problems to the power grid. In addition, the power electronic device consumes a certain amount of reactive power in the process of work, which leads to the insufficient of reactive power, and causes the voltage drop at the end of the transmission line. As a result, the power quality problems are seriously affecting the normal power consumption of users. In order to solve the problems of harmonics and reactive power brought by renewable energy systems, a compensation method based on current prediction control strategy is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a discrete-time model of the three-phase four-leg inverter is developed in synchronous reference frame. Then, the controller uses all the possible switching states of the inverter for the prediction and evaluates them using a cost function. The switching state, which minimizes the cost function, is then chosen and applied at the next sampling interval. Finally, theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the proposed method can realize reactive power compensation and harmonic elimination of distribution network.

articleTitle: An intelligent monitoring system based on Internet of Things for electric distribution network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the explosive growth of the electric distribution network, the safety of the power grid becomes more and more important. The traditional maintenance mode based on human capital leads to limited, making it difficult to adapt to the rapid development of the power grid. This paper presents the use of Internet of Things and Power Automation and Monitoring Technology to establish a environment monitoring system for intelligent power distribution, such as water level alarm, noise monitoring, transformer overheating alarm, power panel failure alarm, video surveillance, infrared imaging, and realize the linkage with the track inspection robot. The monitoring system uploads data to a “cloud” server by optical fiber and wireless 4G public network. Centralized online monitoring and management of switching stations and power distribution stations can be achieved by the host computer or mobile clients.

articleTitle: Online Reliability Assessment of Distribution Feeder Considering Time Sequential Load Transfer Procedure
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An online reliability evaluation method for distribution network considering time sequential load transfer procedure is presented in this paper. The method, which takes the medium voltage distribution feeder as the evaluation object, assesses the worst outage risk in real time under the extreme fault condition. In order to simulate the load restoration procedure after fault, an optimization model of the load transfer strategy is set up aiming at minimizing total energy loss. The power variation in load transfer periods as well as the continuous back-up power supply ability is considered in the model, and a multi period heuristic search algorithm is applied to solve it efficiently. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method is verified by case study, and the results can provide references for distribution system operators in distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Management and Control Mode of Distribution Network Project and Assets Based on Bi-Directional Risk Identification and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The management and control of distribution network project is systematic, which runs through the whole process, from project planning to equipment recycling. Features and goals at different stages are different which mix the characteristics of locality and entirety. In this paper, a new method concerning lean management and control mode of distribution network project and assets is proposed based on Bi-Directional risk identification and monitoring system. Firstly, the monitoring and control index from project planning to equipment operation is discussed which can be mostly integrated automatically from the existing info-system. Secondly, the Bi-Directional risk identification model is presented. Finally, the whole-chain abnormal action monitoring system based on quasi-real-time information is introduced. This closed-loop control and feedback mechanism has already been used in distribution project and asset management in SGCC. The application results show that this method makes contribution to precision investment strategy and helps to improve the performance of enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Planning Method for the Safe and Efficient Electric - Gas Multi Energy System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the optimal planning of electric - gas multi energy system is studied to improve the efficiency of comprehensive energy utilization. Considering the demand of multiple energy sources in the integrated energy system, an optimization model of the electric-gas system is established. The model considers the economic and safety reliability optimization objectives, considers the system constraints in the form of different energy requirements, and the weighted Voronoi diagram algorithm is used to solve the problem. Finally, a specific example is given, and the results show that the model and algorithm presented in this paper can provide an integrated energy system optimization program.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling and Dynamic Analysis of Transmission Mechanism With Multiple Clearances And Dynamic Friciton for Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Spring Operating Mechanism (SOM) is a dynamic mechanical system to open and close high voltage circuit breaker in electric power controlling system. For opening and closing within a few mili-seconds, it is highly sensitive with speedy transmission and great reliability. With the clearance joints, the SOM will generate high-frequency vibration due to transient impact. It has complicated wide-band nonlinear dynamic features. To save time and money for a new design and analysis of SOM system, a dynamics model of the SOM with multiple clearances and dynamic friction is established. Also, an experimental platform is built to measure the displacement of the moving contact in opening and closing. The reliability of modeling is validated through the comparison with test data. In addition, the effect of dynamic friction force on the SOM with clearance is investigated. It can be concluded that the modest increase of the friction force has a significant effect on the dynamic responses of the mechanism with clearances.

articleTitle: Analysis of Service Load and Security of Power TD-LTE Wireless Private Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, with the improvement of construction of smart grid and the degree of city energy internet, electricity TD-LTE wireless network in power system is used more and more widely, to meet the increasing demand of power communication services. This paper studies the load and adaptation of distribution automation service in TD-LTE power private network. Finally, this paper analyzes the security risks of TD-LTE power private network, and puts forward specific security protection strategies and measures for security risks.

articleTitle: Multi-rate Collaborative Timing Simulation for Active Distribution Network Cyber Physical System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: with the development of information technology, automation and intellectualization of distribution network, distribution network has gradually developed into a typical cyber physical system (CPS). In distribution network CPS, the information flow and energy flow is mixed, the discrete state and the continuous process interweave, and the dynamic process of conduction mechanism between cyber system and physical system are complex, these brings difficulty for simulation of distribution network CPS. In this paper, the coupling relationship between physical system and cyber system in active distribution network CPS is analyzed. A distribution network communication service model of communication node, link and process based on OPNET are constructed. A framework of information flow and energy flow fusion calculation is proposed, and a multi-rate cooperative timing simulation method based on trigger synchronization is adopted. A prototype system based on distribution network simulation module and OPNET is realized. The effectiveness and correctness of the model and algorithm are verified by a practical example from a CPS demonstration project.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Compatibility of DC Charging Pile
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, the problem of environmental pollution becomes more and more serious. As a representative of green and clean energy vehicles, electric vehicles are gradually emerging in the public view. In the practical application, the energy supply problem of electric vehicles has been bothering people, and the emergence of charging piles has solved this problem well. Charging piles can be divided into ac charging piles and dc charging piles. This paper mainly studies the electromagnetic compatibility problem of dc charging pile system, in order to ensure that the DC charging pile in the power grid safe operation, and does not interfere with the normal operation of other electrical equipment, which requires the DC charging pile of electromagnetic compatibility specification must meet certain countries.

articleTitle: Lifecycle Management of Dropout Fuse
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Dropout fuses are widely used in distribution network of 10 kilovolts for their outstanding characteristics of simple structure and convenient maintenance. However problems occur after a period of usage, such as erosion of the fuse-carrier contacts, fuse-carrier dropout failure, and fuse-holder porcelain insulator fracture. 190 dropout fuses from 6 different manufacturers were tested. And the results showed that the unqualified components had been the major cause of the faults listed above. In order to improve the quality of dropout fuses, a scheme of lifecycle management was promoted of which adaptive and personalized testing was the core means. And the scheme included three stages covering the whole lifecycle of dropout fuses prior to supply through post installation.

articleTitle: Research Locating and Sizing Method of Flexible Closed-loop Device Network Controller Based on Entropy Weight Ideal Solution
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The application of the flexible closed-loop device can be used to solve the problems that the distribution network can't continue to run under the looped operation and improve the reliability of power supply. The location model based on the “primary screening-fine screening” mode is established by means of decoupling the locating and sizing issues in order to solve the locating and sizing NP-hard problems of the flexible closed-loop device in this paper. The model is central with power supply reliability and taking into account of the supply capacity and economic through entropy and ideal point analysis manner for comprehensive assessment program optimization. The sizing model is established based on net load and feeder capacity carrying out the life cycle management of assets concept, and three kinds of applicable sizing methods applied in different stages of development grid are studied based on the analysis of different stages of development characteristics of the grid. The scientific and engineering practicality of this model is showed through the analysis of a demonstration area.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model for Short-Time Wind Power Forecasting Base on Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition and Volterra Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In view of excavating the non-stationary and nonlinearity of wind power, a hybrid model based on ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) and Volterra neural networks(VNN) is introduced. Firstly, the end issue of EEMD is dealt with by using the largest Lyapunov prediction. Secondly, the new gained time series is decomposed into a series of sequences of different time scale by the EEMD to reduce its non-stationary. Then the VNN model of each component is established on the basis of important parameters including embedded dimensions, delay time and maximum Lyapunov exponent, after mining the sequences chaotic characteristics by means of phase space reconstructed. Finally, the predicting results of each subsequence are superimposed to gain the final estimating result. Calculation example results show that the proposed model is able to excavate power time series features effectively and obtain higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on Distribution Transformer Supplier Evaluation Based on Entropy
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution transformer is one of the key equipment in the power system. Its quality is directly related to the continuous and stable operation of the power system. At present, the distribution transformer manufacturing industry is overcapacity. The quality of distribution transformers is different strictly. It has great significance to evaluate the distribution transformer suppliers with an objective quantitative method, which contributes to purchase high-quality equipment and ensure the safe and economic operation of the power grid. There are many researches on the method of supplier evaluation, which mainly focus on the research of evaluation index or index weight. Because of the weak data base and lack of large data support, there are many subjective factors in the process of determining the evaluation process. State Grid Corporation of China (SGCC) has established the supplier database. There are more than 55 thousand suppliers in the database. In the database, there are more than 600 suppliers can produce distribution transformer, which are verified by SGCC. The high quality database enhances solid foundation for supplier evaluation. The method of distribution transformer supplier evaluation based on entropy weight method is proposed. According to the current status of power enterprise supplier management, dig into the database information. The evaluation index is divided into three levels. The first level includes 4 indexes. The second level includes 14 indexes. The third level includes 47 indexes. The evaluation indexes are comprehensive, objective and quantifiable, and the evaluation method is also objective, which avoiding subjective impact and realizing the objective quantitative evaluation of suppliers. Finally, the method is applied to distribution transformer suppliers for example analysis, which verifies the practicability of the evaluation method.

articleTitle: Sishui No.2 Main Transformer Winding Fault Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Transformer Winding Fault is one of the main causes of Transformer damage. When a transformer has an outlet short-circuit accident, it flows through a large short circuit current in the transformer winding. The short circuit current generates electrodynamic force under the mutual action of the leakage magnetic field and can lead to failure of the transformer winding. Based on the analysis of the short circuit accident at the outlet of the No.2 main transformer in Sishui substation, it is very effective to judge transformer winding fault by combining the frequency response method of transformer windings with chromatographic analysis. In order to avoid the override trip accident, the cable should be changed to a fast fuse cabinet or a set of drop switches. In order to avoid the short circuit damage to the transformer, the manufacturer is required to provide the test report on the short circuit resistance of the transformer.

articleTitle: Economic Loss assessment of end-users based on an integrated method of quality loss functions
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increase of the access of different kinds of sensitive devices, voltage sags will bring more serious economic losses to the power consumers. In this paper, a multivariate Inverted Probability Loss Function (IPLF) model based on the entropy weight method (EWM) is proposed to evaluate the economic loss of power consumers. Firstly, the economic loss is divided into two parts, according to causing the interruption of economic activity or not. For the former, according to the voltage tolerance curve of user's device, the failure probability of device is calculated by the probability model considering the energy loss, and the relationship of the quality loss function between the two parties can be established. For the economic loss existed when the economic activity wasn't interrupted, the index of the single voltage sags event in the IEEE standard were used as the variable parameter in the economic loss model. Then EWM was used to synthesize the multiple IPLF. In the end, according to an example based on a user's historical voltage sags monitoring data, the experimental results show that this method can effectively assess the user's economic loss severity of voltage sags, and can provide decision support for the power supply enterprises to choose the power supply scheme and the power users to choose the investment scheme of the governance measures.

articleTitle: Research on Power System Harmonic Detection Based on Hadoop MapReduce Framework
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the advancement of the smart grid construction, higher requirements of computing speed and precision of the power quality monitoring indexes are put forward. The storage capacity and computing ability of the server in traditional power quality monitoring platform can hardly meet the growing demands of operation requirements. The purpose of this article is to realize a high efficiency calculation of sampling data under low hardware cost and minor resource waste. It is realized through Hadoop distributed file system and parallel programming model MapReduce to calculate the basic sampling data in power quality monitoring platform; The harmonic analysis algorithm based on time domain multiplication window is applied to the MapReduce framework of the power quality monitoring platform. The feasibility and superiority of the proposed parallel processing model of the power quality platform are verified through the experiment based on a small Hadoop cluster.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Improving the Voltage Quality of PVGS Connected to Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In allusion to voltage fluctuations at point of common coupling (PCC) caused by photovoltaic generation system (PVGS) connected to distribution network, this paper launches a comprehensive study on factors that affect the PCC voltage variations, using typical examples to quantitatively analyze and sum up the laws. It is expected to make full use of the capacity of PVGS., and optimize the distribution of active and reactive output of PVGS to improve PCC voltage quality. On this basis., two strategies are proposed. One is a reactive setting strategy for suppressing voltage fluctuations under different active output conditions with allowable voltage deviation. Another is for maximizing PCC voltage support under voltage sags. These strategies could suppress PCC voltage fluctuations as active output fluctuating strongly and increase PCC voltage under voltage sags. The simulation verifies the validity and feasibility of the proposed strategies.

articleTitle: The Selection of Rated Voltage on Medium and Low Voltage Side of Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper briefly describes the principle of voltage regulation of 220kV transformer, discusses the influence of selection of rated voltage on medium and low voltage side of transformer, discusses the reasons for the contradiction of voltage adjustment on the medium and low side of transformer, and puts forward several solutions to the voltage adjustment with a concrete example, which has some reference significance in power grid operation and 220kV substation design.

articleTitle: Semidefinite Relaxation Represented ZIP loads in Optimal Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Load modeling is one of the most significant fields in optimal power flow (OPF) problems. However, recent research especially in semidefinite relaxation based OPF has paid much more attention on efficiency, stability and accuracy on convex relaxation reformulation other than load modeling. In this paper, we propose a relatively tightness semidefinite programming (SDP) extension implemented with geometry relations to formulate static ZIP load model, also named as the polynomial load model, which is modeled as constant impedance, constant current and constant power loads, depending on the relation of node voltage magnitude. Such enhanced convex relaxation represented ZIP loads is tighter than that of the former literature reported, since the relaxed polynomial model performs well in detailed load behavior of voltage magnitude dependent. Available SDP formulations on OPF proposed recently can be straightforwardly implemented with the proposed convexity load models. The proposed ZIP load model is tested with up to 118 buses IEEE benchmark on the usage of standard semidefinite programming solvers. The results show that the proposed SDP relaxation represented ZIP load model is on the emergence of both computationally affordable consumption and the accuracy of represented load behavior in reality, since dropping the extra rank relaxation than a previously introduced model.

articleTitle: Parallel Synchronization of Energy Storage System Based on Virtual Synchronizer Control
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the coordinated control strategy for energy storage to realize the island operation of micro grid is studied. Firstly, the energy storage converter model based on virtual synchronous machine control is established. Secondly, based on the stability analysis of multi-parallel connection of virtual synchronous machines in off-grid mode, it is proposed to dynamically adjust the active control parameters in the droop control by introducing state of charge (SOC) feedback to achieve reasonable distribution of active power among different energy storages. Finally, a number of energy storage systems were built on the simulink simulation platform to realize the island operation of the microgrid and verify the effectiveness of the control strategy in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Capacity Selection of Multiple Distributed Generations Connected to Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The distributed generation connected to the microgrid is a key way to balance power supply and demand and to reduce the loss of long distance transmission. The capacity selection of distributed generation in microgrid affects the reliability and economy of power supply. Appropriate capacity of distributed generation is an important part to the efficient and reliable system operation. Based on these points, some research are taken in this article. First, boundary constraints are carried out for the capacity selection of the distributed generation, which are determined by the rated working current of the branch, the upper transformer capacity and the load. Then, based on the consideration of reliability and economy of power supply, the selection optimization are further proposed. Finally, based on the dynamic simulation platform., the microgrid simulation model with multiple distributed generations is carried out to analyse the capacity selection.

articleTitle: The Influence and Countermeasures the Distributed Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Solution for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic power with the large scale has switched in distribution network, lead to circuit nodes added, and increase the difficulty operations of the distribution network. Combined with the existing grid, Operator is difficult to real-time monitoring safe distribution network when photovoltaic switched, including reliable voltage, harmonic, frequency, reactive power and other critical data, certainly will influence the safety of the power distribution network, exist stable and reliable operation of the “black spots” and safe hidden trouble. Aiming at this problem, this paper analyzes the influence of distributed photovoltaic power generation for power distribution network as well as the problems existing grid scheme, put forward the corresponding solving measures, so as to reduce the impact on the distribution network after the distributed photovoltaic access, ensure the safe, stable and reliable distribution network operation.

articleTitle: The Tolerance of ASDs to Voltage Sags Based on Mechanical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on quantifying the influence of voltage sags on adjust speed drivers, putting forward relevant suggestions and improvement measures have become important issues for power grid corporations, power consumers and manufacturers. In this paper, with the dynamic equations of DC circuit and dynamic equations of asynchronous drive, mechanism analyses of the sensitivity to internal (i.e. protection system, control strategies) and external (i.e. load and voltage sags characteristic indexes) factors on ASDs were carried out and proposed corresponding measures. Especially combined with undervoltage and overcurrent protection thresholds, the operating ranges under vector control and direct torque control strategies were obtained, which provided the theoretical reference for protection systems setting with different control strategies to voltage sags.

articleTitle: The Establishment of Energy Storage Model and its Application in Secondary Frequency Regulation of Air Conditioning Load
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The energy storage property of the air conditioning system are studied firstly, based on which, the energy storage model for air-conditioning system is put forward. Then, the air conditioning load aggregation model and the charging/discharging control model of energy storage element in secondary frequency regulation of power system are mainly studied. In load aggregation model, the cluster load of air conditioning will be integrated into a virtual AGC generator unit, with the representation of its regulation capacity, regulation speed and regulation precision. The AGC instructions will be inversed into open or stop control signal of air-conditioning equipment through the charging/discharging control model. Finally, the characteristic of virtual AGC unit is analyzed, and the effectiveness of the air conditioning participating in secondary frequency regulation is verified in the case study.

articleTitle: Discrete-Time Model-Based Eigen-Value Stability Analysis for Multiple-VSC System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With an increasing application of voltage source converter technologies in distribution systems, the dynamic performance is becoming of particular interesting for the designing and stability analysis. In this context, this paper presents discrete-time modeling and stability analysis method for VSC-based AC/DC systems. The converters are defined in this paper through discrete-time modeling, and the dynamic characteristics and stability of the system can be discussed by analyzing the eigenvalues of the state space matrix, in s-plane. According to the case study and simulation results, the accuracy of the method and the theoretical analyses are validated. The modelling can be effectively applied to the design of the controller parameters and the prediction of the stability boundaries.

articleTitle: Research on the Securitization of Electric Vehicle Charging Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The development of new energy vehicles is an important measure to solve the problem of environmental pollution and energy security in China. The maturity of charging network infrastructure planning and construction is an important factor affecting the development of electric vehicle industry. The securitization of electric vehicle charging network provides a feasible financing scheme for the construction of the charging network. By injecting charging network assets into a special purpose company established by the builder Special Purpose Vehicle(SPV), through underwriters issuing asset-backed securities in the capital market, to achieve asset securitization management, and through analyzing the risk of charging network asset securitization to build the investment decision models, the investors can basically determine the securitization term and yield to maturity, so that to obtain low-cost liquidity funds and increase the speed of charging network construction.

articleTitle: The Application of Scenario Analysis in Optimal Dispatch Strategy of Microgrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Micro power grid with wind power and photovoltaic power generation, represented by means of renewable energy distributed generation, since it has intermittent, volatility and unpredictability caused larger negative impact to the micro grid, if a large number of access is difficult to guarantee safe and reliable operation of the power quality and power grid. As a kind of electric energy storage unit, electric vehicles can play a certain role in cushioning the impact of renewable energy power generation on the micro grid. At first, this paper in view of the electric vehicle charging and discharging behavior disorder and intermittent wind power photovoltaic, volatility and unpredictability, scenario analysis method is used to cycle the electric car charge and discharge with wind power and pv output data clustering analysis, cuts, established can reflect the characteristics of the historical data of the typical scenario set; Secondly, considering the equipment parameters and user requirements, etc, under the constraint of fully electric vehicles as the energy storage unit as a cushion, reducing output fluctuations to power renewable energy, improve the utilization of renewable energy, to ensure the safe and reliable economic and efficient operation of micro power grid; Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the feasibility of the proposed scheduling strategy.

Author Keywords: charging and discharging strategy of electric vehicle

articleTitle: Study on Receiving External Power Evaluation Method of the Receiving Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The capacity of power supplied by external for receiving-end grid is comprehensive reflection of how much power of `send to' and' come down'. To a certain extent, the capacity of power supplied by external is the sign of the mature development of the power grid. The mature power grid, such as Beijing and Shanghai power grid, can receive massive external electric power. At the same time, it can guarantee the safe and stable operation of the power grid. But there is no clear method to evaluate and improve the capacity of power supplied by external so far.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of the Charging-Discharging-Storage Integrated Station Based on Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The constructions of energy corollary facilities electric vehicle (EV) charging-discharging-storage integrated station is a Platform that integrates the advantages of charging stations, power stations and power storage stations. In the power market, the operating economic benefits of this platform are the core factor of its survival and development. As a service provider for Power Network and electric vehicles (EV), different Operation mode can be taken and meet the requirement of both. The response on the demand side described in this passage is that the grid guides the integrated station to adjust the operation mode by the market price. In opinion of economics, this paper calculates the economic benefit of the integration station under the three modes of operation of frequency modulation, spinning reserve service and Peak-Load Regulation, Comparison and analysis of three groups were carried out. The results showed that the economic benefit of charge-discharge-storage integrated station provided Peak-Load Regulation is the best, and Profit from providing frequency modulation (FM) is greater than Profit from providing spinning reserve service. Integrated station participates in ancillary services in electricity market is a feasibility development direction for providers of electric vehicle service in the future.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling for Home Energy Based on Chance Constrained Programming
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the optimal scheduling for home energy, on the load side, this paper classifies the loads according to the urgency, and establishes their satisfaction models respectively, then minimizes the customer's cost while guarantees the inhabitants' satisfaction. On the power side, an optimal scheduling model based on the chance constrained programming (CCP) algorithm is proposed to optimize the energy scheduling problem of the home energy management system(HEMS). This model can considerably decrease the consumers' cost by introducing real-time pricing(RTP), photovoltaic(PV) and energy storage system(ESS). Considering that the short-term distribution of PV output is approximately normal distribution, the PV output is expressed as the sum of predicted output and prediction error. The distribution characteristics of error are applied to optimize the scheduling of ESS. The experimental studies reveal that the proposed work is able to satisfy the consumer and achieves better results than previous related researches.

articleTitle: A Systematic Approach to Optimization of Circuit-Breaker Damper
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper shows a systematic approach to optimize the mechanical characteristic of a medium voltage (MV) circuit-breakers (CB) for a wide range of operating temperatures. The mechanical damper is the critical element which strongly determines the travel curve behavior of the CB when opening. Most dampers used in MV-CB contain oil as one of the damping elements. The viscosity of the oil is varying with temperature. Therefore also the damping characteristic of oil damper is temperature depending. To make sure the CB works correctly under all ambient conditions encountered in service measures have to be taken to make sure the CB is able to operate correctly and reliably and fulfills the switching duties required. An existing MV-CB was tested under different ambient temperatures and showed unsatisfactory results. The design of the CB was analyzed and the damper identified as the main root cause. A special test setup for the complete CB and a test jig for the damper only was developed. Based on the findings obtained with this new setups the damper was optimized only by modifying some internal parts of the damper, keeping the outside dimensions and the oil filling the same. Thus eliminating the need of any changes on the CB design. The tests on the CB with the optimized damper showed excellent results at all requested ambient temperature levels. The newly developed damper test rig can be used to quickly and efficiently derive damper parameters or for performance testing of dampers during development or final testing in damper production.

articleTitle: Data Driven Predictive Maintenance of Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents a method for the predictive maintenance of distribution transformers. That is, a method of predicting which transformers are most likely to fail soon. Once predicted, such transformers may be subject to maintenance or replacement. This practice reduces the costs and increases the reliability of power distribution systems. The practice is common in transmission systems. In that domain, physical methods such as dissolved gas analysis see fantastic results. Data-driven techniques utilizing DGA data are also popular. But such methods are cost prohibitive for distribution systems. Instead, this paper proposes to utilize a data driven framework for the task which only uses readily available data. Such data include the transformers' specification, loading, location, and weather-related information. Such data inspire the use of two suitable machine learning algorithms. The first is random forests. The second is the Random Undersampling with AdaBoost (RUSBoost) algorithm. These algorithms are tested on over 700,000 distribution transformers in Southern California. This test finds that both algorithms outperform the current state of practice. Further, it finds that the RUSBoost algorithm performs better than the Random Forest.

articleTitle: A Review of Wind Turbine Deloaded Operation Techniques for Primary Frequency Control in Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Wind farm is rapidly increasing across the world as a cheaper source of green energy and as fossil fuel is depleting every day. Most conventional power plants have been replaced with wind turbines generators as a result of the high increasing penetration of renewable energy especially wind power, but this has negatively impacted on the frequency stability and reliability of power systems due to wind speed variability. A required frequency can't be compromised, so a new global grid code regulation mandates all wind turbine generators (WTGs) in an interconnected electricity network to participate in primary frequency control (PFC) for the curtailment of frequency disturbance in the power system as a result of generation and load consumption imbalance. Literature shows that the deloaded mode of operation which makes the wind turbine participate in the primary frequency control is still emerging and very vast in scope and has a critical role to play as reliability and availability of electric power in this industrial age is concern. This paper provide an extensive up-to-date literature review of deloaded mode of operation for primary frequency regulation of wind turbine generators in an interconnected power system. Various control modes and comparisons with the deloaded mode are highlighted as well. Again, an assessment into some factors that determine quantity and quality of the power reserve margins, the percentage of reserve margin per the level of wind farm penetration and some optimization processes as well as projected future research works will be outlined.

articleTitle: Research on Topology and Control Technology of Soft Multi-State Open Point with Fault Isolation Capability
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The common phenomenon of open-loop operation of closed-loop designed distribution networks leads to a slow load transfer speed and unbalanced feeder power. Meanwhile, the increasing amount of DC loads and the growth of new permeability have brought new challenges to the operation control of distribution network, which requires a stronger power flow regulation ability. This paper carries out the study of soft multi-state open point (SMOP) technology used in distribution network feeder in order to meet the aforementioned challenges. A topology of a three-terminal SMOP with fault isolation capability is proposed followed by its mathematical model analysis. Based on the mathematical model, the operating range of the proposed topology is then determined. After that, the structure of control system and a self-healing control strategy is designed for the SMOP. A three-terminal SMOP simulation model based on PSCAD/EMTDC is constructed in which the validity of the proposed topology and its control strategy are verified.

articleTitle: Introduction of Australian 100MW Storage Operation and its Enlightenment to China
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: On 1st December 2017, the world's largest 100MW/129MWh lithium battery storage power station from Tesla was put into operation in South Australia. Then on 14th December 2017 and 18th January 2018, Tesla storage battery participated in grid frequency recovery after Victorian Loy Yang power station unit tripping accident. Tesla was triggered 140ms after the accident, before injecting active power to the grid. As a result, grid frequency was back to 50Hz with the help of Tesla and other contracted coal-fired generators within 6 minutes. Up to now, Tesla power station has provided auxiliary services such as regular adjustment and output, energy output and emergency output to the power grid. This paper first analyzes the physical and economic reasons why Tesla storage battery is integrated into Australia power grid. Then the structure and control strategy of battery is introduced. The operation of energy storage is introduced from both physical and economic dimensions. Later on, energy storage grid related technical standards and evaluation hierarchy are suggested to be made. New type of ancillary service is developed and storage’ s profit making mode is explored. All above proposals are lessons that China should learn to develop its storage technologies and storage-grid integration technologies.

articleTitle: Research on the Available Power Supply Capacity Assessment Method Considering the Access of Large-Scale New Energy Generation and Electric Vehicle Charging Facilities
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, the development of electric vehicles has shown a rapid growth trend. The emergence of large-scale new distributed energy generation technology has brought profound changes to the analysis, design and control of the traditional distribution system. Therefore, a comprehensive analysis tool is developed to evaluate the power supply capacity of the active distribution network and build a comprehensive power supply capability. The combined evaluation model has important research value. This paper considers the uncertainty of new energy power generation forecast and the scale of electric power. The vehicle charging is the size of the typical flexible load response behavior, and the power supply capacity is analyzed. The three dimensions of the voltage limit, the limit of the thermal limit and the voltage collapse are discussed, and the concept of the transmission limit of the power system (TTC) is proposed, which is the basis for determining the available transmission capacity (ATC). The computation of ATC mainly includes deterministic algorithm and probabilistic algorithm. Under the power system operation constraint (AGC) of the active distribution network, under the premise of ensuring the balance of power generation and load, maintaining the frequency quality of the power system and the physical constraints of the active distribution network, the mathematical model of the power supply capacity from the new energy generation node to the load node is studied and established.

Author Keywords: New energy and electric vehicle charging facilitie s

articleTitle: A Combination Control Strategy of VSC-HVDC with Wind Farms Based on Virtual Synchronous Generator of Voltage Drop Method
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large-scale wind farms can supply power to the AC power grid through the HVDC based on voltage source converter (VSC-HVDC). This paper proposes a combination control strategy based on virtual synchronous generator (VSG) of voltage drop without relying on communication for the case of small disturbances and large shifts in the frequency on the AC power grid. Firstly, the improved virtual synchronous machine technology is added on the grid side VSC (GSVSC) of the DC side to selectively provide an effective inertial response for the frequency disturbance of the receiving-end power grid. Secondly, the wind farm VSC (WFVSC) adopts an improved frequency conversion control strategy and selectively responds to the frequency control according to the voltage fluctuation level of the DC side. At the same time, the doubly-fed wind turbines of the wind farms use virtual synchronous machine technology to adjust the rotating speed, rather than the traditional maximum power tracking mode. Finally, simulation experiments on PSCAD/EMTDC simulation software verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Exploration of Building Energy Management System in the Form of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Building energy consumption which is still maintain a rapid growth trend accounts for about 20% of total energy consumption in china, and buildings have a huge impact on resources, energy and environment. It has been recognized that building is one of the key factors to peak carbon emissions. This paper discusses building energy management connotation and development tendency in the energy internet form, then create the systems architecture and functional design of building energy management system. These can provide some good suggestions about energy management innovatation and software development under the new situation.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation Method for Asset Management Performance of Distribution Network Based on Optimal Combination Weight
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Asset management performance evaluation is an important part of enterprise asset management. In order to improve asset management performance evaluation system of distribution network (DN) in China, a new performance evaluation model of asset life cycle management(LCM) is proposed. Firstly, through an in-depth analysis of development characteristics of DN and the various demands of users in China, based on interface between users and DN, a comprehensive performance evaluation system is constructed for asset LCM covering economy, service efficiency and social benefits and other aspects. According to the purpose of enterprise and the characteristics of each index, an optimal combination weighting method, which takes both subjective and objective factors into consideration, is used to weight the service efficiency and social benefit indexes. Based on this, the performance evaluation model and calculation method of DN asset management are established. Finally, the evaluation method is applied to the performance evaluation of annual assets management of the DN in 14 counties of a municipal power company.

articleTitle: Fast Search Method for AC / DC Cascading Failures based on Short Circuit Ratio Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In China, multi in feed AC and DC hybrid power system has been formed. The AC system fault may lead to the failure of multi DC simultaneous commutation failure, and the cascading failure of avalanche type may occur. In this paper, a fast search method of AC fault region, which considers the interaction of AC and DC interaction and multi DC interaction, is considered, and the impact of single DC or multi DC commutation failure on AC power grid is evaluated, and the fast search for AC and DC cascading failures is realized. Firstly, based on the two port Devenan equivalent, the influence of AC fault on the node voltage of DC converter station is calculated quickly, and the AC failure criterion of DC commutation failure is derived according to the minimum turn off angle standard. Further considering the influence of DC commutation failure on other DC, from the fault bus, the node of commutation failure DC converter station and the adjacent converter station, the multi-port Devenan equivalent of the power grid is carried out to calculate the influence of reactive power impact on the bus voltage of other DC converter stations during the failure of DC commutation, and a comprehensive criterion for the commutation failure is derived. Then, the influence of DC commutation failure on AC power grid is quantitatively evaluated from two aspects of active power impact and reactive power impact. The actual power grid calculation shows that the proposed DC commutation failure judgment method is more accurate and comprehensive, and the construction method of AC and DC cascading fault sets is practical.

articleTitle: Study on Regional Energy Planning for Municipal Power Grid Containing Clean Power
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the incomplete or serious lack of measurement data in the renewable energy planning of municipal power grids, the equivalent parameters calculating method of the region was studied in this paper, based on the multidimensional autoregressive model. Renewable electricity energy planning including wind power was executed in a regional power grid according to its historical load data and wind speed data. The executable renewable energy planning schemes were determined under different emission reduction targets on the platform of HOMER software, with the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission reduction goal as the main constraint, the optimal economy as the objective function. Analysis conclusions provides a reference for the region to formulate renewable energy development policies.

articleTitle: Domestic and Foreign Power Grid Peak Shaving of The Comparison of The Auxiliary Service Mechanism and Thinking: The Significance of Gansu Province
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, more energy to participate in power grid peak shaving tendency in Gansu province is increasingly obvious, clean energy development is swift and violent, the power structure, space truss structure has greatly changed, the system scale continues to expand, the ancillary services on peak mechanism is also put forward more requirements. The current domestic existing auxiliary service market transaction cost compensation and pricing mechanism is not perfect and the problem such as peak shaving of incentive mechanism is not sound. For further implement all measures to electric power system reform, the reduction of electric power commodity attribute, build effective competition market structure and market system, optimize the allocation of resources in a larger scope, need to further improve and deepen the power auxiliary service compensation mechanism (market). Because national electricity market model is different, it is difficult to establish a universal reingistic algorithm of auxiliary services, countries will according to your own experience and the structure of the power market, determine your pricing strategy, according to the actual situation, formulate suitable service mechanism of peak-load regulation. In this article, through analysis of the United States, the Nordic countries, countries such as Britain and Australia, the auxiliary service content, trading mechanism, compensation pricing method, etc., and extract its can be reference for the reform of Gansu power grid peak shaving, the macro view, the government strengthen macro management, enterprises improve their strength, and the public to actively participate in, and objectively look at foreign successful cases, under the condition of region in Gansu province to explore the stronger mechanism was improved. Through microscopic research, this paper puts forward the following Suggestions, such as unified electricity market, safeguard fair competition in the electric power, at the same time offers a clear signal of investment and construction, moment hold national policy vane, establish special auxiliary services policy research institute; Formulating appropriate region in Gansu power grid peak shaving the cost of ancillary services, cost analysis and strategy for accurate; Update the market main body concept, strengthen market theory study, improve the efficiency of market mechanism; Ability and quality of relevant personnel to ascend, promoting education and training; Especially the area of Gansu province ancillary services to perfect the compensation mechanism, this is one of the important link, etc. All of these in northwest Gansu province, we will improve the mechanism of peak shaving auxiliary services put forward constructive advice, as well as our country comprehensively deepen peak shaving auxiliary services provide reference and inspiration.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Photovoltaic Virtual Synchronous Generators
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Virtual Synchronous Generators (VSG), as an effective mean to improve the frequency and voltage regulation ability of the photovoltaic power generation, had aroused wide concern. The analysis on whether VSG would cause stability problem became an important issue to ensure the safety of power system. The stability analysis of photovoltaic VSG is an enormous challenge because this VSG not only retains the characteristic of power electronic devices but also emulates the essential behavior of synchronous generators. Existing studies concentrated on the stability of VSG device and the risk of oscillation when VSG applied in microgrid. The damping characteristic of distributed photovoltaic VSG has not been researched. Meanwhile the impact of each VSG control parameter on oscillation model damping has already been studied. However, the interactive influence from several parameters to system stability has not been discussed in existing researches. To address these issues, this paper developed the small signal model of photovoltaic VSG. The oscillation mode of VSG system was calculated based on this model, which was also applied to investigate the stability of whole system with different control parameters and under various system scenarios. The results obtained by small-signal model are validated by digital simulation equipped with physical controller. Brief conclusions were drawn as follows: (1) grid-connected photovoltaic VSG system has three dangerous oscillation modes of poorly damp, which are the mode caused by the power control, the mode introduced by virtual impedance control and the mode associated with LC filter; (2) unstable subsynchronous oscillation will appear if power droop gain or virtual mechanical time constant exceeds the threshold. High-frequency or synchronous oscillation may be excited by decreasing the virtual resistance. Subsynchronous oscillation can be caused by increasing the virtual resistance. Reduction of virtual inductance is likely to result in high-frequency or subsynchronous oscillation and growing of virtual inductance will contribute to a negative damping for subsynchronous and synchronous oscillation mode; (3) the damping of new oscillation mode introduced by power control of VSG is relatively small when photovoltaic VSG is applied in low voltage power grid. The influence from system condition to damping of oscillation mode associated with LC filter is the key factor to decide the stability of VSG system in high voltage grid.

articleTitle: Review on Synchronous Condenser Modeling Study
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Synchronous condenser is an important reactive resource of power system, the operation of which is significant. Its model has always been a major concern to researchers, because accurate and reasonable synchronous condenser parameter is the basis of analysis and calculation of system dynamic behavior. With the increasing of the safety and stability of power grid, it is more imperative to obtain modeling and parameter identification method. In this paper, generator and excitation system model and parameter identification of synchronous condenser are studied and summarized, in order to obtain its equivalent model which can in accord with or be close to practical operation state.

articleTitle: The Application Research of Very Low Frequency Diagnostic Methods in Acceptance Tests on New Cable Systems of Medium Voltage
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Tangent delta (TD) measurements using very low frequency (VLF) sinusoidal waveform in aged cable system have been proved sensitive to water tree degradation and insulation aging. Whereas, the application of VLF in acceptance tests on new cable systems of medium voltage is still on research and development. This paper presents an experimental study of the capability of the main VLF testing methods for newly installed 10kV XLPE cable systems in acceptance tests. Compared with oscillation wave excitation, the different waveforms including sinusoidal (Sinus) and cosine-rectangular (CR) of VLF voltage were employed to stress the nine samples of artificial defects of different types. Various characteristics of TD measurement and partial discharge (PD) measurement were analyzed. The results showed that VLF-Sinus voltage has a distinctive ability of detection for a wet or lossy accessory through TD or PD measurements. It is recommended to employ a combination of the monitored VLF-Sinus withstand with TD measurement and the PD measurement under damped alternative current (DAC) or VLF-CR as field diagnostic tools in acceptance test for newly installed cables.

articleTitle: An Optimizing Power System Dispatch with An Extra EV Load Using PLEXOS Appoach
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The vehicles powered by electricity are quickly developed to meet the reduction in greenhouse gas emissions. Although electrical vehicle (EV) dose produce less carbon emissions and the less fossil fuel are consumed compared with traditional vehicles, the electricity should be supplied to EV battery charging where excess emissions would be produced from power generation. In this work, we try to optimize the power dispatch for the extra electronic vehicle loading exemplified by the Ireland's electricity market in 2020 with a commercial PLEXOS software. We have investigated the effects of the EV load on the SEM (Single Electricity Market) with the four different scenarios including peak, off-peak, stochastic, and EPRI, respectively.
