The simulative model was used to optimize the dispatch of a generation and supply energy for a specified demand load. It was confirmed the EV charging at the peak time presented the highest increasing in the systematic marginal price, generation costs and total C02 emissions. The off-peak charging is more beneficial than other charging modes that would contribute 1.54% renewable energy penetration and supply to the 200% emissions reduction target. The present work may provide a new idea and technological approach for the sectional dispatch of the power grid and optimizing EV load in the future.

articleTitle: An Overview of Transmission Line Trip Risk Assessment Under Typhoon Disaster
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power systems in all parts of the world are suffering from the plaguing of the wind disaster, and many coastal cities are suffering from serious typhoons. The trip fault of the power transmission line caused by the typhoon has occurred frequently, so the risk assessment of the transmission line under typhoon disaster is increasingly important. This paper summarizes some typical cases of typhoon around the world, and concludes the main reasons for the trip of transmission lines, including windage yaw, floater, tower damage, broken line, lightning stroke and so on. In view of the reasons of the trip, the Monte Carlo method, fuzzy mathematical model, machine learning algorithm, probability model, regulation method and improved electrical geometry model are introduced. The model and so on are applied to the risk assessment method and model of transmission line trip, and the preventive measures for transmission line failure under typhoon disaster are put forward. By summarizing the relevant literature on the risk assessment of power system at home and abroad, the existing literature on the risk assessment of power system in bad weather is more, but the research on the risk assessment of transmission line trip under typhoon disaster is less. Finally, this paper looks forward the development prospect of the risk assessment of transmission line trip under typhoon disaster.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Control Architecture and Decentralized Cooperative Control Strategy for Large Scale Air Conditioning Load Participating in Peak Load Regulation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the realization of large-scale air conditioning (AC) load to participate in demand response, a decentralized multi-agent cooperative control strategy based on leader-follower consistency was proposed. A hierarchical architecture that can effectively control large-scale ACs and a topology model of multi-agent related communication network were constructed. The demand side load reduction cost of the grid company was a quadratic function for the user's load reduction. A leader-follower decentralized coordination algorithm based on incremental cost of load response was proposed to meet the requirement of precise load control for a large number of dispersed ACs. Finally, case studies were given to show that the proposed method can achieve the optimal state of consistency under different load conditions and agent topology. In addition, an example was given to simulate the overall peak load regulation of large-scale ACs from top to bottom.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Preference Optimization of Unit Restoration During Network Reconstruction Based on DE-EDA
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The non-black-start generator start-up sequence optimization is an essential step for power system restoration. a multi-objective optimization model with consideration of preferences in terms of the relative importance of objectives is built to optimize generator start-up sequence and associated restoration paths simultaneously. The a priori elicitation method is used to solve the multi-objective optimization problem. The preference information is explicated by designing a subset of the whole feasible space. Then, the preferred solutions are searched in the designed region by using DE-EDA. Several Pareto optimal generator start-up sequences and restoration paths which are more desirable for the preferences can be obtained after the model is solved. Finally, a practical power system, the western power system of Shandong province in China is employed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Instability of Wind Farms Based on Nyquist Stability Criterion
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The wind-power generation is a kind of renewable energy technology with the good development prospects at present. As the problem of wind farm resonance becomes more and more serious. Moreover, because of the negative damping of the VSC(voltage source converter) output impedance in partial frequency domain, sometimes there is a problem of harmonic instability in wind farms. The purpose of this paper is to analyze the mechanism of harmonic instability in wind farms. Firstly, the harmonic model of wind farms is built in this paper. The VSC impedance model base on the control parameters is established to explore the output characteristics of the VSC in the wind turbine. The transmission and amplification rules of harmonics in the VSC control loop are explored. Further, the influence factors of harmonic instability are analyzed by using Nyquist stability criterion. Meanwhile, passive damping is used to suppress harmonic instability.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Area Identification Method Based on Reactive Power Loss Severity Index Under Disturbance of Magnetic Storm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the condition of strong magnetic storm, geo-magnetically induced current (GIC) flowing through the neutral point of the transformer, causing the increase of reactive power loss, which leads to overload of the reactive power compensation device, drop of the bus voltage and occurrence of a chain fault, which in turn causes a blackout of the system. However, it is not realistic from the perspective of economy and technology to suppress GIC at each substation. Based on this, this paper first analyzes the change rule of reactive power loss of substations under different magnetic storm intensity and direction and then defines the reactive power loss severity index of the substation. The indicator only normalized the actual reactive power losses and does not change the relative relationship between the magnitudes of reactive losses of each transformer. According to the indicator, a identification method for the areas susceptible to magnetic storms in a given system is proposed, which can provide a basis for grid planning and the operation of system dispatchers under the influence of geomagnetic storms. Finally, 750kV power system is taken as an example to verify the feasibility of the proposed algorithm and the vulnerable areas in the example are pointed out.

articleTitle: Adaptability of Wind Power Integration and Comparison Study on Grid Code Technical Requirements
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Wind power is a mainstream of renewable energy power generation. With its increasing capacity in power grid, it is very urgent to study the technical requirements and adaptability of wind power integration. To ensure the safe and steady operation of network and improve the adaptive ability, investigations on wind power integration have been made by system operators of countries and the grid codes for wind farms have also been issued. Based on the adaptability of wind power integration, this paper reviews the international grid code technical requirements for wind farms, especially focus on the comparison study of low voltage ride through (LVRT), power control and operating adaptability, and confirms the formulating principle and specific index differences of international grid codes. Finally, the new issues that may be caused by large-scale wind power integration are explored and some suggestions are proposed from the perspective of mutual adaptability between wind farms and power system, which will make a certain reference value for further improving grid code technical requirements.

articleTitle: Reactive Planning of Island Power Grid Containing VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Island power grids usually face with more challenges than the traditional other types of grids. An approach of operation optimization for island power grid utilizing VSC-HVDC is proposed in this paper. It makes use of VSC to actively regulate active and reactive power. The goal to reduce power loss as well as optimize the economic costs due to the switching of capacitor banks in power stations is considered. In accordance with the characteristics of this model, an improved genetic algorithm is employed. Based on a practical project- Multi-terminal VSC-HVDC Demonstration Project in Zhoushan, the effects of the proposed approach is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Limit Access Capacity of Photovoltaic Source on the Basis of Chance-constrained Programming in Rural Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To avoid the calculation of limit access capacity of photovoltaic (PV) source is incorrect due to the consideration of the occurrence of a small probability event, this paper proposes a method to calculate the limit access capacity of photovoltaic (PV) source based on the chance onstraints of voltage deviation on the basis of considering the randomness of PV power and load. Maximizing limit access capacity of PV is regarded as the goal, the voltage deviation is regarded as the chance constrained condition, the calculation model of limit access capacity of PV is established. Then, using the LHS and Newton-Raphson to calculate the probabilistic load flow (PLF), the statistical properties of node voltage are obtained. Calculation results of PLF and quantum genetic algorithm are used to solve the model. By comparing the results of optimization with heuristic method, the correctness and validity of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: Discriminate Method of Power Frequency Ferroresonance in System with Non-Effectively Earthed Neutral of Three-Phase Enclosed GIS
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Ferroresonance overvoltage is one of the most important factors to impact electric equipment inner insulation. In system with non-effectively earthed neutral, the equipment damage caused by ferroresonance overvoltage possesses great proportion. This paper derives the criterion of power frequency ferroresonance in system with non-effectively earthed neutral in detailed, in order to conveniently judge whether there is power frequency ferroresonance when system transferring working mode. This criterion derives the relation between equivalent circuit resistance and critical resistance using analytical method and can be used for determining the zero sequence resistance value in cascade with PT secondary side for eliminating ferroresonance. The method is verified by an example under two conditions. Finally, the effect of neutral connecting arc suppression coil on ferroresonance is analyzed.

articleTitle: Corona Discharge Characteristics for Conductors of HVDC Transmission Lines with Different Heights to Groud
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The corona discharge characteristic of the conductor is one of the key factors affecting the electromagnetic environment of the project. In order to obtain corona discharge characteristics of conductors with different heights to ground and correction methods for inception corona voltage of conductors with different heights to ground, corona test were carried out in Ultra-high Voltage Test Base in Wuhan with ultraviolet image apparatus, the corona test of conductors of JL/G1A-1250/100 and JL/G lA-1250/70 at different heights to ground were carried out, one single conductor, 6-bundle conductor with bundle space 500mm and 8-bundle conductor with bundle space 550mm were tested separately. The results show that Under DC positive voltage, the corona inception voltage for conductors increased with the rise of the height to ground, different bundle distances, different bundle conductors and one single conductor corona discharge characteristics have some differences; The corona inception voltage between single conductor and different bundle distances conductors have certain functional relationship. By establishing the functional relationship between them, the corona inception voltage of bundle conductors can be calculated by the corona inception voltage value of a single conductor, the value of correction errors can be controlled at less than 13%.

articleTitle: Risk Visualization of Power Tower under Typhoon Disaster Based on Multi-source Heterogeneous Information
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Risk visualization of power system under typhoon disaster has important scientific significance and engineering application value for power system disaster prevention and mitigation. In this paper, based on the multi-source hetero-generous information database, such as equipment operation information, meteorological information and geographic information, the damage probability models of the main power tower network based on 6 machine learning algorithms including AdaBoost iteration algorithm, GBRT (Gradient Boost Regression Tree), RF (Random Forest), LR (Logistic Regression), SVR (Support Vector Regression) and CART (Classification and Regression Tree) are established by utilizing the historical damage data of the main power tower network under typhoon disaster in a coastal city, and the error and prediction accuracy of the models are compared. Then by combining with the historical data of typhoon “Mujigae”, the predicted damage probability and risk value of each model are visualized with the geographic grid of 0.15°×0.1°. The predicted effectiveness of these models is compared, and the ideal model and display index is selected.

articleTitle: Study on Power-Transmission Curve of Wind Power Transmitted with Thermal Power Considering Wind Power Peak Load Regulation Requirement
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Driven by growing concerns about climate change, rapid depletion of conventional fossil fuel and global environmental issues, the installation of wind power has increased significantly in many countries in recent years. Due to the variability and low capacity factor of wind power, it is inevitable that wind power should be transmitted with thermal power through high-voltage transmission lines to the load centers. In this situation, the paper presents a method for power-transmission curve of wind power transmitted with thermal power considering wind power peak load regulation requirement. The peak load regulation requirement probabilistic model for transmitted wind power is proposed due to its random nature. Then, the optimation model for co-operation wind power and thermal power is prensted, which takes into the account constraints of thermal units and transmission line, and the objective function being maximized is the transmitted energy The case studies are carried out for a system, and the results verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the presented method.

Author Keywords: Wind power transmission with thermal power

articleTitle: Optimization of Renewable Energy Big Data Transactions Based on Vector Evaluated Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To maximize the profits of both buyer and seller in renewable energy big data (REBD) transactions., a vector evaluated genetic algorithm (VEGA) based optimal trading strategy is proposed in this paper. Firstly., the REBD evaluation model is designed to calculate the objective function of VEGA. Multiple dimensions of REBD are used to set up the evaluation model. To address the problem in weight assignment of different aspects., analytic hierarchy process (AHP) based fuzzy evaluation method is adopted. Then., the problem of accessing win-win REBD transactions is converted into a multi-objective optimization problem. On this basis., vector evaluated genetic algorithm (VEGA) was used to solve the transaction optimization problem and find the Pareto solution by searching the non-inferior solution of all proposals. Finally., the accuracy of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation results of a REBD transaction case.

articleTitle: Analysis of AC Asymmetrical Fault on DC Control System in Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Compared with the individual AC microgrid and DC microgrid, hybrid AC/DC microgrid is more suitable for high permeability renewable energy access to the power grid. Hybrid microgrid contains a lot of sensitive DC load and all kinds of distributed generations (DG). The harmonic disturbance produced by the AC fault will not only affect the DC line, but also affect the control system of the DG, resulting in the violent fluctuation of the output power of the DG, which is not conducive to the stability of the hybrid microgrid. Firstly, the influence of disturbance (zero sequence component and negative sequence component) caused by AC grounded fault on voltage and power of the DC system is analyzed in depth. Secondly, the action mechanism of the zero sequence component and negative sequence component to the DG control system on DC side is studied, and then the calculation method of the internal loop current reference containing the disturbance component is given under the typical control strategy of DG. Finally, a hybrid microgrid fault equivalence model is built on the PSCAD/ EMTDC software in order to verify the correctness of the aforementioned theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Smart Grid Comprehensive Development Level Based on Combination Weighting Method and Improved Grey Relational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to assess the status quo of the smart grid comprehensive development level in various countries, this paper proposes an evaluation method combining combination weighting method and improved grey relational method. Combining with the concept of the smart grid, this paper establishes an index system that evaluates the smart grid comprehensive development level. It starts from three aspects: infrastructure, operational effectiveness, and policies and regulations. This paper combines ANP weighting method and the Emma-Kantiratry weighting method to obtain an integrated weight vector. Besides, this paper combines grey relational method with TOPSIS method to obtain the weighted evaluation result, by calculating the gray relation and the Euclid distance between the sample data and the two series.

articleTitle: Restarting Strategy of UPFC Series Connect Unit for Fault Ride-Through Based on Fault Identification
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the latest generation of Flexible AC Transmission System(FACTS) devices, UPFC integrates various flexible control means of FACTS components. Because of the weak insulation capacity of electronic equipment, UPFC fault ride-through capability is limited. This paper introduces the fast fault isolation technique of UPFC, and then a restarting strategy of UPFC series connect unit based on fault identification is put forward for improving fault ride-through capability. Based on comprehensively analyzing UPFC control protection system operation, AC protection operation, power gird status and switch position, the most appropriate operation mode of UPFC such as shutdown, switching mode or restarting to the original mode is determined. For the faults which are determined to restarting, the strategy detects different characteristic quantities for identifying fault recovery for different fault types, the restart of series connect unit is performed when conditions are satisfied. Then discrimination principle and implementation method of the strategy are represented in detail. And based on power flow transfer distribution factor method, the power instruction is adjusted quickly after UPFC restarting caused by remote power gird fault. The strategy is verified in simulation test for Nanjing 220kV power grid UPFC project. The result shows that it has good application feasibility and power grid adaptability, and the strategy can further improve UPFC fault ride through capability.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation System of the Investment Effect of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the State Grid Corporation accelerated the development of the distribution network, the scale of investment in distribution networks continued to increase during the 13th Five-Year Plan period. To this end, the grid company urgently need to make a scientific evaluation of the Investment effect and provides guidance for investment allocation. This paper focuses on the relationship between grid investment and efficiency, establishes a lean evaluation system and investment allocation method.

articleTitle: A New Method for Calculating the Voltage Dip Type in Three-Phase Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Voltage dip is one of the severe power quality disturbances, leading to complains from the industry customers. There are kinds of ways to mitigate the effect by voltage dip. Calculating and determining the dip type is the premise of choosing the mitigation method. This paper proposes a new algorithm for calculating the voltage dip type. The algorithm is based on the shapes of Type C and Type D. Apply the new algorithm on comprehensive voltage dips and compare with the typical dip type method to verify the feasibility and correctness.

articleTitle: A Two-stage Optimization Method for Economic Operation of the Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a two-stage optimization method is presented to achieve the goal of economic operation of the Micro-grid. The first stage minimizes the user cost on the basis of load scheduling, taking users' satisfaction into consideration and the model is solved by Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. The second level is aimed at optimizing output of units including a wind turbine, a photovoltaic, a battery storage system and a micro-turbine in micro-grid. The economic operational cost is considered in micro-grid model, which is solved by mixed integer linear programming method. In the test case, operational costs in two scenarios including load characteristic and without load characteristic are separately analyzed, and the output of units are compared. The results show that based on the proposed two-stage optimization method, the operation cost of micro-grid will be reduced obviously.

articleTitle: A Method for Supraharmonic Source Determination Based on Complex ICA
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Harmonic distortion in the frequency range 2 to 150 kHz is referred to as supraharmonic. The influence of supraharmonic on power grid has become a concern with increasing modern power electronic devices connected into power grid. Determining responsibility is the premise for controlling and managing supraharmonic. Since harmonics of a point of common coupling (PCC) are commonly produced by both utility side and customer side, it is important to determine which side is the dominant harmonic source and quantify their respective responsibilities. Considering supraharmonic sources of both sides are approximately independent, the complex independent component analysis (Complex ICA) method is used to obtain the mixed matrix and supraharmonic impedances of both sides. Meanwhile, a new index for judging dominant supraharmonic source is proposed by vector projection technique. Project the supraharmonic voltages, which are produced respectively by the supraharmonic sources of the utility side and the customer side, to the measured voltage of a PCC. By comparing the value of the projection, if the value of one side is larger than half of the supraharmonic voltage of the PCC, it can be considered to be a dominant harmonic source. The method can determine the position of dominant supraharmonic source and quantify the responsibility, which provides new ideas for the supraharmonic source tracing. Validity and effectiveness are verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Design of UPFC Sub-Synchronous Oscillation Damping Controller Based on Modal Control
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) is a specific dynamic behavior due to the coupling of mechanic and electrical parts of power system, which is a severe stability problem. Unified Power Flow Controller (UPFC), as the most advanced FACTS device, can restrain the system oscillation effectively through proper design. In this paper, UPFC's ability to damp SSO was studied first. An UPFC damping controller design method based on the modal control method is then proposed. Analysis of examples show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively suppress the sub-synchronous oscillation of power system and improve the stability of the system.

articleTitle: The Study on Mechanism of the Influence from MMC-HVDC on Sub-synchronous Oscillation of the Units
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As MMC-HVDC system is of a large number of applications, the mechanism of its influence on the SSO characteristics of the adjacent units needs to be studied. This article proposed the coupling loop of the voltage disturbance between HVDC system and the AC bus, and further established the response characteristics equations of MMC-HVDC control system between amplitude and phase perturbation of the AC bus voltage. Then, the damping characteristics based on response characteristic equations above were analyzed to reveal the phenomena and reason of the weak connection between MMC-HVDC and the units' SSO characteristics. Finally, the results are verified by electromagnetic transient simulations. The results show that MMC-HVDC system has weaker damping effect on the units' SSO characteristics.

articleTitle: A Short Term Load Forecasting by Considering Heat Island Effect Factor Based on IGA-ELM Model
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Load forecasting accuracy directly affects the safety, stability, and economic efficiency of the power grid. For the problem that the extreme learning machine (ELM) randomly generates the weights and the thresholds which makes the network model unstable, this paper proposes a load forecasting method based on an improved genetic algorithm (IGA) to optimize the ELM. The characteristics and causes of the heat island effect are analyzed and the prediction accuracy is further improved after adding the heat island effect for the first time, which is of great significance for ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Static Security Assessment Considering Uncertainty Based on Sampled-Blind-Number for Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To consider the uncertainty, a Sampled-Blind-Number (SBN) based static security evaluation for distribution networks is put forward. The load and distributed generation are modeled as a region load with uncertainty and it is described by a certain SBN with a group of sampled values and the corresponding probabilities. A fault is set in each position and N-l criterion is checked for each combination of the possible load value. The risk probability of N-l criterion not met, the degree of risk and the safety margin from risk are calculated. An example is given to explain the proposed approach showing the SBN is a good way to describe random load with arbitrary probability density function and the static security assessment considering uncertainty is referable for the expansion planning of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Monthly Power Market Bidding Optimal Strategy Considering Carbon Trading Risks
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of the national carbon trading market, the bidding strategy of Independent Power Producer (IPP) considering carbon trading is paid more and more attention. In the carbon trading market., IPP would face the risk of uncertainty of carbon trading prices. Using the principle of risk management theory in financial field., this paper presents conditional value at risk in carbon trading market (CRM-CVaR). Based on this risk measurement index., IPP monthly bidding optimal mathematics model is established. Simulation cases compare IPP bidding optimal strategy considering CRM-CVaR with non considering this index. Meanwhile., IPP comprehensive income entropy index is defined to measure the uniformity of the distribution of the IPP total revenue. It is shown by the numerical results that the algorithm is effective and can give IPP valuable bidding strategy.

articleTitle: Application of Photovoltaic Uninterruptible Power Supply System In Distribution Network Communication Station
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The communication devices in distribution station are important equipment to ensure the normal operation of the power distribution equipment and communication signal system. The power is sent out by the power plant, and it's transformed into substation after step by step, then it's redistributed to each distribution station. And the power voltage in the distribution site is generally 10KV. Generally, the large-scale three-remote distribution station has the function of providing power for communication devices, but the small-scale two-remote distribution station can't provide power supply for communication devices directly. So devices such as transformers are needed to provide power supply for communication devices. But the transformers are big in volume and high in cost, so this paper uses uninterrupted solar power supply system to solve the DC power supply problem of distribution network communication stations.

articleTitle: Complementary Operation Analysis of Hydro and Wind Power in Yunnan Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To promote the orderly development and full utilization of hydro and wind power under the market competition circumstances, this paper presents an analysis study conducted on the complementary operation characteristic of hydro and wind power in Yunnan electricity market. First, the features of hydro and wind power resources in Yunnan are described. Then, according to the power source structure and supply and demand situation in Yunnan electricity market, hydro and wind power output characteristic, wind power generation cluster effect, complementary operation characteristic of hydro and wind power as well as the problems of renewable energies integration and development planning are further studied. The result of the analysis study not only demonstrates that hydro and wind power have considerable complementarities annually and monthly and joint operation could smooth the wind power output for the power grid to promote the renewable energies integration, but offers consults for electricity industry restructuring and market reform, power grid planning and operation, and the coordinated development of power producers and grids as well.

articleTitle: Robust Energy Efficiency Optimization for Coordinated Transmission with Transceiver Impairments in Private TD-LTE Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Private TD-LTE Wireless Network has been widely utilized in power distribution communication due to its benefits of ease deployment and flexible coverage. Since the dedicated spectrum bandwidth for private TD-LTE network is extremely limited, coordinated transmission is often carried out to enhance system throughput. This paper studies the adverse impacts of transceiver impairments on the performance of coordinated transmission from the perspective of channel estimation and signal transceiver process. A robust optimization scheme utilizing Lagrange Multiplier method is then proposed to maximize the worst energy efficiency caused by the channel estimate error and signal distortion due to transceiver impairments. Simulations are conducted and the results verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Study on Thermal Overheating Faults of Electrical Equipment Connector Based on Thermal Balance Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Taking the bus bar joint as an example, this paper analyzes the sources and influencing factors of the temperature rise of the electrical equipment joints. The main factors of heat generation are heat generated by current through contact resistance and sunshine heating. The heat dissipation channels include radiation heat dissipation, convection heat dissipation, and conduction heat dissipation. This paper establishes a balance equation between heat production and heat dissipation. A thermal experiment is designed, and the relation equation between bus plate joint heating and operation environment is deduced based on the experimental results. It is proposed that when the operating conditions and the environment are different, the key point for determining the detailed quantitative relationship between the temperature of the electrical equipment joints and each influencing factor is to determine the α coefficient and ε coefficient of the operating environment. Based on these values, the contact resistance of the joint can be calculated and used to evaluate the status of the electrical equipment joints.

articleTitle: Researchon VoltageStabilityofActiveDistribution NetworkwithDistributed Generations
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of static voltage stability caused by distributed generation access to distribution network, this paper mainly investigates the voltage stability of active distribution network including distribution network. To reflect system voltage stability of each node, a voltage stability index method is firstly proposed according to the results of power flow calculation for the whole distribution network to. Considering distributed generation as a negative load direct injection, different models of distributed generation in power flow calculation are then established. Finally, taking the typical wind power of distributed generation for example, active distribution network of IEEE-33 nodes is simulated. The influence of different fan efforts, fan access position and active power fluctuation on voltage stability of active power distribution system is analyzed in detail. The simulation results show that distributed network with distributed generation can effectively improve the voltage stability.

articleTitle: Interharmonic Detection Based on Iterative Spectrum Estimation and SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The interharmonic problem is a new focus in the research field of power quality. It is not an integer multiple of fundamental and usually with small amplitude. In terms of these identities, a new method of interharmoic detection based on iterative spectrum estimation method with variable frequency resolution combined with support vector machine (SVM) is presented in this paper. Compared with transitional FFT, higher frequency resolution can be obtained by the proposed approach during the same sampling time. Moreover the iterative method has no problems with spectral leakage, so the frequencies detected don't need to be modified in the asynchronous sampling case. Combined with the above method, amplitudes and phases of interharmonics can be estimated with SVM method in a shorter calculating time after frequency precalculating accurately. The simulation with Matlab validates the approach proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromagnetic Influence Between High-voltage AC Transmission Lines and Buried Oil and Gas Pipelines(May 2018)
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper also give some suggestions for the protection of electromagnetic influence. This paper shows computational analysis and evaluation methods of AC corrosion influence between high-voltage ac transmission lines and buried oil and gas pipelines. CDEGS simulation analysis is carried out on the engineering project which involve overhead 500kV and several 220kV AC transmission lines nearby buried oil and gas pipelines. The results shows different changes of disturbance voltage on nearby pipelines before and after the construction of 500kV AC transmission. This paper also give some suggestions for the protection of electromagnetic influence.

articleTitle: An Impedance Reshaping Control Strategy to Enhance Adaptability to Grid for Grid-Connected Inverters
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the distributed generation accessing to power grid in high proportion, multi-level transformers and long-distance transmission lines lead to larger equivalent impedance at the grid side, so the grid gradually shows the weak grid characteristics. Under this condition, grid-connected inverters prone to resonance or instability. This paper investigates the influence of grid impedance on the stability of grid-connected system based on impedance analysis method, and it is revealed that the essential reason for the resonance of the grid-connected system is the lack of phase margin, which easily triggers that the harmonic component at the impedance crossover frequency is amplified sharply and output current has a serious distortion. Aiming at this issue, an impedance reshaping control strategy is proposed to compensate the phase margin of the system, thereby improving the robustness of the grid-connected inverter to a wide range of varying grid impedance and ensuring the inverter operate stably. This approach relies on the grid voltage feed-forward control, which can achieve series correction to output impedance by choosing a appropriate feedforward function. Due to the lead correction with leading phase characteristics, it can increase the phase of the inverter impedance, and then increasing the stability margin of grid-connected system. In order to maximize the compensation of lead correction to the phase, the minimum phase margin of the grid-connected system with minimum short-circuit ratio is calculated, and specific design process and parameter selection method are given to make the phase margin meet the requirements of stable operation. Unlike the existing approach, the proposed scheme does not need to detect the real-time grid impedance to complete the phase margin compensation, therefore, it overcomes the shortcomings that the traditional solution is difficult to achieve the expected compensation effect owing to the inaccurate measurement result of the grid impedance. Moreover, the proposed controller has the advantage of facile realization and low cost. Finally, a 10-kW inverter simulation model is built in the Matlab / Simulink. Simulation results show that the inverter before adoping impedance reshaping control strategy lose instability in the weak grid, while the inverter after adoping impedance reshaping control kept stable and has a good current wave. Simulation results verify the validity and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Reactive Power Optimization Based on Improved Artificial Searching Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of multi-objective reactive power optimization, firstly the defects of current algorithms are analyzed, then an improved chaos artificial searching swarm algorithm based on artificial search is proposed. The optimization performance of the algorithm is improved by introducing chaos theory and the dynamic improvement of algorithm step. This algorithm was tested with classical test functions. The results show that the optimization ability of the artificial search swarm algorithm is significantly improved. In the MATLAB 2014b environment, ICASSA is used to optimize the simulation of the IEEE14 and IEEE30 buses of the standard power system. Comparing the performance of ICASSA, IPSO and IDE, the results show the ICASSA has better search ability. Finally, the reactive power optimization of a real power network is simulated, and the results show that the ICASSA algorithm has potential application value.

articleTitle: Method for Suppressing Neutral Point Displacement Overvoltage and Suppression Circuit in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Neutral displacement overvoltage is harmful to power equipment. A method for suppressing the neutral point displacement overvoltage and its suppression circuit were proposed in this paper to restore it to a normal level. First, it is judged if the neutral point displacement voltage is greater than the set value. Next, the previous and current currents on the arc suppression coil are measured. Then, current is injected at the neutral point of the grid. Finally, it is judged whether the zero-sequence overvoltage of the distribution network is successfully suppressed. The feasibility of the suppression method and the suppression circuit proposed in this paper was proved by the experimental results. This method is great significance for suppressing the displacement overvoltage of the neutral point of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Parameter Tuning of UPFC Supplementary Damping Controller Considering Communication Latency
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: UPFC (unified power flow controller) can control bus voltage, line flow and enhance system dynamic stability using different controlling strategies. Its supplementary damping controller may exert great importance to system dynamic stability. Firstly, this paper adds UPFC into the system linearized model and applies DTA (damping torque analysis) to UPFC analysis and deduces the DTA sensitivity. On this basis, the DTA model considering time-delay is obtained according to the frequency domain model of time-delay, which can be applied to UPFC supplementary controller parameter tuning combined with the phase compensation method. Finally, validity and feasibility of the proposed model are demonstrated in two practical cases. Simulation results indicate the method could inhibit oscillations effectively and improve system stability.

articleTitle: Study on Holographic Model and Key Factors Identification for Distribution Transformer Supplier
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution transformer (DT) is one of the key equipment in the power system. Its quality is directly related to the continuous and stable operation of the power system. At present, the distribution transformer manufacturing industry is overcapacity. The quality of distribution transformers is different strictly. It has great significance to research and set up evaluation models of DT suppliers, which is helpful to the purchase of high-quality equipment and ensuring the safe and economical operation of the distribution grid. With the continuous development of information and communication technology, the power companies have launched an electronic bidding procurement, which improves the procurement efficiency and quality. For DT suppliers, their own information is the basis for evaluation and selection, which has been accumulated on the electronic tendering platform by the form of online data. If the relevant data could be further excavated through the Internet technology, the created value could strongly promote the realization of the scientific and intelligent procurement mode. Based on the situation above, the holographic model for DT suppliers is constructed by the combination of subjective and objective theoretical methods. The experts experience method and PCA method is used to identify and select the key factors, which could reflect the basic conditions and abilities of DT suppliers comprehensively and quantitatively in all aspects. In this stage, indexes of 3 grades are established, containing the aspects of DT supplier's information on qualification, credit, manufacturing, products, etc. Then the AHP method is used to determine the weight of the chosen indexes, so as to make the holographic model have the function of scoring for DT suppliers. The holographic model can be used in scoring for bidding and classification of the different DT suppliers. The construction of the model has made a progress on the combination of large data and Internet application with the bidding and purchasing business, and helps to choose the suitable suppliers and products more objectively. However, the holographic model needs to be improved as the requirements change and development of the Internet technology.

articleTitle: FMPC-VMD Based Control Strategy for Tracking Generation Plans of Multi-type Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To take full advantage of the complementary nature of multi-type energy storage and maximally increase the capability of tracking the scheduled PV power output, a charging-discharging control strategy combining Fuzzy-Model Predictive Control (FMPC) and Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) for a energy storage system (ESS) is proposed. Firstly, the total energy storage load can be obtained based on FMPC algorithm. Then, power allocation between multi-type power storage is achieved with VMD. A simulation analysis, taking a typical PV output as an actual data sample, showed that the proposed FMPC-VMD control method for the multi-type BESS is uniquely flexible and adaptable in achieving the control effect of improving the capability of tracking the scheduled PV power output.

articleTitle: An Investment Decision Model of Distribution Network Planning Based on Correlation Mining of Reconstruction Measures and Performance Indexes
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, how to build a reliable, high efficient, high-tech and environmental friendly distribution network infrastructure has great theoretical and practical significance. In this paper, based on the sample data, the correlation mining method is applied to analyze the relationship between different types of reconstruction measures and performance indexes. Through the comparison of different performance indexes of reconstruction measures, the optimal measures can be chosen, and the accurate investment decision model can be built. Experimental result shows the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Failure in Temperature-Rise Test of 10kV Three-Phase Oil-Immersed Amorphous Alloy Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper provides the statistical results of 10kV three-phase oil-immersed amorphous alloy transformer sampling inspection of last year. Main unqualified test items are listed and two cases of failing in temperature rise test are analyzed. Then some management control measures are provided to improve product quality and manufacturing standards. This is of great importance in improving the quality of equipment which would be accessed into the grid and maintaining the long-period safe and stable operation of distribute network.

Author Keywords: safe and stable operation of distribute network

articleTitle: Research on Communication Network Access Solution of Smart Home Energy Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper describes the communication technology used in the smart home energy monitoring system from two aspects. On the one hand, users can realize two-way interaction of electricity through the company communication network; On the other hand, the real-time monitoring of smart home can be realized through the telecom operator network and the home domain ZigBee network. This paper focuses on the technical characteristics of ZigBee and networking application of Internet of things in home domain.

articleTitle: Role and Inspiration of Legal and Policy in the Development of U.S. Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the deepening of the electricity marketization process, competition in the electricity market has been intensified, new relations and new issues between different market subjects will surely emerge, thus corresponding legal system will be needed to consolidate and standardize the operation of the market. This paper combing with the U.S. electricity marketing process, taking key laws and orders, electricity market structure and specific electricity market rules as research objects, the relationship between the development of electricity market and the construction of the legal system are analyzed in this paper. Base on the reformation of China's electricity market, the paper puts forward some suggestions on the legal framework of the China's electricity market.

articleTitle: Study on Default Risk Identification and Coping Strategy for Contracts of Grid Materials under The Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: By classifying and summarizing the historical data of material purchasing by power grid enterprises and referring to the price of key raw materials and important components, this paper offers a dynamic simulation of the typical material purchasing costs, focuses on the material contracts with supply price lower than or close to the dynamic cost price and carries out risk identification and early warning. The linkage mechanism between power supply purchasing costs and market price is established in this paper to achieve updating and matching, enhance material purchasing flexibility and responsiveness of market price change, reduce default risk of material contract and promote the sound development of power supply purchasing market.

articleTitle: Development of a FPGA-based Protective Relay in Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Integration of distributed electric resources in distribution network brings many challenges in protection. In this paper, we develop a FPGA-based protective relay suitable for active distribution networks. The overall scheme design and implementation details of the relay are described. The relay is implemented on Xilinx Spartan-6 FPGA programmed in Verilog HDL. To enhance real-time, FPGA parallel processes SV and GOOSE conforming to IEC61850 standard, with which the relay will become smarter to meet the requirement of active distribution networks. The relay simultaneously realizes such functions by FPGA: analog-to-digital converting, digital filter and voltage & current measurement, communication and protection functions. The effectiveness of the proposed design is verified by a closed-loop test method. Compared to DSP-based protective relay, the proposed design is a more cost-effective solution.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Transfer of Active Distribution Network Based on Prediction Information
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the high penetration of distributed energy resource (DER), we can realize load transfer by changing switches' states when there is a fault. The computational efficiency can be improved sharply by improved greedy algorithm to “eat load”. According to load, photovoltaic power generation and wind power generation prediction information, we can early estimate distribution network state to adjust load transfer solution. The minimum energy loss is set the goal in this paper and, combined with distribution network radial constraints, power flow constraints and output constraints of DERs, dynamic load transfer solution is obtained during fault period. The effectiveness and reliability of dynamic load transfer algorithm is verified by theoretical analysis and simulation.

articleTitle: A New Design Method for (6k±1)-Order Repetitive Control Used in Harmonic Current Source
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Repetitive control (RC) method can improve the tracking precision compared with traditional controller, However, the internal model structure determines that the dynamic response of RC will have a fundamental time delay T0. To improve the response speed of traditional RC controller, (6k±1)-order RC structure is used in control which can reduce the data memory and improve the tracking speed, but the new structure will inevitably increase the difficulty of the stability judgement. In this paper, a new design method is proposed for the parameter design of (6k±1)-order RC strategy, simulation and experiments of (6k±1)-order method is performed inharmonic current source (HCS), which shows the validity and advantages of the proposed new design method.

articleTitle: Load Cluster Management Considering Response Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The elastic load on demand side can change with the fluctuation electricity price, so it could be modeled as the adjustable load cluster and involved into power dispatching with traditional generation unit, which can improve the flexibility of the power system. Due to the influence of various factors, such as the response to electricity price is not timely, signal transmission delay, the user's habits is difficult to be changed, and the response amount and expected value always exist in a certain range of deviation. In this paper, the value at risk (VaR) is used to measure the risk loss caused by the uncertainty of the load cluster response, then VaR is introduced as a loss measure to participate in the optimization of the power dispatching model and establish a joint scheduling model. Through the actual example analysis, the results show that, due to the risk loss of the adjustable load cluster is considered, the risk loss caused by uncertainty response is reduced. The research has practical application prospect to the implementation of DSM projects.

articleTitle: Suppression Measures of Insulator Flashover Caused by Haze Flashover
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Fog haze weather frequently appears in recent years. Fog haze not only makes the travel inconvenient, also has a harmful effect on body. Fog haze brings serious security hidden danger to the power grid safety and power equipment operation. The lightest situation is shortening the time of saturated salt density, and pollution accident is the heaviest situation caused power equipment. The concept of haze flashover, haze and PM2.5 is explained, and the harm and source of haze are expounded. At the same time, the mechanism of haze flashover and the measures to restrain haze flashover are discussed. It is pointed out that the best method to prevent haze flashover is dry ice cleaning, and dry ice cleaning is the implementation technology to ensure the safe operation of power equipment in the future, which has a wide application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Investment Strategies of Urban Integrated Energy System for Different Operating Modes
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As an important part of the energy internet, the energy production and consumption under the framework of urban integrated energy system tend to be market-oriented. The participants satisfying certain conditions can participate in various forms of energy production, marketing, or consumption. First of all, this paper analyzes the forms of participation of all stakeholders in urban integrated energy system, and constructs several typical operation plans of urban integrated energy system. Then, based on the cost and the price of the existing energy, the value flow model of the urban integrated energy system is set up under the typical scene. The cost-benefit analysis of each stakeholder in typical operation mode is compared and analyzed, which provides reference for each participant in the investment strategies and profit model of urban energy internet.

articleTitle: Resonance Analysis of Small Current Grounding System in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, there are a large number of arc suppression coil grounding mode in the low-voltage distribution network for the equipment insulation and power supply reliability considerations. The role of arc suppression coil grounding mode is when the grid single-phase ground fault occurs, arc suppression coil will provide inductor current to compensate the capacitor current. It is conducive to prevent the arc-reignition, to achieve the purpose of arc extinguishing, which will reduce the high amplitude over-voltage probability, to preventing further expansion of the accident. Engineering is generally used the overcompensation method for the way to prevent the occurrence of resonance phenomenon. But, the capacitive current data used in the overcompensation method of the engineering are generally designed to be estimated based on recent or long-term loads and current equipment conditions. In the following years of substation operation, due to the rapid increase in load, the rapid expansion of the transmission line, the actual capacitor current is often quite different with the originally estimated one. Especially for large-scale urban distribution network with large number of cable or large-scale overhead lines to transform the cable, the design of the over-compensation mode of operation may no longer be established, become fully compensated or even under-compensation. Several obvious voltage waveform distortion of the actual distribution network is analyzed in this paper. The resonant energy spectrum of each phase is analyzed by MATLAB, and it is pointed out that the resonance of the voltage waveform is caused by the resonance of the zero sequence circuit. And use RTDS simulation system to modeling and analysis this situation. The simulation results are in good agreement with the actual waveforms, which will verified that the results of this paper are correct.

articleTitle: Analysis on Amplitude Frequency Characteristics of GIS Shell TEV in Substation with HRPC
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of ultra-high voltage transmission technology, the Hybrid Reactive Power Compensation method (HRPC) which utilizes series compensation and controllable high resistance can be widely used. Therefore, the study on the influence of HRPC on GIS shell' s TEV is significant. Based on simplified equivalent model of GIS shell grounding, the simulation analysis of the TEV waveform and frequency characteristics before and after the installation of HRPC are carried out. In both conditions of grounding that HRPC and GIS are connected to some and different grounding grids, the relationship between the amplitude of the TEV main frequency oscillation and the installation position of the HRPC are analyzed, Besides, the influence of the SCSR entrance capacitor and the series compensation capacitance on the corresponding amplitude of the TEV main frequency is analyzed as well. The results show that, compared with the case of non HRPC, the TEV oscillation of the GIS is more severe after the installation of HRPC, the peak value of TEV does not change notably, and the amplitude of the TEV main frequency has been greatly improved. With the increase of the distance between HRPC and GIS, the amplitude of the TEV main frequency decreases. The TEV main frequency amplitude increases with the equivalent capacitance of SCSR, and does not change with the variation of the earth capacitance.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch Model of Interruptible Loads Based on Scenario Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposed an optimal dispatch model based on the scenario analysis which considered interruptible load. Scenario analysis can not only reflect the uncertainty in the operation of power system, but also the dispatch decisions which is time-varying. This paper has made a brief summary of the methods of scenario generation, scenario reduction and scenario tree generation. Besides, the operation constraints of interruptible loads were mainly studied, such as the reduction amount, the interrupt duration, the interrupt frequency and the advance notification time. The comparison between interruptible loads and conventional unit shows that the interruptible loads can be treated as virtual power plants. The optimal dispatch model was established and studied in case, and the case study shows that the optimal dispatch model can effectively handle the uncertainty in the system operation.

articleTitle: Optimal Monitoring Allocation by Considering Voltage Sags Locating and Disturbance Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents a bi-level optimal allocation for voltage-sag monitors with the consideration of fault locating and disturbance tolerance ability. In the first level, a binary linear programming model is proposed for both symmetrical and asymmetrical faults. A binary gravity search algorithm (BGSA) is applied for solving the binary optimization problem. In the second level, to select the optimal allocation among all feasible solutions, the disturbance tolerance ability is modeled and quantified based on fuzzy inference. Allocation-level disturbance tolerance indexes are then obtained to determine the ultimate monitoring allocation. The IEEE 39-bus test system is used for the validation of proposed method.

articleTitle: Identification of Erroneous Network Parameters Using SCADA Measurements
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The accurate value of the network parameters is essential for power system monitoring and control center. This paper proposes a method for estimating the erroneous parameters with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition(SCADA) measurements only. First, the suspicious branch is taken as the center to form a local power network. Then, the parameters are regarded as state vector. According to the type of the branch, the Jacobian matrix of parameters are calculated from the corresponding power flow equation. Finally, a fixed-point iteration process is established to work out the estimated value of the suspicious parameter. In addition, the reliable parameters in the local area is added as the pseudo measurement to the measurement equations, which improves the redundancy of measurement. The effectiveness of the proposed method is tested in the IEEE 118-bus system.

articleTitle: Research on Bilateral Games Between Electric Generations and Sale Sides With Incomplete Information
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the deepening of the electric power system reform, electricity market has attracted attentions from both academic and industrial societies. In this paper, a bilateral game model with incomplete information between the electricity generation and selling enterprises is established, which considers the direct electricity purchase prices and amount as the strategy sets of the both sides. In order to forecast the direct electricity purchase prices, the factor of generation costs is introduced, which uses the co-integration theory to construct the relation between the direct electricity purchase prices and the generation costs. Furthermore, to forecast the direct electricity purchase amount, the similar days method is adopted to ensure the information sharing demand between both sides. Finally, the equilibrium solution of the bilateral game is obtained by using Nash equilibrium, and the model has been proved by simulation.

articleTitle: Cooperative Fault Isolation Technology for Relay Protection and Distribution Automation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To improve the ability of fault handling in distribution networks, a coordinated fault isolation technique for relay protection and distribution automation was proposed. The configuration principles of relay protection and distribution automation co-processing distribution network faults is given, and the process of fault handling is analyzed. When the trunk line fails, the relay protection operates at the specified time, and then the distribution automation further optimizes and corrects it, so that the fault isolation is in the minimum range; the branch line fault relay protection can be completed, and the two do not affect each other. The static simulation system test shows that the co-operation fault isolation scheme of relay protection and distribution automation is feasible and isolates the fault area in the shortest time. Relay protection and distribution automation have significantly improved power supply reliability.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis on energy consumption of AC miniature circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to study contact energy loss of AC miniature circuit breaker(AC-MCB), simulation model of the 3-D contact energy consumption was established. The applied excitation was based on measured current data. At the connected state, simulation complete cycle and incomplete cycle energy consumption value was simulated and calculated, and power loss density color map in the specific time was given. The arcing was made into equivalent resistance of the contacts breaking process, and the model of arc column was setted up, the power loss density color maps of arcing state was given in the specific time and energy loss values of contact breaking process was calculated. At last, the simulation results were analyzed, providing theoretical support and technical support of product structure and materials optimization.

articleTitle: Enterprise Electric Energy Efficiency Evaluation based on AHP-Fuzzy Method
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Energy serves as the basis of social development. China's economy faces resource shortage and environmental pollution while growing rapidly. China's industrial energy consumption accounts for 70% of the total energy consumption, while this figure in developed countries is merely 33% or so. Hence, it is imperative to research into enterprises' electric energy efficiency and emission reduction measures. This paper starts from the perspective of users' energy consumption and builds a corporate user's electric energy efficiency evaluation system based on the characteristics of typical industry power use. It proposes 5 primary indicators (power quality, equipment management, production management, economic electric energy efficiency and environmental impact) from the perspectives of development quality and external coordination, which are further divided into 21 sub-indicators. Then, a multi-attribute network-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to comprehensively evaluate the electric energy efficiency of enterprises. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the evaluation method is verified with the case of a port company, and proposals for improving electric energy efficiency are offered accordingly.

articleTitle: Portfolio Purchasing Optimization Model Based on Skewness-CVaR for Electricity Retailers Under Peak - Valley Prices
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In a multi-market environment, electricity retailers need to allocate the proportion of electricity purchased from the contract market, the day-ahead market and the real-time market in order to reduce risks and increase profits. This article considers the implementation of peak-valley prices on the side of power sales, studies the income space of electricity procurement and sale for electricity retailers, and uses CVaR to quantify the losses that electricity retailers may suffer; since CVaR mainly reflects the size of losses, it cannot adjust the proportion of power purchases in various markets to increase the income from electricity retailers; therefore, under the condition of satisfying CVaR, the skewness constraint is introduced into the portfolio purchasing optimization model, this article adjusts the proportion of electricity purchased in each market by controlling the degree of skewness, so as to control the return of electricity retailers, the greater the skewness, the lower the probability of a low rate of income and the greater the probability of a high rate of income; this article takes the maximization of the income of electricity retailers as a target function, the skewness-CVaR based portfolio purchasing optimization model for electricity retailers under peak - valley prices is established. The example results show that this model provides new risk measurement indicators and power purchase plans for electricity retailers.

articleTitle: Fault Modeling and Simulation Based on Cyber Physical System in Complex Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the high penetration of renewable energy in distribution network and the gradual improvement of smart grid construction, the physical processing and information processing are closely coupled. Complex distribution network is a typical cyber physical system(CPS). The sequential property of electric power system and the time-discrete property of communication system have made the research of CPS for distribution network complicated. In view of dynamic process of CPS for distribution network, the fusion modeling and large-scale simulation calculation and platform of CPS for distribution network were investigated. First, the characteristics and the interaction principle of CPS for distribution network were analyzed. And the coupling mode of CPS for distribution network was proposed. Next, the simulation model of physical system was proposed. From different information data types, information data flow was modeled. On this basis, a framework for integration of multiple cyber physical modules was constructed. And CPS fusion method was proposed. Taking the simulation platform of CPS for distribution network as example, characteristics of RT-LAB as the physical simulation tool, and OPNET as the information simulation tool were analyzed. And the feasibility of co-simulation of RT-LAB and OPNET was elaborated. Finally, a fast simulation framework based on RT-LAB was established. And a cooperative simulation for electrical power system and control system was proposed. Based on the essential difference between physical events and information events, two kinds of simulation timing synchronization methods suitable for physical model and information model were presented. A 62-nodes distribution network with distributed generators of an area was modeled on RT-LAB. The simulation results of CPS platform based on RT-LAB and OPNET show that when a single-phase fault occurs in a complex distribution network, communication problems such as congestion delays and error codes of information system in the transmission of measurement data and control instruction cause failures to be dealt with in time delay to trigger a cascading fault. The results effectively verified the importance of control information system to monitor distribution network. At the same time, the CPS simulation platform for the actual environment of complex distribution network is necessary.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Stability of Distribution Network by Modeling and Simulation of Distributed Photovoltaic Power
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Photovoltaic power is being widely connected to distribution network. However, a large number of grid-connected PV systems would change the direction of power flow. Based on practical engineering requirement, different aspects of the typical bipolar photovoltaic power system has been researched to build the math models of different complexity. In this paper, different aspects of the typical bipolar photovoltaic power system has been researched, including photovoltaic cell model, chopper model, inverter model, filter model and the controller model. Based on the integration of different models, the accurate model of PV is proposed. Finally, through Matlab, these models of different orders are simulated and analyzed in order to verify their correctness in the situation of voltage sag. Besides, the characteristics of PV cluster model is been summarized. For the large and complex PV cluster, the Strategy of multi-model-switching simulation is put forward. Based on these simplified methods, an important index is proposed for measuring the stability of photovoltaic power system after accessing large quantities of power grids.

articleTitle: A Novel Measuring Method of Capacitance to Ground in Resonant Grounding System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to accurately and effectively realize the arc-suppression coil tuning, it is urgent to improve the measuring accuracy of the capacitance to ground in resonant grounding system. Because the existing measuring method does not consider the damping resistance which is connected in the grounding loop of arc-suppression coil, a novel measuring method of capacitance to ground in resonant grounding system was proposed in this paper. First, a variable-frequency current signal is injected into the system by the zero-sequence voltage transformer of the distribution network. Then the returned voltage signal will be measured by the voltage transformer inside the arc-suppression coil. After establishing the variable-frequency equivalent circuit which considers the damping resistance, the capacitance to ground can be calculated accurately. Finally, the effectiveness of this method was proved by the PSCAD/EMTDC, which showed that this method has high precision, which eliminates the negative influence of damping resistance.

articleTitle: Process Management for Distribution Networks' Graph Modification Tasks in PMS 2.0 System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, distribution companies have employed specialized software such as PMS 2.0 for the network components and asset management. PMS 2.0 has been widely adopted for the power grids in most cities of China with the great promotion of State Grid. Because of the heavy construction and operation tasks in distribution networks, the changes in reality need to be exactly reflected in the graphical interfaces of PMS 2.0 in time. The correct and up-to-date graphical interfaces can give full assistance for distribution network operation and maintenance. However, the distribution networks' graph modification tasks cannot always keeping up with the operation and construction on the real networks, because of miscommunication among departments, slow auditing procedures and plan adjustments. Thus, this paper tries to introduce the process management theories to distribution networks' graph modification tasks in PMS 2.0 system. The whole processes of the graph modification tasks have been identified and the key processes resulted in delay release have also been carefully discussed. Then, this paper reconstructs the processes for the graph modification and gives correction proposal to improve the key processes. The process management has been applied to practice and achieved good results.

articleTitle: Research on optimized purchasing strategy and risk management in electricity market
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper discussed the optimized purchasing strategy and risk management in different electricity market based on Markowitz portfolio theory and Value at Risk (VaR). The simulation results show that this model is correct and valuable. We provide a method of improving upon the Markowitz portfolio using value at risk as the decision-making criteria for distribution system operator in deregulated electricity market.

articleTitle: Construction and Management of Online 3D Training Studio
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Nowadays new generation of information and telecommunication technologies including mobile Internet and smart technology are developing quickly and becoming a powerful tool to promote the transformation of smart enterprises. In view of the limitations of training form, innovation, efficiency, brand construction and other aspects of the real training studio, State Grid Zhejiang Electric Power Co.,ltd. constructed 3D (VR) online training studio which introduced VR technology, WebGL technology, RFID radio frequency identification technology and automatic roaming routing algorithm technology.
