The reactive power adjustment ability is established to establish the voltage coordination optimization model of the distribution network. Thirdly, the chaotic particle swarm optimization algorithm based on particle dimension entropy and greedy strategy is proposed to solve the model. Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Grid-Connected Photovoltaic System Based on Tapped-Inductor Quasi-Z-Source Inverter and Its Low Voltage Ride-Through Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Compared with traditional Z-source and quasi-Z-source inverter, tapped-inductor quasi-Z-source inverter (TL-qZSI) has higher booster multiple, lower capacitance stress and higher conversion efficiency. Therefore, it is very suitable for grid-connected photovoltaic power generation system. This paper analyzes the voltage boosting theory of the TL-qZSI and applies it into grid-connected photovoltaic power generation system. For the imbalanced power grid voltage sag situation, this paper puts forward a low voltage ride-through (LVRT) control strategy. System realizes the unity power factor running and has a good LVRT ability under imbalanced power grid voltage sag. At last, the simulation and experimental results are shown to verify the correctness of the control method.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Evaluation of Urban Transmission Security Margin Considering Flexible HVDN Topological Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The integration of the large-scale wind farm and the growing amount of the electric vehicles deteriorate the unbalanced urban load distribution, which increases the operation risk, especially during the peak load time. In order to enlarge the transmission security margin, the operators usually resort to switching the main and reserve lines in high voltage distribution network (HVDN) to transfer the loads. Besides, the uncertainty output of the wind farm also expands or shrinks the security margin. In an attempt to assess this resilient security margin appropriately, a probabilistic evaluation model based on the three-point estimate method and Cornish-Fisher expansion were established. In addition, the Resilient Steady State Distance (RSSD) index was defined to describe the current Resilient Security Margin (RSM). And the influence of the flexible HVDN topological structure was also detailed in the paper. Simulation results showed that the proposed evaluation model can achieve the resilient probabilistic evaluation of the urban transmission network security margin and provide reliable indicators for operational decision making.

articleTitle: Influence Factors Analysis and Optimization of Forces on T-type Cable Joint in Ring Main Unit
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to advantages such as simple structure, small volume, low cost of purchasing and maintenance, Ring Main Unit (RMU) has been widely used in distribution network. However, According to the defect statistics of Guangzhou power grid, numerous cases indicate that excessive forces caused by non-standard installation transferring from T -type Cable Joint to bush can lead to fracture and seal failure, further insulation fault, which significantly reduce equipment and system reliability. In recent years, Studies on installation process' impact on stress of RMU bushes are mainly based on maintenance experience, quantitative analysis with numerical simulation and experiment are barely performed. In this paper, three-dimensional mechanical model based on Finite Element Method (FEM) is built, and influence law of various factors on force in RMU bushes are analyzed. Meanwhile, buckling test device is set up and force in RMU bushes influenced by different factors such as overlengthen cable is measured, the experiment data shows the same trend as the simulation result. What's more, optimal height and interphase distance of RMU bushes is obtained with calculation. Research results of this paper have important guiding significance for T-type cable joint installation process and RMU cable cabinet structure design.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Transactional Energy Minimization Method Based on Market-Based Control
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to coordinate and control all kinds of distributed energy in distribution network more effectively and adapt to the core concept of active distribution network, an active distribution network transactional energy minimization method based on market-based control is proposed. Firstly, combining the idea of market-based control with the characteristics of various distributed energy sources in the active distribution network, a market control-based distribution network transactional energy minimization method is proposed. Then, considering the uncertainty factors of renewable energy consumption and active load and the differences between different subjects in distribution network, energy bidding models of distributed energy, adjustable load and energy storage system are established respectively. Moreover, a distribution network energy trading model is established, which realizes the optimization of distribution network energy and the balance of power supply and demand. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the energy minimization method in blocking management of distribution network, increasing the consumption rate of renewable energy and economy.

Author Keywords: Balance of power supply and demand

articleTitle: Analysis of Insulation Aging Performance of Medium Voltage Crosslinked Polyethylene Cable During Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to explore the characteristics of insulation aging changes of medium voltage cross-linked polyethylene cables after running for a period of time, the dielectric loss of 35 kV cable insulation with new cable and actual operating life of la, 3a, 5a, 7a, 10a was studied. Axial slicing was performed on the inside and outside of the cable with different operating years. A flat sample with a surface of 1 mm thickness was prepared and tested. The experimental results show that the low frequency dielectric loss factor of XLPE correlates with the aging degree. When the frequency is below 0.1 Hz, the tangent of dielectric loss angle shows a linear upward trend with the aging degree. The outer dielectric loss of the actual running cable insulation is greater than the inner side, indicating that environmental factors may be the main cause of insulation aging of the running cable. The detection of dielectric loss can evaluate the external environment of the running cable, the main insulation aging cause, and the aging degree. It is a simple and effective method suitable for practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Optimization of Grid - Connected Wind - Storage Capacity Based on Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Grid-connected wind power will bring a series of interference to the power system. How to allocate the wind-storage capacity reasonably in the grid-connected wind-storage power generation system, so as to reduce the power fluctuation, is the key link in the design of wind -storage power generation system. The wind and storage power are modeled jointly. We adopt the adaptive genetic algorithm, and the improved charging and discharging strategy of energy storage device. Taking the number of fans and batteries as the decision variables, and the probability of fluctuation over limit as the objective function, considering of battery charge and discharge as constraint function, we can quickly get the capacity configuration, and a year of real-time wind power data shows that the program feasible.

Author Keywords: the probability of fluctuation over limit

articleTitle: Research on Power Supply Voltage Regulation of Large Users Adapting to Doing Business Promotion in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper focuses on the analysis of voltage regulation of large users in Shanghai under the new circumstance of Doing Business. Through the comparison of current regulation rules of power supply voltage for large users in other foreign and domestic cities, the primary optimal strategy to promote Doing Business has been raised. Focused on the users with the capacity from 8MVA to 40MVA, the sensitivity analysis with the adjustment of capacity limit has been fully studied. Taking the limit capacity for 10kV users as a typical case, the influence of increasing the upper limit have been considered from the utility, users and the whole society perspectives. Along with the technical-economical evaluation, the paper finally proposes a practical optimal strategy of users voltage regulation, to advance a mutually beneficial and win-win situation of entire society.

articleTitle: Research on distribution terminal software version control method based on DNA coding
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The distribution terminal software version controlled is important to the stable operation and observability of the distribution network, and there is a lack of effective supervision methods at present. This paper studies and implements a software version control method for distribution terminal, through analyzing the influence factors of executable file attributes, a priority factor matching model is constructed. By selecting two isomeric hash algorithms and using combinatorial fault safety thought, the collision probability is effectively reduced while the efficiency is guaranteed. Combined with the technology of random sequence and segmentation rotation rank, it extracts the DNA coding string which only represents the distribution terminal software identity, and realizes the effective and feasible identification, archiving and detection control process for the terminal software. The practical application shows that the method can effectively control the software version of the delivery terminal, avoid misoperation and human tampering, and the process is simple and reliable.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Flow Analysis of Power System for Petrochemical Enterprises Based on the Interior Point Method and PSASP
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electricity consumption accounts for about 20% to 30% of total energy consumption in a petrochemical enterprise. The optimal power flow analysis can guide electricity workers to optimize the operation mode of the enterprise power network, reduce the power loss and improve the power, which can save the energy and costs of the enterprise maximized. It can also provide scientific basis for decision making to workers considering the economy of power supply grid during making network planning in order to develop a rational power network planning.

articleTitle: Research of the Intermediate Frequency Furnace Harmonic Analysis and Control Based on ADPSS
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the high-power IF furnace contains frequency conversion device, the effects of harmonics injected into the power grid cannot be ignored. In this paper, the working principle and power supply structure of IF furnace are introduced in detail. Based on the Advanced Digital Power System Simulator (ADPSS) and taking a steel plant project accessed to East Inner Mongolia power grid for an example, the electromagnetic transient model of IF furnace is established and simulated. The harmonic analysis method combined the time domain simulation with the recursive discrete Fourier algorithm (DFT) is used to obtain the harmonic characteristics of the IF furnace. An electromagnetic transient harmonic control model based on active power filter is established, and the validity and correctness of the proposed model and harmonic analysis method are verified by simulation. The harmonic pollution of IF furnace access to power grid is reduced, and the power quality of the grid is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Optimizing Heat Supply of Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The heat supply mode of thermal power plants generally adopts central heating, which uses the high thermal energy generated by the complete combustion of coal for power generation, and the low thermal energy for heating, so as to realize the efficient utilization of energy. This paper expounds the present situation and existing problems of central heating in thermal power plants. This paper analyzes the necessity and obstacles of central heating in Hunan thermal power plant and puts forward some measures to optimize central heating in Hunan thermal power plant.

Author Keywords: central heating in thermal power plants

articleTitle: A Method of Analyzing Geomagnetic Storm Damage to Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As grid complexity and voltage levels increase, the impact of geomagnetic storms on the grid is also increasing. Calculating the geomagnetic induced current (GIC) generated by the magnetic storm and determining the weak links in the system are critical to assessing the magnetic storm disaster and the post-disaster power grid recovery. This paper provides a method for calculating GIC, reflect the impact of the magnetic storm on the power grid in the reactive way, and proposes a modified model of IEEE RTS-79. Based on this, the weak link in the power grid under different degrees of magnetic storm disaster is determined, and a new method to resist the disaster of magnetic storm is proposed. The establishment of the model lays the foundation for the future recovery of the post-disaster power grid. The analysis method of this paper contributes to the treatment of future geomagnetic storm damage to the power grid.

articleTitle: PHEV charging Strategy under Time and Space Dimension with Interval Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Development of the plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) with low carbon and environment friendly characteristics is an inevitable trend to achieve sustainable development in future. However, random charging behavior of large-scale PHEV may have serious impacts on the security and operation of distribution network. Firstly, a novel time-space dimension combined optimization scheme (TSCOS) is proposed in this paper, which investigates PHEV charging issue from time and geography viewpoints. With the connection between time dimension and space dimension, this approach manages to improve the overall system performance and minimize constrains on the PHEV owners' charging behavior. Secondly, interval algorithm is used in the charging strategy to accommodate the random charging behavior and its uncertainty to distribution system analysis. Finally, case studies are presented to show the effectiveness of TSCOS with the IEEE 33 bus test system.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Energy Supply System Based on Molten Carbonate Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The fuel cell-based distributed energy supply system has low pollution emission, low noise, and modular advantages. This paper aims at a 100 kW-class MCFC cogeneration system using natural gas as fuel. The MCFC unit model was developed based on the lumped parameter method. A parallel system and a series system model were built. The effect of single cell voltage and fuel cell stack arrangement on system efficiency, operating temperature, catalytic burner operating parameters, etc. are analyzed. As a result, the series system in which two fuel cell stacks arranged in series can improve the stack efficiency and the system power generation efficiency. Compared to a parallel system in which two fuel cell stacks arranged in parallel, the stack efficiency and the system power generation efficiency of the series system are 6 to 8 percentage points higher than that of the parallel system. For the series system, the air needed to be graded to maintain the operating temperature of the second-stage stack, the air ratio was about 2.75; the power ratio of the two stacks was about 8.0. Compared with the catalytic burner in the parallel system, the inlet burner temperature in the series system increased by about 50 °C, and the inlet hydrogen mole fraction in the series system was reduced by 1 percentage point. The heat balance design of the catalytic burner in the series system was required.

articleTitle: Steady-State Modelling of VSC MTDC for Power System Analysis in DIgSILENT Power Factory
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a steady-state multi-terminal voltage source converter high voltage direct current (VSC MTDC) model for power system analysis in DIgSILENT PowerFactory is introduced. Power flow is one of the most important and most widely used calculation in power system analysis. Although DIgSILENT PowerFactory provides a variety of elements for building MTDC grids, it's very inefficient when using the basic elements, such as ElmVscmono and ElmDcdc, to build multi-voltage level MTDC grids for example collection of large-scale renewable energy generation cluster. The aim of this paper is to derive custom steady-state VSC HVDC models to be incorporated into built-in AC/DC power flow computations that can handle power grids with high proportion of renewable energy generation connected. The hybrid modeling methods can effectively improve the modeling efficiency and extensibility. An AC/DC power flow is implemented using DIgSILENT PowerFactory to show the validity of the steady-state models.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Inspection Robot for Offline Foreign Objects Based on Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The underline foreign objects is a common defect for transmission line. When foreign objects is under the transmission line, there will be plants and other foreign objects which affect the normal operation of the transmission line. It will cause a large accident if we do not deal with that in time. Therefore, how to prevent accidents such as bulging under the line has become the top priority of the research. This paper studies and designs an intelligent inspection robot for a line of foreign objects. Through the high-definition camera of the inspection robot, the image of the detection area is collected. The Digital Signal Processor (DSP) chip is used to preprocess it in real time, and the virtual wire frame technique is used to mark a region in the image range. The threshold value changes are monitored in real time to get the distance between the transmission line and the foreign objects under the line. If the test result is abnormal, the image will be compressed to JPEG format and sent to the monitoring technician for alarm.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Method for Distributed Power Acceptable Capacity of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distributed generation access to the distribution network, has important influence to the power flow, relay protection, network loss, power quality, reliability and power dispatching of power network, while unreasonable access bring bad effects to the safe operation of power system. This paper analyses the different operating conditions and summarizes factors limit of distributed power supply access, puts forward an universal analysis method of distributed power capacity access. It could satisfy the distributed power acceptance ability analysis and calculation during various operation modes of the distribution network, which has strong applicability in the the actual operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Insulation Performance of SF6 Substitute N2 With The Effect of Micro-moisture
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Using N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>or dry air to replace SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>as high-voltage switchgear insulation media is a hot topic in the development of environmental friendly switching equipment. To make switchgear equipment with N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>has a much compact structure in space, engineers should fully understand the insulation characteristics of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. In this paper, the insulation characteristics of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>with trace water were studied from the point view of electron swarm parameters and the breakdown tests. Firstly, the density-normalized effective ionization coefficient (α-η)/N in N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>0 gas mixtures were calculated by solving the Boltzmann equation in the condition of steady-state Townsend discharge experiment. Values of the limiting electric field strength for which the electron ionization exactly balances the attachment were derived from the effective ionization coefficient data. Secondly, the breakdown characteristics of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>with the effect of moisture by the sphere-plate electrodes have been investigated. From the calculation and experiment results, it was revealed that the insulation characteristics of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>were not severely affected by different water content ranging from 0 μL/L to 1,000 μL/L in N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. And the breakdown voltage was decreased 8 ~ 15 % with increasing moisture contents from 1,500 to 2,000 μL/L.

articleTitle: Research on the Power Frequency Current Cutting Off Capacity of 10kV Multi-Short-Gaps Arrester Under the Polluted Condition
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to study the ability of l0kV multi-short-gaps arrester to cutting off the power frequency follow current after lightning over-voltage breakdown under the polluted condition, the pollution tests have been carried out, and the influence of the filthy solution on the repeated breakdown discharge has been also tested in this paper. Results show that the arrester can cut off the power frequency follow current at zero crossing under different pollution levels, and the arc does not occur any more. The repeated combined tests of impulse and power frequency show that the contamination has little effect on the power frequency cutting off capacity of the arrester, the filthy solution can even reduce the duration of the power frequency follow current. The strong arc blowing effect of the chamber can spout the filthy solution, that is the arrester has a certain self clean ability. Therefore, the 10kV multi-short-gaps arrester can operate effectively and correctly to achieve the lighting protection function under different abominable natural conditions.

Author Keywords: the ability to cutting off the power frequency follow current

articleTitle: The Study of Monthly Power Generation Plan Based on Energy Saving Dispatch Considering Wind, Nuclear, Water, Thermal, and Other Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the simulation model of the transaction plan that meets the energy-saving power generation dispatching is established by using the time series simulation method, and the factors such as the output characteristics, load characteristics and peak shaving characteristics of various energy sources are considered. The model can be solved by Cplex simulator. The simulation results can show the output mode of various power type units, and the daily output plan of each unit can be obtained.

articleTitle: Study on Voltage Sag Control of Distribution Network Based on Custom Power Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the wide application of microelectronic devices, various types of sensitive devices have imposed higher requirements on power quality, among which voltage sag has caused the greatest loss to users. Therefore, this paper first analyzes the necessity of applying custom power technology for voltage sag control in distribution network. And then, the working principle, advantages and disadvantages, and application scope of different kinds of custom power devices are summarized. On this basis, effective suggestions on voltage sag control are provided for users, including the load sensitivity level evaluation, protection device configuration, distribution system design, custom power scheme developing and so on. Finally, with a hospital in Shanghai as an example, a custom power application scheme is designed to improve the resistance ability of the user's power distribution system to voltage sag.

articleTitle: Research on the Transient Stability Influenced by Wind Farm Access Nodes Based on Dynamic Security Region
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The access of renewable energy such as wind power brings more challenges to the safe operation of the power system. In this paper, the basic construction method of dynamic security region (DSR) boundary is introduced. This paper analyzes the differences in the dynamic security regions by changing access nodes. It is concluded that the distance between the access node and the balancer is negatively related to the transient stability of the power system. Test results on the New England 3-genrator 9-bus system are presented and prove the correctness of the conclusion.

articleTitle: Research on Implementation Scheme of Local Bay Control Unit (BCU) Installation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An implementation scheme of local BCU installation is introduced in this paper. The BCU is divided into two parts in this scheme, namely, the fundamental BCU and auxiliary BCU, in principle, the former one includes measurement, position acquisition of circuit breakers and isolators and control function, the signals of this part can be standardized, but at present, for the differences of primary equipment, the pressure blocking and binary input and output (BIO) acquisition (BIO) are hard to be standardized, so the signals of this part are acquired by the auxiliary BCU and directly sent to station control level through MMS network. The scheme effectively solved the problems of large quantity of binary input and binary output and the different binary input quantity of primary equipment.

articleTitle: Reduction of Energy Storage Capacity in an Isolated Microgrid by Using Smart Load
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The general concept of smart load (SL) was originally introduced to provide practical implementation in grid power─frequency support applications. In this paper, a specific feature of SL which is composed of a SL controller and a linear load is introduced, after that, a comprehensive discussion on the application of SL for voltage stabilization and energy storage capacity reduction in an isolated microgrid is presented. The key component of this novel SL is the controller which is operated as a series reactive power compensator (RPC), unlike the traditional reactive power compensation technologies, it offers not only reactive power compensation but also active power variation in the linear load. Results validate the effectiveness of adopting this SL for a isolated microgrid with renewable energy source and energy storage system.

articleTitle: Research on the Limit Access Capacity and Key Influencing Factors of Distributed Generation Connected to Power Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, along with increasing global concerns for environmental protection and energy saving issues, the Distributed Generation (DG) technology has become a hot research topic. After DG connected into the distribution network, the distribution network structure, and operation will be tremendous changed. Therefore, it is of practical significance to study the influence of DG access on the distribution network and the capacity of the network. This article first analyzes the influence of DG on voltage quality of distribution network, and proposed DG limit access capacity optimization model. The model takes the voltage deviation, voltage fluctuation, short circuit current, line load flow, tidal current equation constraint and distributed force constraint into consideration, and uses PSO algorithm to calculate the distribution network limit receptivity. The simulation and optimization results show that the proposed model and algorithm are effective.

articleTitle: Construction of Ideal Time Section Based on Multi-Source Measurement Data in Dispatch Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Measurement delay outliers adverse consequences, affecting the right conclusion of online power system analysis. In this paper, the possible measurement delay is given through the analysis of data acquisition and transmission process. Based on the verification platform of dispatching automation system, the measurement delay case is constructed. The influence of measurement delay on state estimation is analyzed quantitatively. A method of ideal time section based on unified time scalar in dispatch control system is proposed.

articleTitle: Scheme of Intelligent Use of Electricity for Electricity Markets of Binhai New Area
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Intelligent use of electricity is an important part of smart grid, which is a future direction of electricity usage. Scheme for a particular area is a valuable trial for promotion of intelligent use of electricity. Because of heavy load demand, a rapid development of electric vehicle and smart home, abundant renewable resource, scheme of intelligent use of electricity for electricity market of Binhai New Area is proposed. A structure of three-level responsibility and six-module technology is established. An encouragement for distributed generation is designed. A program of price subsidy to improve the user's habit is advised. An example of Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-city, Binhai New Area is introduced, which further verified the feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: The Application and Assessment of Smart Technologies for Batch Control of Load Dispatching
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Smart technologies for batch control of load dispatching are proposed based on D5000 systems, which helps to do the fast and accurate removal of the designated large-capacity load in case of over supplying and emergent load curtailing. The overall framework and operation flow were also provided. By integrating several key technologies, including load control permissions, intelligent anti-misoperation, automatic line selection and parallel processing mechanism, the functions that autonomously switch between multiple interfaces, automatically screen out the controllable lines, optimize the anti-misoperation mechanism and speed up the batch control operation, were realized successfully. Besides, the Delphi-anti-entropy weight method was adopted to analyze the requirements on safety, accuracy, speed and friendliness of batch load removal under emergent operation cases. The practical simulation examples show that smart technologies for batch control of load dispatching is effective and valuable in following aspects: ensuring safe and stable operation of the power grid, minimizing the social influences brought about by load control, further extending the intelligent and practical level of D5000 systems, and so on.

articleTitle: Reactive Power and Voltage Control for High Penetration Photovoltaic Interconnected to Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of distributed generation in the power grid, its impact on reactive power and voltage cannot be ignored because of the instability of its output. First, this paper makes a reactive power optimization from a global perspective, and establishes an optimization model with active power loss minimization as the objective function. Besides, particle swarm algorithm is used to solve the nonlinear problem, and the numerical values of coefficient is improved to optimize the particle swarm algorithm which is easy to get trouble into the local optimum and the speed of which is getting very slow later. Secondly, the local control of reactive power and voltage is carried out through the coordination controller. Finally, through the actual power grid data analysis in Zhejiang Jinhu area, the model and algorithm are proved to be feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Discussion on Voltage Sag Source Locating Method in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analyzes different voltage sag source locating methods based on different monitoring devices, including the methods for fault source tracing based on power quality monitoring device, and the fault source locating method based on voltage sag monitoring device. This analysis would be a guide for monitoring device allocation. In particular, a clear summary of the steps of different positioning methods is performed. On this basis, the necessary grid network topology and sag information for different locating methods are further elaborated. At the same time, different locating methods are compared in terms of fault tolerance, accuracy, and rapidity. Finally, prospects of future work are given.

articleTitle: Research of Off-grid Energy Storage Converter Based on Repetitive Control and PI Control
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The coordinated control of photovoltaic energy storage DC power supply system is one of most important issues for ensuring the system reliable operation. An autonomous control strategy is proposed for photovoltaic-energy storage DC power supply system without communication, With this strategy, any unit in system can switch its control mode smoothly via common DC bus voltage. During transition, its droop curve can be adjusted adaptively according to current operating state. The DC bus voltage amplitude is employed as an information carrier to determine the operation mode switching. Hence, each controller operates independently without communicating each other. With this method, voltage regulation, power balance and power sharing among different sources are guaranteed. Above conclusions are verified through PSCAD simulation in a photovoltaic energy storage DC power supply system.

articleTitle: The Research of External Characteristic Model Based on Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: State variables change of Photovoltaic alone with its control variables is studied on the basis of photovoltaic generation system research. A model of photovoltaic external characteristic model is established as well. The model included its active power output as well as reactive power output. The power of each photovoltaic can be variable in a wide range based on the local temperature, illumination intensity and weather conditions when these DGs are connected to the grid. As a result., the power flow of distribution network may be changed and it will also lead to a higher network losses and fluctuated voltages. A novel model for analyzing active power change of photovoltaic is established., besides., the feasibility and influencing factors of reactive power of photovoltaic is demonstrated. In the end, the corresponding method of dynamic power prediction of photovoltaic is proposed to get the optimal active power output and reactive power output. The results of an example show that the efficiency of photovoltaic and the stability of power system can be largely improved by using the method.

articleTitle: Influence of Negative Phase Sequence of Distribution Line to Feeder Terminal Unit Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Performing line commutation at an appropriate distribution switch can better balance the inductive reactance between three-phase lines and reduce transmission line losses. However, due to the large number of distribution lines and the complex operating environment, the management of distribution line is very difficult, and after the commutation some distribution lines may be in negative sequence operation because of failing to plan reasonably and no checking phase sequence in time, that affect the normal operation of the feeder terminal unit(FTU). This paper first analyzes the FTU's working principle of the dual power supply, then studies the FTU's protection function configuration, and then obtains the influence of negative sequence operation of the line on the power supply and protection of the FTU. And then, according to the negative sequence operation characteristics of the line, this paper puts forward some suggestions, such as adding phase sequence alarm function, phase sequence adjusted by software, etc. Finally, combined with a negative sequence operation case in Shandong Province, it is verified that the negative sequence operation of the line can affect the operation of the FTU and the proposed method can effectively improve the distribution line management efficiency and the reliability of the FTU.

articleTitle: Research on Connection Capacity Planning of The Distribution Network Line Based on “One Library and Three Centers”
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to make more reasonable assembling capacity planning of power distribution network line, a refined research method for connection capacity planning of power distribution network line is proposed based on the full use of “one library and three centers” (unified data repository, statistical distribution center, center of mathematical analysis and decision-making center) in this paper. First, the users of power distribution network are classified to analyze the load characteristics of all kinds of user. Next the development stage of distribution network users is analyzed by fast clustering analysis method. Then a calculation method for determining the planning connection capacity of distribution network line is given based on the simultaneity rate and the demand coefficient of loads. Finally, an actual distribution network line planning case is given to demonstrate the basic features of the method proposed.

articleTitle: Fushun Area ‘3.15’ Oversized Ice Coverage Accident
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: On March 15th, the Fushun region suffered from rain and snow and a large area of flashover and flashover accidents occurred. 8 lines of 66 kV lines tripped 14 times and 31 lines of 10 kV lines tripped 32 times. The blackout affected 466 kWh in the 10 kV zone. The power loss was 0.5 million kilowatts, and the power loss was 40.65 million kilowatts. Aiming at the characteristics of short ice cover duration, low ice density, and external insulation flashover in Fushun area, measures to prevent ice flashover were developed. Based on the five-character antiicing policy of `avoid,' `resist,' `melt,' `change,' and `defend,' the actual rectification measures in line with Fushun's power grid, which consist primarily of `reforms,' were formulated. The summary of law of preventing line ice coating and tower broken, has a wide range of popularization value.

articleTitle: Application of Load Allocation Algorithm to Low Voltage Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper focuses on the use of load allocation techniques for low voltage distribution network modeling. A load allocation algorithm is proposed for generating relatively realistic load profiles. The case studies examine the accuracy of the proposed load allocation algorithm based on monitored real-time data from distribution feeders and energy meters. The network topology validation is also investigated and included as part of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison Between Renewable Obligation and Feed-in Tariff with Contract for Difference in UK
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The UK has recently made a movement in its renewable incentive policy. The current Renewable Obligation scheme is considered not capable to meet future supply requirements and UK's ambitious decarbonization target. Therefore, the government adjusted the renewable support scheme to the feed-in tariff with contract for difference scheme, which is believed to provide renewable generators' more confidence in renewable plants installation. A fitness model is proposed to assess renewable subsidy schemes' performance. Their performances are compared under their optimum subsidy strategies via a dynamic optimization method that can characterize the market expanding effects. This study demonstrates that CfD is a more efficient and cost-effective renewable incentive scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Hierarchical Power Allocation Strategy for Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The energy storage system is an indispensable component of the Mircogrid. It can be used to satisfy power quality requirement, to provide urgent power supply and suppress power fluctuation of renewable power generation. Battery/supercapacitor hybrid energy storage system (HESS) is an effective way to suppress power fluctuation of photovoltaic power generation system during radiation change. This paper focuses on the power sharing problem between energy-density and power-density components of the HESS. First, a hierarchical power allocation strategy is proposed to optimize the response frequency as well as state-of-charge (SOC) of supercapacitors. Second, the design of the low pass filter with time constant adjustment module, the over-charging /discharging protection module and maximal power control module are introduced. Finally, The simulation results proved the effectiveness of the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Optimization Research on the $\pi$ T hybrid structure of 110kV Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: There exsits some operational problems of the πT hybrid structure, such as large workload of maintenance, flexibility and forced power outage, which can not meet the increasing demand for electric power reliability. In this paper, the problems existing in the actual operation of the πT hybrid structure are analyzed in detail, and the optimization scheme is put forward. The technical and economic demonstration of the optimization scheme is carried out. The transition scheme of πT hybrid structure to chain π connection structure has been studied. In order to guid the actual work, the paper has formulated the principle of 110 kV power grid planning.

articleTitle: Unit Overpowering Capability Potential Analysis of Conventional Generation Units using HP Feedwater Heater Bypass
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When the power grid is operating in high loading and the load increasing of the nearby units is difficult in grid abnormal condition, the overpower capability of the generation units in grid abnormal area will be very important for the grid. A unit overpowering method is proposed under power grid abnormal conditions. The proposed method is based on the change of the operation mode of the turbine high pressure feedwater heater system. A theoretical analysis method for evaluation of overpowering of the existing generation unit using the proposed method is put forward. Based on the design parameter of the full load condition, an overpower factor of the unit under high pressure feedwater heater bypass condition can be calculated. This overpower factor is illustrated as a function of the feedwater heater outlet mixed temperature drop or feedwater heater bypass flow fraction. An example of the unit overpowering scheme is provided for a 1000MW super-super-critical generation unit. It is shown that under the condition of grid abnormal operation condition the high pressure feedwater heater bypass is opened partly and 5%-35%of the feedwater is bypassed through the heater bypass line, and and a 0.77%-5.09% of the unit rated output increase can be expected under full load condition. Typically the high pressure feedwater heater bypass is opened and 20% of the feedwater is bypassed, and nearly 3% of the unit output can be increased under full load condition. It is also shown that under the HP heater bypass operation condition the final temperature dropping is nearly linear to the bypass line flow fraction. Therefore, controlling of the final feedwater temperature can be taken as an indirect indication of the heater bypass flow. The theoretical analysis results also give some operation limitation for future site application.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Wind Power and Solar Power Supply and Centralized Power Supply in Remote Areas
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper aims at the power supply problem of different types of rural users in rural power supply system. It comprehensively considers factors such as rural load density, power supply radius, load characteristics, distributed energy distribution and other factors, combined with the development of different rural areas. The principles of local consumption, practical networking, and other proposals put forward a power supply model for remote areas in eastern Inner Mongolia. By discussing the two methods of decentralized microgrid power supply and centralized power supply, a specific power supply scheme was derived to enable it to solve the local power supply problem.

articleTitle: Stratified]Configuration of Electrochemical Energy Storage in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper has reviewed the study process and application situation of Electrochemical Energy Storage (EES), and has a comprehensive assessment by RAMS/LCC system from many aspects for Lithium-ion battery, Sodium-sulfur battery, lead-acid battery, Redox-flow battery totally five main EES technologies. It has explained the application and demands in distribution network (DN) of EES, and analyzed several problems to configure EES in current applied demonstration, so put forward a stratified and distributed energy storage configuration architecture which comprehensively considers EES function demands, technological performance and products' features. It also proposes the application trend of EES in future DN, offering reference for relevant implementation of engineering construction.

articleTitle: The Formulation of Subsidy Price for Demand Response Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, how to formulate a reasonable subsidy price for demand response in China's power grid is an urgent issue to be solved. This paper establishes the revenue models of users and power grid in the context of demand response. Based on the revenue models, this paper also establishes a Stackelberg game model to characterize the game behavior of power grid and users on demand response subsidy price. In addition, the method of solving the Stackelberg game model established is proposed, and a case is given to calculate the optimal unit power subsidy price for demand response.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Blackout Social Comprehensive Loss Based on Public Security Model
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Since the modern society has an increasing dependency on the electricity, the power blackout will cause massive losses and impacts on the grid. How to evaluate comprehensive loss caused by blackout is the problem both government and grid enterprises pay special attention to. A social comprehensive evaluation indicator system and corresponding evaluation model for the impact caused by blackout are established based on public security model, and the quantitative evaluation is performed in the aspects of social personnel casualties, property loss and loss due to delay in service restoration. Theoretical analysis on the parameter of the established model and the optimization of the assigned values for the model parameters are carried out. According to the statistics data of blackout in a city, the social comprehensive loss after blackout is calculated and compared with calculation results of typical blackout events occurred around the world, and the rationality of the proposed evaluation model is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Economic Dispatch Strategy Based on Generator and Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper firstly analyzes the load curves of some curve provinces in south China. In the process of analysis of the power characteristics of GuangDong, the MATLAB software is used to quantitatively analyze the effect of peak-filling and valley-filling in the second stage. And the existing problems are analyzed: the means of GuangDong peak modulation frequency modulation is insufficient and the energy storage unit has a great effect on the frequency modulation and frequency modulation of the system. Through the establishment of the relevant mathematical model, the use of GAMS software with a constrained quadratic control obtained after the power transmission curve. The analysis of the transmission situation in the dry season is carried out, and it is found that the peak-valley difference can be reduced in a considerable range. And then according to the special period of the west to east of the wet season, the data within the program to be amended, the same can be a reasonable optimization of the results.

articleTitle: Peak-shaving Requirement Analysis Method Based on Sequential Monte-Carlo Simulation for Large Scale Wind Power Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a peak-shaving requirement analysis method based on sequential Monte-Carlo simulation for large scale wind power integrated system is presented after analyzing the influence of large-scale wind power on the peak-shaving feature of power system. This method establishes the time sequence model of wind power and load, as well as the conventional generators of which the planned outage is also being considered as a random variable, and a three-state transfer model is established. Then the peak-shaving shortage indices of large scale wind power integrated system are defined, which can be used to probabilistically evaluate the peak-shaving requirement of the system. The convergence of the method is verified by IEEE-RTS79 system. At last, the method is applied in the real large power system of Jibei power grid in North China.

articleTitle: A State Assessment Algorithm of Power Cable Based on Association Rules Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the continuous development of power grids, power cables are widely used in urban power grids. But cables are generally laid underground, and the fault is not easy to be found and the recovery time is long, the reliability of power supply was seriously threatened. The traditional planned maintenance has not been able to solve the existing problems accurately. Therefore, it is of great significance to improve the reliability of power distribution and reduce the failure rate by assessing the operational status of power cables through the relevance analysis of massive monitoring and testing data. This paper proposes a power cable state assessment algorithm based on association rule data mining technology from the perspective of big data and information relevance. Firstly, by analyzing the online monitoring data, detection data, experimental data, and the interrelation of the state parameters of the cable and transformer fault types, the set of cable synthetic status parameters can be set up. Then, use the association rule method to calculate the weight coefficient of each state parameters; In order to effectively avoid the influence of subjective factors on the evaluation results, weighted theory of equilibrium function was used to calculate the weight coefficient of the synthetic status parameters; Finally, combined with the existing assessment process, an accurate and objective evaluation system power cable was established. The results of the example verify the validity and accuracy of the assessment method, which provides a new novel idea for cable status assessment.

articleTitle: Research on Application of High-capacity Power Electronic Technology in Urban Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large-scale urban power grid is facing increasingly serious trend of heavy load problem. The cost of traditional solutions is usually high due to large investment and difficult implementation of urban construction. In this literature, the application of three types of power electronic technology in solving unbalanced power flow of urban power grid is considered. The technical theory of UPFC is analyzed for entry point. By comparing with flexible DC technology and SSSC which are of the same type with UPFC, the application scenarios of three types of power electronic devices are demonstrated and the feasibility of UPFC above flexible DC technology and SSSC in urban power grid are proposed. Then an actual problem of a real urban power grid and several solutions including UFPC are studied and compared, which shows the application potential of UPFC in project perspective.

articleTitle: Study of Double Fed Wind Turbine Modified Simulation Model in Grid Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Theme of this paper is to reduce the output characteristics bias of doubly fed generator simulation model and real wind turbine. A modified model of doubly fed induction generator based on data measurement is presented in this paper. The mathematical model for simulating wind turbine is obtained by data fitting. Secondly, aimed at approaching real wind turbine output characteristics, the mathematical model is researched for improving the control strategy. Finally, a simulation example shown that the modified model can accurately imitate the output characteristics of real wind turbine and improves the simulation accuracy of the doubly fed induction generator.

articleTitle: The Integration of Power Electronic Transformer with DC Microgrid and its Influences on Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the aggravation of the energy crisis, more and more countries have begun to research on the energy internet, aiming to realize a large-scale access and intelligent control of renewable energy. In this context, power electronic transformer is a promising electrical device to serve as the “energy router” in the future energy internet for the reason that it provides multiple types of electrical interfaces and is highly controllable. Compared with traditional transformers, PET has some ancillary functions like reactive power compensation, fault isolation, power factor adjustment, and the advantage of small size and light weight. It is an ideal grid connection device for microgrids. This paper presented a topology of a PET based DC microgrid and its control strategy. The power management and the influences of the microgrid on the distribution network are elaborated. The behavior of the proposed system and the influences of the microgrid on the two indices of loss and power quality of distribution network are observed and analyzed by PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: The Research of Overall Effect Evaluation Index System of New Energy Combined Power Project
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the current, the evaluation index system of energy projects is only for a single project or a single aspect, which for new energy combined power project is lack. According to the features of the new energy combined power project, the integrated overall effect evaluation index system is studied. The integrated overall effect evaluation index system is established by four areas as demonstration effect, operating effect, economic benefit and environmental impact. Choose a actual operating data of a new energy combined power project as a numerical example. Actual examples show that the proposed index system can be more fully grasp the impact elements of the new energy combined power project and guide its development in the future.

articleTitle: Synchronous Condenser Parameter Identification Based on Time-frequency Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An accurate synchronous condenser model is the foundation of system analysis, operation and control. In order to obtain synchronous condenser parameters meeting the increasingly refined simulation requirements of power system, an identification method based on time-frequency transform is proposed in this paper. First, the differential equations in the time domain are converted into algebraic equations in the frequency domain based on the sixth-order practical model of synchronous condenser. The transient and subtransient EMF are then eliminated to obtain the decoupled d-axis and q-axis transfer function. After obtaining the transfer function, an improved genetic algorithm is used for identifying the practical parameters of synchronous condenser. Finally, the dynamic process simulations are conducted in PSD-BPA to verify the rationality of the identification results.

articleTitle: Study on Nonlinear Hedonic Index of Power Consumption Intensity
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power consumption intensity can be interpreted as a `price' in the field of energy consumption for the acquisition of GDP, so this paper introduces the method of Nonlinear Hedonic Index into the evaluation of the power consumption intensity, while introducing Bilateral Box-Cox Transform to strictly follow the conditions such as linearity, independence, homogeneity and normality. Taking the power consumption intensity of China in 2015-2016 as an example, this paper calculates the Hedonic Index of power consumption intensity, points out that the key influencing factors of the change of power consumption intensity. After comparison, it is pointed out that the traditional Divisia Decomposition Approach concerns less characteristic variables and does not fully reflect the heterogeneity of different economies, therefore, underestimates the role of characteristic variables. The correctness of Hedonic Index's application in this field is verified in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Point to Point Quantum Secure Optical Fiber Transmission System of Distribution Network Control Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of how to protect the confidentiality and integrity of the distribution network control signal transmission security problem, this paper proposes a solution for point to point quantum secure optical fiber transmission system of distribution network control signal. The solution is to combine the quantum key distribution (QKD) with one-time pad to realize the secure communication of the point to point of the distribution network control and protection signal. The simulation results show that compared with the classical key distribution system, the proposed scheme has the advantage of confidentiality, integrity and identifiability, and has the uniqueness of tightness enhanced. The security support for the interoperability of intelligent distribution network equipment is enhanced, and the security and intelligence level of the distribution network system are improved.

articleTitle: Effect of New Insulation Cleaning Agent on Electrical and Mechanical Properties of Silicone Rubber Materials
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Silicone rubber insulators are widely used in distribution lines and equipment, while composite insulators may threaten their operation safety under the condition of serious fouling. In order to analyze the influence of insulating cleaning agent on composite insulator material, the swelling characteristics of silicone rubber material in different cleaning agents and the influence of silicone rubber material on electrical properties were studied. The results showed that the swelling of silicone rubber in the first four hours of cleaning agent was very obvious, the change rates of mass and diameter were 31% and 15%, respectively. When the soaking time was 24 hours, the change rate of mass and diameter were 47% and 20%, respectively. The electrical properties of silicone rubber have not changed before and after swelling, and the dielectric loss of silicone rubber before and after swelling has no change. The dielectric loss tan of 1000Hz is stable at 0.42 μm 0.48. The interpole capacitance decreased from 6.54pF to 4.80pF with the swelling time. The tensile strength of silicone rubber decreased slightly by 22.7% after swelling.

articleTitle: Comparison of Virtual and Conventional Synchronous Generators Based on a Modularized Analysis Tool
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: It is questionable that if virtual and conventional synchronous generators could provide identical dynamic support to the power system. In order to summarize the difference, this paper introduces a MIMO-based analysis tool for modelling power systems integrated by conventional or power-electronic interfaced generators. The scalable tool is used to test modelling accuracy of individual generators using dynamic simulation. For small-signal stability analysis, the tool does linearization based on MIMO models, and then couple all generators/loads though the passive network, with the network transient included. During transient stability analysis, VSG's ability to emulate SG's dynamic responses depends on whether the converter has a strong overloading limit, and the current control loop is tuned fast. In practice this could be hard to realize, considering that the converter's current limit is slightly higher than 1.0, and thus the current controller tends to be easily saturated during voltage sags, and the VSG could enter constant-power mode. During small disturbances, VSG could have a low-frequency inertia response similar to SG, yet it can introduce new oscillation modes, depending on the control parameter configuration. Due to lack of stator-flux transient modelling, the high-frequency oscillation of VSG is evidently deviated from that of SG.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Intelligent Data Mining Algorithm for Utility Indexes System of Distribution Automation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A Data-Mining algorithm based on the Support-Confidence-Lift Framework is designed to mine strong association and correlation rules, conforms to the logic of distribution automation system, from the mass and poor-quality historical database of distribution automation system. And two of the four core utility indexes of distribution automation system combined with the historical database of a certain practical distribution grid are taken as the case to illustrate the application of this algorithm. Furthermore, the indexes calculated with or without the data-mining algorithm and their corresponding statistical data are compared and studied carefully. The comparison fully demonstrates that the powerful ability of the algorithm to excavate hidden information and relationships among mass data is valuable to the practical electrical distribution engineering.

articleTitle: Studing the Effect of Automatic Generation Control on the Power Frequency Based on PSD-FDS Emluator
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Thepaper studies the effect of automatic generation control(AGC) on power frequency based on the full dynamic simulation. First modeling of AGC for the full dynamic simulation according to the three components of AGC, which is calculation of area control error (ACE), simulation of control strategy, and calculation of generating power regulation. Second the effect of key-parameters of AGC including dead band, transient frequency-deviation on and rate of generating power regulation on power frequency is studied by simulating. Finally, the paper takes Fujian power as an example to analyze the effect of AGC on under-frequency loading shedding(UFLS) by the serious faults and study on the coordination control between AGC and UFLS.

articleTitle: Research on Grid-connected Strategy of Distributed Generation Dominated by on -grid Electricity Price (July 2018)
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The access of high permeability and large-scale distributed generation makes the operating environment of distribution network extremely badly. To solve the problem of safe and reliable access to distribution networks with large-scale distributed energy sources, based on the on-grid price, this paper deduces the demand information of power distribution network by analyzing and comparing it; establishes the Markov decision process model, defines the reward and punishment mechanism of different behaviors; introduces particle swarm optimization algorithm to optimize the power flow calculation process and improve convergence rate; proposes the control strategy of distributed energy access to the distribution network, and maximizes the economic benefits of distributed energy under the premise of ensuring the highest priority of power quality, and provide more effective means to solve the problem of active distribution network dissipating distributed energy.

articleTitle: Joint Planning of Pumped Storage, Nuclear Power, and Wind Power Installed Based on Maximizing Global Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the power structure, the peaking capacity of the power grid and the impact of wind power on the peak shaving capacity are comprehensively studied. At the same time, considering the volatility of load and wind power, a joint planning model of pumped storage-nuclear power-wind power installation is constructed.

articleTitle: Forecast Method of Distribution Network Input-Output Benefit Based on Peer Measurement Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering that a unified measurement of input and output is not realized in the evaluation on the current distribution network planning schemes, which limits the evaluation effects and cannot support the refined investment decisions, a new evaluation and forecast method for input-output benefits of distribution networks is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the peer measurement mode for input-output benefit is built through the analysis of the supporting conditions for output benefits; then, the evaluation indexes which can accurately reflect the input-output relationships are selected to establish the evaluation index system for the input-output benefit; next, the input-output benefit forecast method is proposed based on the quantitative association analysis of the input-output benefit; finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method are verified through case study.

articleTitle: Study on Consumption Capability of Large-Scale Photovoltaic Access to Regional Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic power generation has the characteristics of sufficient power generation resources, safe and reliable power generation and so on, which has become the focus of worldwide attention. However, distributed photovoltaic power generation brings clean energy to China's power grid and also brings many problems. Due to its scattered, intermittent and random output, it will bring many impacts on the power quality and power supply reliability of China's power grid. Based on the premise that a large number of distributed photovoltaic power sources are connected to the regional distribution network, this paper uses ETAP simulation software to calculate the power flow of the distribution network containing distributed photovoltaic power sources under the condition that the power grid voltage constraints and line power flow constraints are met, and combines with the actual load curve of a certain region, so as to obtain the maximum load bearing capacity of the distribution network that can be connected to the distributed photovoltaic power sources.

articleTitle: Application Principle of Neutral Grounding Method for 66kV System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to optimize the distribution system, selecting the proper neutral point grounding method is one of the most important methods to improve the reliability and economical efficiency of the distribution network. Therefore, the selection and application of the neutral point grounding method is to improve the operation level of the distribution system. The key factor. This paper analyzes and establishes a simulation calculation model to study the single-phase earth fault current and over-voltage characteristics in the arc suppression coil grounding, low-resistance grounding, arc suppression coil, and low-resistance grounding methods of the distribution network neutral point 66kV system. The application principle of neutral point grounding method for 66kV system and the effectiveness and applicability of different capacitive current testing methods are proposed to improve the safety of the urban 66kV system power grid.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Distribution Network Information Analysis Based on General Independent Data Analysis Framework of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)

articleTitle: Research on Accelerated Address Search Method for Intelligent Distribution Network Equipment Identification and Lookup
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve the real-time performance of smart distribution network equipment address recognition search, solve the fast address search problem of distribution network intelligent equipment or device or unit, application Fibonacci method for two segments division of the address segment, this paper proposes a quick address search method for identification and lookup of the distribution network equipment. Aiming at the problem of search and query in the MAC (Media Access Control) address, IPv4 (Internet Protocol version 4) address or IPv6 (Internet Protocol version 6) address space of the equipment / device / unit in the distribution network, the computer simulation results show that compared with the midpoint method, the address lookup speed of the method is faster. It can improve the real-time performance of the intelligent perception of the distribution network and speed up the network management response speed of the equipment / device / unit failure in the distribution network. The operation and maintenance performance of the distribution network are improved, and the security and intelligence level of the distribution network system are promoted.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Difference Coefficient of Generator Excitation System During Multi-Period
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-objective optimization model for the difference coefficient of generator excitation system to improve grid operation voltage level during multi-period and reduce grid loss. The minimum voltage fluctuation at power grid pilot point during multi-period and the minimized active grid loss are taken as the objective functions, while the power flow equations are used as the constraints. The particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is employed to solve the optimization model. The effects of the difference coefficients of generator excitation system on power grid operation voltage are analyzed in detail. The simulation results indicate that the operating voltage level of power grid can be effectively improved and the grid loss can be significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Research on Quality Inspection Management Mode of Distribution Network Equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, while the Power Grid Corp vigorously carried out the transformation and construction of distribution network, it further promotes the management of the source and the overall quality management, and improves the guarantee capability of the power grid's quality and the reliability of the operation. However, there is still a phenomenon that the qualified rate of the equipment is high and the fault of the running equipment is relatively large, and the safe and stable operation of the power grid is affected in a certain extent. This paper optimizes and innovating the management mode of distribution network equipment quality inspection and management under the new situation, studies the allocation and construction model of differential test capability, puts forward the hierarchical quality inspection system structure mode, in order to improve the quality supervision ability of the distribution network equipment before entering the net, and ensure the essential safety of the power grid equipment and the stability of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Generation and Injection Method of Alarm Data in Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to better standardize the function of intelligent alarm in substation, it needs to be standardized to test it. The existing method of alarm data generation is to manually pick up points. According to the application scenarios of typical faults in substation, the corresponding serialization alarm signals are selected, and the sending order and time interval of the alarm signals are manually configured. This method is not only wastes time and energy, but also easy to make mistakes. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes an automatic generation and injection method for alarm test data in smart substation. Based on the typical fault criterion of intelligent alarm, the fault template file is designed. The test files are automatically generated by a series of options such as lED mapping, alarm basic data mapping, alarm sequence data mapping, and the correction of fault templates, and the test files are loaded into the IED simulation service device. Finally, through the IED simulation device, the serialized warning signals contained in the test files are injected into the integrated monitoring system. The automatic generation and injection method avoids the complex and complicated process of manual pick up and configuration, and realizes automatic testing of intelligent alarm reasoning function.

articleTitle: Harmonic Control Measures in Yili Rolling Mill
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Harmonic and electromagnetic interference, power factor reduction is listed as the three major hazards of the power system. The harmonic pollution of the IF electric furnace at Yili Rolling Mill has seriously affected the power quality of the power system and the safe use of electricity by users. Through the power quality test of the Huidong 1 and 2 distribution lines (Yili Rolling Mill) and the analysis of the test data, it is concluded that the 5th, 7th, 11th, and 13th harmonics are the main causes of power pollution. Using a method of connecting a capacitor bank in series with a 4.5% reactor, an LC filter circuit was constructed, and harmonics were filtered out successfully, which verified the effectiveness of the control measures.

articleTitle: Study on the Operation Mode of Multi Micro Grid Based on Public Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a regional multi-micro grid interconnection mode based on public energy storage. The sub-microgrid interconnects the DC busbars of the public energy storage to realize the low-voltage side closed-loop operation. It also improves the reliability of the important load by combining the real-time dynamic grid technology.
