Secondly, this paper proposes the regional multi-micro grid integrated energy local optimization allocation technology. It not only realizes the complete local consumption of the distributed power supply, but also improves the revenue of the microgrid significantly. For the incremental income, the multi-agent regional multi-micro grid commercial operation mode is proposed to achieve multi-party win-win. Finally, the research results are applied to the actual micro-grid reconstruction project, and the operation results verify the advanced nature of the theoretical technology.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Distribution Area Design
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve power supply quality and service level of distribution area, aiming at problems such as low information level, low efficiency, lack of decision-making support and other issues in distribution area planning, intelligent architecture design is put forward to realize online and offline data collection, analysis, forecasting and scheduling of distribution area. The Wangjiazhai Residential Quarter in Pudong New Area is chosen as a pilot to design and install an intelligent system for distribution area on columns. The results demonstrate that the system has great social and economic significance for power companies to increase economic efficiency and provide service for the general public.

articleTitle: Steep Wave Characteristics and Suggestions of Factory composite Disc Suspension Insulators
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: RTV coating on the surface of the disc suspension insulators is an extremely effective anti-pollution flashover measure, which is widely used in all lines with different voltage levels of State Grid Corp., especially the UHVDC project. It effectively solves the problem of large-scale pollution flashover on transmission lines in our country, whereas raises new problems. The existing experience shows that the RTV anti-pollution flashover coating will affect the steep wave performance of the disc suspension porcelain or glass insulators to a certain extent. At present, there is less research on the extent of the RTV coating impact to insulators, as well as the steep wave characteristics of factory compound insulators as new products. This paper studied different tonnage products of disc porcelain and glass insulators for UHV proj ect of State Grid Corp., conducted the air impact breakdown withstand voltage tests respectively in the Key Laboratory of State Grid Corp. At the same time, the samples were modeled and analyzed the field intensity distribution through ANSYS simulation software. The test results show that the steep shock amplitude decreases to 2.4 p.u. for products with a mechanical strength of not more than 210 kN, and the amplitude decreases to 2.2 p.u. for that of not less than 300 kN. For the factory composite disc suspension insulators, it is suggested that corresponding steep wave impulse voltage amplitude criteria should be given according to different mechanical strength levels of the products.

articleTitle: Test System Design of Low Voltage Ride Through of High Altitude Photovoltaic Power Station
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: the photovoltaic resources are abundant in the high altitude area of northwest China, but the network frame is weak in this kind of area, and it is urgent to carry out the detection of Photovoltaic grid connected network test. It is necessary to solve the problem of system insulation safety with Low Voltage Ride Through (LVRT) test for photovoltaic power generation system at high altitude area. In this paper, the principle of LVRT test system of photovoltaic power generation is analyzed. The factors affecting transient overvoltage of the system are analyzed also. According to a 35 kV LVRT experiment, the simulation calculation is studied by using ATP, sums up the test point <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.1\mu \mathrm{F}$</tex> grid connected capacitance and resistance of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$100\Omega$</tex> can effectively reduce the peak of the transient overvoltage, determine the effective measures for overvoltage suppression of test process.

articleTitle: Wind Power Peak Regulation Pricing Model Under Wind and Fire Alternative Trading Mechanism –– A Case Study of Wind Power Integration, Gansu Province (Apr 2018)
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The wind power in the Gansu Province's power grid has gradually realized largescale grid connection with the global energy internet conditions, which has increased the difficulty of the peaking of the power grid system and caused the demand of the grid for peaking auxiliary services to increase. Therefore, in order to promote largr-scale wind power grid-connected power gengeation, as the main provider of grid peaking auxiliary services, it is necessary to provide certain compensation for the thermal power plants that provide peaking services, thereby incentivizing the enthusiasm of the thermal power plant's peaking, ensuring its recovery costs and obtaining Reasonable profit. The core issue of the ancillary services transaction mechanism is how to obtion and price these ancillary services. Based on the above conditions, based on relevant data information provided by the Gansu Provincial Grid Corporation, including the maximum output of wind power (P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i,max</sub>), the status of thermal power plant assembly machines and related power generation, etc., a cost-benefit analysis based service acquisition related pricing strategy was selected; for thermal power plants and wind farms Peaking transaction issues, analysis of the cost-effectiveness of peak shaving; at the same time, in order to ensure the enthusiasm of providing peaking services in the wind power grid integration environment, it is necessary to provide certain compensation for thermal power plants that provide peaking services to ensure that they can recover costs and even obtion Reasonable profit. Since the difference in electricity prices is not significant in the provinces of Gansu Province, the difference between Gansu wind power profits and thermal power is noly analyzed in terms of cost differences, and no comparison of other data is involved. This paper combines the current situation of auxiliary services and wind power participation in peak load adjustment in Gansu Province. According to the principle of “compensation cost and reasonable return”, the wind power peaking pricing model is targeted P = (ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</sub> - C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>) (1 - P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i,FOR</sub>). Finally, the specific example of Gansu Province not only shows the difference in earnings before and after the peak-to-peak adjustment of wind power, but also indicates that the large-scale auxiliary adjustment of wind power can ensure that thermal power generators can participate in deep-peaking with reasonable returns.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation for Electric Vehicle Rapid Charging Stations Based on Asaga
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Construction of rapid charging stations is one of the most important keys to the popularization of electric vehicles (EVs). This paper proposed a multi-objective electric vehicle rapid charging station planning model which considers the profits of users and charging stations. A sizing model is proposed based on queuing theory aiming at minimizing the capacity while satisfy the constraints. A locating model aiming at minimizing the construction cost of charging stations and the distance between users and charging stations simultaneously is proposed. The multiobjective problem is transformed into a single objective problem by utilizing weighting coefficients and the problem is solved by Adaptive Simulated Annealing Genetic Algorithm (ASAGA). Subsequently, Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) was utilized to obtain the terminal planning result. The simulation results have demonstrated the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on the Ultra-Short-Time Load Prediction Method of Air Source Heat Pump Considering the Input of Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Air source heat pump is a heating equipment that using air as heat collection source and refrigerant as energy transfer medium. And the heating power is affected by many factors, which is complex and difficult to predict. In this paper, by researching the heat demand characteristics of the room where the air source heat pump worked and analyzing the dissipation characteristics of the room heat and the process of energy transfer and conversion in the room, the room heat demand model was established, which was based on the external temperature change, indoor temperature and indoor heating load. Further, the load forecasting network structure was built, and the improved ANN neural network was used to predict the heating load of the room air source heat pump accurately, according to the room heat demand model.

articleTitle: Research of Neural Network Ensemble Forecasting Based on Genetic Algorithm to Optimize the Combination Weights Dynamically
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to further improve the accuracy of short-term load forecasting, normalized the weather and holidays data, the paper respectively uses three methods of Radial Basis Function, General Regression Neural Network and Probabilistic Neural Network to do modeling and forecasting, and do neural network ensemble forecasting based on genetic algorithm. By using the right combination of genetic algorithm to dynamically optimize the value of that time by optimizing the weights, the results show that, the resulting prediction accuracy by optimizing the combination of more than a single method to predict has been significantly improved. Through the two-week data to predict load, show that the method has prediction accuracy, stable performance, high precision and good practicality.

articleTitle: Inspection and analysis of metal elements in electrical equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, X fluorescence spectrometry was adopted.the metal elements are detected in the enclosures and supports of the electrical equipment in 66kV, 220kV and 550kV substations; The electrical equipment at run time of 3 to 15 years was detected respectively, Mainly include: transformer, circuit breaker, GIS, metal support, angle iron, iron tower and switch cabinet. The specific contents of the relevant metal elements of the electrical equipment were collected during 3 to 15years, and these data was coordinated, the change of the content of metal elements in electrical equipment and the trend of the change of metal content with the year are analyzed. The analysis results show that, the relationship between the metal content of electrical equipment and the year of operation is monotonically decreasing, and the electrical equipment that in door, the change of its metal content is obviously smaller than that of outdoor electrical equipment. The detection of metal elements in electrical equipment is also a lateral assessment of the operating conditions of the electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Optimal Substation Planning of Active Distribution Network Based on Networkparation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to cope with the widespread access of distributed generation (DG) in distribution network and demand response(DR), a substation optimal planning method considering network load characteristics complementation is proposed in this paper. First, the DG output and the load timing demand response are taken into consideration for the reliability assessment of the cut of the net supply load(NSLC), and then the influence of DG output characteristics in different seasons, weather and the timing demand response characteristics of the different types load under working days and holidays on the NSLC are analyzed. Then, a substation planning model for NSLC and the demand response cost is constructed. Finally, weighted Voronoi diagram method considering the net supply load reduction is used to solve the substation planning model, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an example.

Author Keywords: weighted Voronoi diagram method of NSLC

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy and Simulation Analysis of Hybrid Energy Storage System for Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of new energy power generation technologies such as wind power and photovoltaic, the fluctuation of new energy output power caused the obvious change of voltage value, which affected the power supply quality and the stable operation of the power system. The paper analyzed the short-term rapid and high-power charging and discharging characteristics of super capacitor in hybrid energy storage system. Proposed the method of using power decoupling and voltage stabilization control strategy of four-quadrant voltage source converter and bidirectional DC/DC converter to suppress the wind farm output power fluctuation. The wind farm accessed with the hybrid energy storage system is simulated and analyzed in DigSILENT/PowerFactory. Simulation results indicated the effectiveness of the coordinated control strategy in suppressing the fluctuation of the wind farm output power and improving the stability of the voltage stability.

articleTitle: Research on Control Method of VSC Based DC Grid with Weak AC System Integrated
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Scenario of Passive grid connecting two VSC-HVDC transmission systems has been investigated in this paper. A control method with hierarchy is proposed. VSCs have been grouped into a hierarchy of various categories. Distance which denotes the number of connections with strong grid of VSC stations is used to define the hierarchy used in this paper. Different control methods are used in different categories to regulate different variables. This method can be used in DC grids with many VSCs grouped into a hierarchy of various categories. This paper presents a multilayer DC system with a passive AC grid inside the DC grid. The control principle of VSCs connected with the passive grid is investigated. The AC voltage control and active power control is assigned to different VSC based on its power flow in the inside passive AC grid. Also a DC voltage control is integrated in the hierarchy control system to improve the dynamic instability.

articleTitle: Research and Application of On-site Operation of Power Materials Warehouse Based on Internet of Things Plus
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of electric power materials and combines the problem of warehouse site business management, the paper analyzes the necessity of building the on-site operation of power materials warehouse based on barcode, smart chip and so on. Therefore, the paper describes the design and key point of the system. The input of the on-site operating system of power materials warehouse based on barcode, significantly reduced the time of single operation of warehouse, the accuracy of operation was increased to 100%, secondary subcontracting is more flexible, the integration of material management information system effectively improves the timeliness of job tasks. The standardization and rationality of the storage of warehouse materials are met by the Southern Power Grid.

articleTitle: On Effect of Electrical Double Layer Capacitor Storage Devices on Power Quality in Power System with Electrified Railways
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Energy storage devices for electrified railway have acquired significant attention from both academia and industry due to its capability of energy saving and conservation. Therefore, models of electrified railways with energy storage devices (ESD) need to be built for investigation on the effect of ESD on traction systems and power networks. This paper assesses the effect of the electrical double layer capacitor (EDLC), one prototype of ESD, on the power quality of the network after installation of EDLC. An integrated electromagnetic transient model composed of the traction substation, the transmission line, the locomotives with control systems, and the energy storage devices with control systems is built in ADPSS based on the topology of the real network and data sheets of the selected EDLC from the manufacturer. The overall power quality at the grid side is analyzed using analytical hierarchy process and compared with that before installation of EDLC to assess the effect of EDLC on power quality. The overall power quality performance can be improved after installation of EDLC.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Blocking Failure of UPFC caused by 35kV Distribution Line Fault
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the brief introduction of the unified power flow controller (UPFC) project in western Nanjing power grid, a blocking failure of the UPFC is analyzed in this paper. The blocking failure occurred since the “low grid voltage” was detected due to the evolved fault occurred on the 35kV distribution line, and the busbar automatic transfer of the shunt transformers was not completed. It is pointed out that the reason of the blocking failure is the unsuccessful coordination between the time delay of “low grid voltage” fault to block converter and the busbar automatic transfer logic of the shunt transformers. Besides, the countermeasure is proposed and have been proven to be effective.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic transient harmonic analysis and control system of Ye-Chi Railway traction station
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electrified railway has the high power single-phase rectifier load characteristics because of the power supply and driving mode of electric locomotive, and the power quality problems caused by traction station become more prominent. Based on the Advanced Digital Power System Simulator(ADPSS), this article takes the traction station of Ye-Chi railway accessed to East Inner Mongolia power grid for an example, the electromagnetic transient mathematical model is established, and the recursive discrete Fourier algorithm(DFT) is applied to analyze the harmonic characteristics. By establishing an electromagnetic transient harmonic control model based on active power filter, the effectiveness of the control measure is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research of New Method About the Test of Secondary System for Refurbishment and Extension of Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the large-scale construction of smart substation, the refurbishment and extension of smart substations become more and more. The state-of-art about the test of the refurbishment and extension of secondary system in smart substation is introduced and the problems and new needs are described. The new test process combined pre-test and on-site test is presented, and the new method about the test is discussed in detail from four aspects which are the configuration and verification of SCD file, the construction of virtual simulation and test platform, the pre-test and the join-test on-site. The security measure for the on-site test is also provided. At last, take the extension of line as an example and make analysis; it will be helpful to the test refurbishment and extension of secondary system in smart substation.

articleTitle: The Research of Method of Relay Selection in Power Line Communication System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Because of the random fading and noise, there exists the low-reliable problem in power line communication system. To solve the low-reliable problem, the concept of equivalent link is proposed, which convey the multiple-hop link quality to virtual single-hop link quality, to evaluate the performance of the power line communication network topology. Based on this, an optimization method for layered network topology is proposed. Using this topology, the high-reliable node can be easily found and chosen as relay to improve the reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Evaluation Method of Distributed Generation Interconnection Scheme
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the maturity of technologies, distributed generations were widely used in distribution networks and played an active role in improving reliability of power service, reducing power supply cost, and reducing environmental pollution. By analyzing the power supply reliability, economy, and environment-friendliness of distribution network with distributed generations, a comprehensive evaluation model for the distributed generation interconnection scheme was established, based on which an evaluation method of distributed generation interconnection scheme with the objective of optimizing aggregate utility was proposed. The effectiveness of this method was verified by evaluating several distributed generation interconnection schemes of an actual distribution network.

articleTitle: All-day Detailed Continuous Simulation and Impact Analysis of Oltage Control Strategy for High Penetration Distributed PVBased on Voltage Control System of Real Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Combining with the proportional distributed photovoltaic regional grids in a real park in China, three control strategies for constant power factor, variable power factor, and reactive voltage control of photovoltaic inverters were carefully modeled. Based on the OpenDSS simulation platform, a detailed simulation model of the park power grid with substation AVC system was built. Based on this, the system-level continuous control simulation of the park power grid was performed every 5 minutes throughout the day. Through simulation and comparison, the effectiveness of each control strategy and its impact on the existing distribution network AVC system are analyzed, and the superiority of the reactive voltage control strategy is verified. It can provide a scientific reference for the planning and operation scheduling of distribution networks after massive distributed photovoltaic grid connection so as to ensure the safe dissipation of distributed photovoltaics.

articleTitle: Research on Apache Spark Based Transformer Areas Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The massive data accumulated by the power company provides the basic data profile for load forecasting. In this paper, a dynamic Bayesian network is built as a load forecasting model of transformer areas. The parallel computing platform Apache Spark is used to calculate the parameters of the model based on large volume of transformers' historical data in parallel. Meanwhile, the Pregel computing model is used to parallelize the forward backward algorithm to realize the forecasting tasks. The experimental results show that the proposed transformer areas load forecasting technology based on distributed graph computing has high prediction accuracy and fast calculation speed.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Businesses Interconnection and Security Technology of New Power IMS Switching Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: China State Grid Company has decided to construct next generation exchanging telecommunication network using IMS technology, and it adopted private digital communication network to overload multimedia services. The users or terminals cannot access the IMS network through internet or other public networks, so that mobile applications cannot be deployed in mobile phones. It analyzed business requirements of power enterprises firstly, brought out implement methods and intercommunication ways between power private network and public network according to power system information security protection requirement, and it gave the comparison and resolution of different methods to use multimedia services for power communication.

articleTitle: A Multi-level Reactive Power Control Strategy for PV Power Plant Based on Sensitivity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to make full use of the ability of photo voltaic (PV) units to regulate their own reactive power to participate in voltage stability control of power system, this paper takes full account of the interaction between power grid and PV power plant and proposes a multi-level reactive power control strategy based on sensitivity analysis for PV plant. Firstly, reference of reactive power is calculated combined with the analysis of reactive power and voltage sensitivity of PV power plant and the operation status of power grid. Secondly, reactive power command is allocated to each PV unit according to the reactive power margin. Finally, a reactive power control system model based on an actual PV plant project is established to verify the correctness of proposed strategy in this paper.

articleTitle: A Power Load Association Rules Mining Method Based on Improved FP-Growth Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Some low-frequency information in the power load association analysis cannot be mined effectively by traditional mining algorithms. In this case, a comprehensive mining method based on FP-growth algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the data on meteorology, solar terms, holiday and total load in Pudong District of Shanghai for 546 days was clustered and generalized by K-means method. Then the original transaction sets was classified according to the counts of the clustering result. And they were mined by different methods comprehensively. Compared with association rules obtained by traditional algorithms, more association rules can be mined by the comprehensive mining method, with accuracy and robustness. The comprehensive mining method provides basis for load forecasting as well as distribution network load warning, which is crucial to the operation and management of smart grid.

articleTitle: Characteristics Analysis of Arc Temperature in SF6 Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A method to process the arc spectrum data in a real SF6 circuit breaker was described and the arc temperature characteristics were analyzed. The arc spectrum data was corrected based on the principle of line broaden to correct noise and spectral shifts. Considering the fact that there were few sampling points for actual measurement in a real SF6 circuit breaker, the algorithm based on cubic spline interpolation with an accuracy of 0.85% was applied. The radial distribution of arc temperature was calculated with an accuracy of 8.54 %. The arc temperature after current zero, the arc temperature at different currents, positions and measuring time points were compared. The arc characteristics is analyzed. Temperatures in the arc center were in the range of 15000K-25000K while the arc circuit varied from 6kA-30kA.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Location for UHV Half-wavelength Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper mainly elaborated some new problems on the fault location for half-wavelength transmission lines, and studied its fault location method. The results of the research show that the accuracy of the traditional double-terminal fault location method is poor for half-wavelength transmission lines. While adding the traveling wave detection units along the line and using the three-point method can effectively improve fault location accuracy. In addition, simulation results indicate that with the increase of the number of detection points, the accuracy of fault location is gradually improved. But when the distance between two adjacent detection points is reduced to a certain extent, the location accuracy is no longer improved. It is reasonable to take 200-300km between adjacent detection points. For the capacitance tuning network, the arrangement of the measuring points also should ensures that the number of capacitors between the fault point and the three nearby measuring points is sufficiently small.

articleTitle: A Technical-economical Analysis of Customer Voltage Regulation in Urban Grid Considering Comprehensive Impacts
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the new business environment, getting electricity sheds light on how essential it is to measure customer connection, which is complicated by supply reliability, procurement practices, application time, technical standards, etc. In an effort to ensure this permanent connection, the paper calls for emphasis on distribution network planning, especially on the selection of voltage grades. Based on the existing grid, studies are carried out for different adjustment plans on customer-side voltage. The combined impacts have been considered from the utility, customers, and the whole society perspectives. Alongside with the technical-economic evaluation, the paper finally proposes an optimal combination of voltage grades in urban grid, promoting a mutually beneficial and win-win situation of entire society.

articleTitle: The Research of SCADA Remote Information Analytical Method in Power Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The importance of the work to the fault diagnosis system is introduced; in this paper, through the study of analysis method of SCADA remote information; the main functions and the data types of the software are described; a series of rules were put forward which is used to automatic extraction and analysis SCADA remote information. A SCADA data analytical tools was developed, which is database separated and has the function of automatic analysis and manual modification. The function of automatic extract and analysis protection alarm information and the function of analysis break-logic are implemented. Use the SCADA data of Dingxi power network in Gansu province, the analytical tools was tested, the desired effect.

articleTitle: Phase selection and differential protection based on Wavelet Transform for half-wavelength AC transmission line
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The traditional distance protection is no longer applicable to the half-wavelength AC transmission line for the completely different characteristics from the conventional transmission line. In order to solve this problem, phase selection and differential protection based on wavelet transform is proposed. The mode components of the reverse current traveling wave and the zero sequence current of the half-wavelength line are transformed by wavelet transform, and the phase selection is carried out according to the results of the wavelet transform. The wave heads of both sides of the mode current after the fault phase wavelet transform are respectively integrated. The differential protection is constructed with the absolute value of the sum of integral current on both sides as the differential current and the absolute value of the integral difference as the braking current. PSCAD simulation shows that the protection scheme is suitable for half-wavelength line, which can protect the full length of the transmission line, effectively distinguish internal from external faults, and has a certain ability to resist transition resistance.

articleTitle: Framework and Application of Testing Platform for Dispatching Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The function and performance testing of traditional dispatching control system mainly relies on the actual power grid environment and manual testing methods. It is difficult to discover the hidden problems of the dispatching control system. On the other hand, there is no systematic testing method for the feasibility of new technologies application in dispatching control system. This paper constructs a testing platform for dispatching control system. Testing environment is developed for dispatching control system at all levels, which integrates the primary and secondary system simulation. And testing scenarios for the platform, various applications, and complex functions are automatically generated. The overall testing and evaluation for dispatching control system are obtained by testing platform, which improves the comprehensiveness and completeness of testing and effectively reduces its hidden problems.

articleTitle: On the Secure and Stable Operational Technology for Multi-DC Asynchronous Power-Sending Grid With High Proportion of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, with a rapid growth of the generation of hydropower, wind and solar power, renewable energy has occupied more than 60% of the total installed capacity of power grids in Qinghai, Yunnan, Sichuan, Tibet and other areas. Along with the yearly increased power transmission from these provinces, the ultra-high voltage AC/DC hybrid power grids will be evolving to be the multi-DC asynchronous grid, which is a trend of future represented by the work done in Yunnan. Taking Yunnan province as an example, this article studies the operational problems related to the multi-DC asynchronous power-sending grid with high proportion of renewable energy, and describes a new secure and stable operational technology that has been applied into the grid in Yunnan. We case-study the effects of the operation after the application of such technology and evaluate its practical influences.

articleTitle: Gradient Boosting Decision Tree and Random Forest Based Partial Discharge Pattern Recognition of HV Cable
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a typical “white box” pattern recognition method, the traditional Decision Tree (DT) method, which is easy to be interpreted and trained, has been widely applied in the Partial Discharge (PD) pattern recognition of high voltage cables. However, the disadvantages of the DT method are significant, including the limited recognition accuracy, poor anti-interference ability and poor generalization ability, etc. In order to overcome the challenges, Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) and Random Forest (RF) based PD pattern recognition methods are presented in the paper. Firstly, 3500 PD samples are obtained based on the PD testing of five types of artificial defects of ethylene-propylene (EPR) cables in the high voltage lab. Secondly, PD data pre-processing is carried out and 34 types of PD features are extracted from the raw data. Thirdly, the principles of GBDT and RF based PD pattern recognition are presented in details. Finally, the 3500 PD samples are applied to evaluate the GBDT and RF based PD pattern recognition methods, which are compared with the traditional DT method. The results show that the PD pattern recognition accuracies of RF, GBDT and DT are 89.7%, 90.4% and 84.3% respectively. GBDT and RF based PD pattern recognition methods show remarkable advantages, compared with the DT method, which are both applicable for industrial application of PD based condition monitoring of high voltage cables.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Planning of Power Source, Grid and Load for Shanghai Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In Shanghai, the electricity load density is relatively high and the distributed power resources are abundant. However., the distributed power access lacks unified planning. This article analyzes the coordinated planning of Shanghai power supply based on power source, grid and load., together with the resources required. A collaborative planning model of power source., grid and load is established which is solved by two-level cross feedback particle swarm optimization simulated annealing algorithm. This paper evaluates the power distribution network planning results before and after considering the collaborative planning of power source., grid and load. It shows that the planning method mentioned in this paper benefits in several aspects as better operation economy., characteristics and efficiency of distributed power utilization.

articleTitle: Load Balancing Distribution Network Reconfiguration Based on Constraint Satisfaction Problem Model
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Load balancing plays an important role in reducing network losses and improving the power supply capacity of the distribution network. In this paper, the data structure of the simplified model of the distribution network is improved, and the information description of the node is improved to the information description of the edge to reduce the data storage space. Aiming at the problem that the load balancing with the tie-switch as the core is easy to fall into the endless loop, the constraint satisfaction problem model for the load-balanced distribution network reconstruction is firstly used in this paper. The constraints of network reconstruction with load balancing as the goal is established and a load balancing index suitable for the constraint satisfaction problem is proposed. The problem of distribution network reconstruction is expressed as the mathematical problem with the minimum load balancing index as the objective function. The example shows the feasibility of the algorithm used.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Voltage Control Strategy Wind Power Clustered Access Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the large-scale and clustered development of wind power, its intermittent and randomicity will make network voltage fluctuate frequently, which even leads problems of voltage stability at weak system access points. For this reason, to research on reactive voltage control strategy wind power clustered Access has important practical significance. This paper first analyzed the research actuality and specificity and problems of reactive voltage control wind power clustered access. Multi-Agent technology's application in terms of reactive voltage control is studied and it shows that reactive voltage control based on multi-agent has advantages in solving the curse of computing dimensionality and the difficulty of coordinating decentralized control. This paper establishes steady state mathematical model of the three major wind turbine and wind farm, and analyzed their reactive voltage characteristics. On this basis, reactive voltage characteristics of wind power cluster accessed point and regional power grid. The existing reactive voltage control strategies just only consider wind farm's point of coupling connection (pcc) and neglect the impact on the voltage of network side's substations. This paper proposes a reactive voltage control strategy considering the voltage of all pcc and important nodes, whose target is voltage off-limits control. This strategy makes regions of grids accessed and areas of a region possesses Agent's intelligent feature using reactive voltage sensitivity, and the voltage of grid accessed will keep reasonable. Finally, this paper in HeXi corridor in GanSu province for grid simulation calculation analysis, which proved in this paper grid of reactive voltage comprehensive control strategy is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Wet Snow Effect on Insulator Flashover in Distribution and Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Snow is a common weather phenomenon, but snow on insulators will affect its electrical performance. In this paper, snow volume conductivity is measured to find factors which have impacts on it and snow flashover process is simulated on the rectangle plate model. The results show that snow volume conductivity reach maximum in the vicinity of the melting point and the increase of density and snow water conductivity will lead to the increase of conductivity. Snow flashover process is close related to water content, the increase of water content, density and snow water conductivity will lead to the decrease of snow flashover voltage.

articleTitle: The Research on Electric Power Control Center Credit Monitoring and Management Using Cloud Computing and Smart Workflow
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The technology support system of modern power dispatching control center has gradually presented the trend of networking, marketization and rapid development. Accordingly, it puts forward higher requirements on the availability, reliability, interoperability and flexibility of the grid control data and workflow model, and the construction of the credit grid control center system is imperative. In order to solve the problem of the above credit risk, this paper combines cloud computing with expert reasoning and workflow management in the field of artificial intelligence, redefines the workflow system according to the artificial intelligence control method, and constructs the integration of the virtualized Infrastructure as a Service, the control Platform as a Service, the credit evaluation of the power grid control center and the credit management Software as a Service and security management. Cloud computing framework enables the system to be reliable, intelligent and creditable on the underlying mechanism. The application of credit evaluation and credit management model in the large regional power grid based on cloud computing and intelligent workflow is a good solution to the problem of trusted data interaction and efficient workflow execution among the multilevel control centers. It provides a useful technique for the economic dispatch, energy saving, lean management and electricity market reform of the large power control center.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis of Peak-Valley Regulation of Central China Power Grid Under Different Wind Power Consumption Situations
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the background of one province in Central China power grid absorbing local and outer wind power, this paper studied on the peak shaving characteristics of the wind power into Central China power grid from different provinces and regions. By analyzing the output characteristics and typical 24h load characteristics of wind power, the characteristic index system of wind power peak shaving load has been established. And the impacts of different indicators on wind power peak shaving have been analyzed. Through the calculation and analysis, the accurate value of wind power peak shaving regulation probability and wind power peak shaving rate could be obtained. In the study of optimal allocation of existing pumped storage power stations, most of the wind power peak shaving rates are considered according to a fixed value. But it failed to analyze the rationality of the fixed value in depth. This paper provides an in-depth analysis of the simplified calculation of wind power peak shaving rate, and through the comparative analysis of the maximum planning capacity of wind power, some useful conclusions are obtained.

Author Keywords: difference between peak load and valley load
maximum planning capacity of wind power

articleTitle: Study on Improving the Allowed Penetration Level of Distributed Generations by Utilizing the Distribution Network Reconfiguration Under Considering Network Loss
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To maximize the consumptive ability of the distribution network to the distributed generations, an approach of improving the allowed penetration level by utilizing the distribution network reconfiguration under the condition of considering line loss is proposed. Models for calculating of distributed generations is introduced. And the mathematical model of distribution network reconfiguration with distributed generations is set up, in which, the sum of the reduction of the network loss and the admittance capacity of distributed generations after the distribution network reconfiguration is introduced as the index. Superior optimization algorithm is introduced to find out the best planning scheme of distribution network reconfiguration and the allowed penetration capacity of every distributed generation. Through the calculation of the IEEE33 node, the results show that the approach always have good effects to improve the allowed penetration capacity. When the load is greatly reduced, the allowed penetration capacity of distributed generations are compared before and after distribution network reconfiguration. And the results of which show that it is still feasible and effective to improve the allowed penetration capacity.

articleTitle: A Situation Awareness and Early Warning Method for Voltage Instability Risk
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Voltage stability of distribution network is of great significance for safe and reliable operation of distribution system. Aiming at the unexpected and concealment characteristics of the uncertainty of wind power, component fault and load fluctuation in the complex active distribution network, and the concealment of the voltage instability, a method of rapid perception and early warning for the risk situation of voltage instability in distribution network based on data mining and deep learning was proposed in this paper. Taking into account the uncertain factors of source network load and other factors, through feature extraction and derivative methods, the environment factors, power flow state and equipment state which may cause voltage instability are analyzed, and multi-dimensional feature sets are established. Based on the voltage entropy and the weighted voltage entropy, a method to divide the risk grade of voltage instability is proposed. The voltage instability probability and the severity of the distribution network are considered, and the voltage instability is divided into three grades. The deep learning algorithm is introduced to establish the situation awareness model of voltage instability risk, and the accuracy rate of voltage instability risk prediction is compared. By improving the IEEE37 standard example, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified, and it can provide effective support for the specific operation and maintenance of distribution network.

articleTitle: Optimal Reactive Optimization of Distribution Network with Wind Turbines Based on Improved NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering the uncertainties of wind turbines output and the random fluctuations of load, and the correlation of multi-wind turbine output and load correlation, this paper first uses Latin hypercube sampling to generate multiple scenarios, and then uses K-means clustering to generate several typical scenarios. For K-means clustering, it is not possible to determine the optimal number of clusters based on the characteristics of wind power output data and load data distribution. The clustering validity index is used to determine the optimal number of clusters. The improved non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm based on local differential method was used to solve the model, and selected the best compromise solution from the Pareto optimal solution set according to fuzzy membership degree. and finally the simulation was performed in the improved IEEE 33-bus power distribution network. The results prove that the reactive power optimization can effectively improve the voltage level of the distribution network and reduce the network loss.

articleTitle: Analysis and Practice of Mobile Field Operation Information Platform for Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, smart mobile devices and mobile technology continue to spread, with the continuous improvement of our country's economic level, the electric power industry is facing great development prospects, and there are all kinds of problems, which have caused serious constraints to the long-term development of electric power enterprises. Therefore, starting with the current situation of the operation of the field operation in the power grid enterprises, the technology is comprehensive. Research and analysis should be a universal practical work. Especially in recent years, with the continuous progress of information technology in China, some information platforms have been introduced to the power grid enterprises. We hope to guide the work environment through these platforms to guide the work environment, so that the efficiency of the power grid can be improved and the electric power enterprises have their own long-term development. This paper, starting with the type of field operation business of power grid enterprises, briefly introduces the business requirements, and then carries out a comprehensive analysis and practice on the information platform, hoping to provide a valuable reference for the related units.

articleTitle: Protection and Control Scheme of Intelligent Distributed Distribution Network and Its Secondary System Design
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper initial on the protection control scheme and secondary equipment design of intelligent distributed integrated power distribution. The protection scheme is explained based on the functional coordination and fault analysis between the protections. By one case of the secondary design, and the reliability, flexibility and economy of the intelligent distributed integrated terminal are described, and shows its advantages in grid and market.

articleTitle: The Bargain Game Analysis on Policy-Processing of Grid Construction
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper simulates the game in the policy-processing of grid construction based on the Rubinstein game ideology of bargaining, and constructs the Principal-Agent model given the incomplete information for grid company and local government. This paper also discusses the game model for the bargaining between local government and residents and makes an analysis of the mutual action among the three interest groups: grid company, local government and local residents. Probe is made into the achievement of balance in the allocation of benefit for all interest groups under the current policy. The last discussion aims to construct a harmonious external environment for grid construction.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-objective Optimization Dispatching Scheme Based on High-energy Load
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the grand vision of Energy Internet, distributed generation technology has attracted more and more attention. However, the randomness and volatility of renewable energy power generation put forward new requirements for power system dispatching strategies, which makes the current strategy need to improve urgently. To solve this problem, we have studied the strategy for ensuring the balance of supply and demand in power systems through high-energy load, furthermore, proposed a multi-objective optimization model that increases the consumption rate of renewable energy generation by high-energy load scheduling and provides a reference for power dispatching of distributed generation in Energy Internet.

articleTitle: Heating System Modification Schemes for Heat-Power Decoupling of Cogeneration Unit and Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Focusing on solving the interference of the heating supply and power generation under relatively high heating load conditions, heating-power decoupling of the cogeneration units can lower the power output of the generation units to a great extent while meeting the external heating load requirement. With its distinctive advantage of low investment, the solution of the existing heating steam system modification is strongly recommended for increasing the flexibility of the cogeneration unit. Model-based software is utilized for the performance simulation of the 300MW subcritical cogeneration unit manufactured by STC under various heating steam modification schemes. Three possible heating steam modification schemes are considered in the modeling building-up process, and the critical operation parameters and limits are explained for the modification schemes. The high pressure supplement steam is taken from the IP turbine inlet hot reheat steam and HP turbine exhaust cold reheat steam and No.4 steam extraction respectively for Scheme No.1, No.2 and No.3. The results of the minimum power loading capability under maximum heating load condition are calculated. It is shown that with the increase of the proportion of the high pressure steam, the minimum load that could be reached is decreased while maintaining the maximum heating load. From the point view of the peak load adjustment improvement, scheme No.1 has apparent and significant effect and scheme No.2 has average and moderate effect while scheme No.3 has the worst effect. The performance data of the unit is also provided for the various modification schemes. It's shown that the unit performance under 200t/h IP inlet heating steam condition in scheme No.1 is very close to the 75% heating load condition of the original IP-LP crossover piping heating steam scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence With Connected Wind Farm Power Changing and Improvement Strategies on Grid Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The volatility and intermittency of wind speed lead to voltage stability changing of wind farm connecting power system. This paper studies the influence of local wind farm power fluctuation and the improvement strategies on grid voltage stability. In simulation model, the influences on grid voltage stability improving are researched of different reactive power compensator. Finally, with different operation sections of wind power, the grid voltage fluctuations are analyzed to evaluate the improvement effects of grid voltage stability with different reactive power compensation devices.

articleTitle: A Parallel Impedance Based Criteria and Active Damping Control for DC Microgrid Stability
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Multiple converters and negative impedance characteristics of constant power loads of DC microgrid will lead system instability. First, the equivalent input and output impedance of the system have been obtained. Based on the Nyquist stability criterion, a passivity based parallel impedance method has been proposed to determine the system voltage stability. The proposed method can transform the stability problem into the system passivity problem and its performance was compared with the traditional impedance ratio criterion. Secondly, in order to improve the stability of DC microgrid, an active damping control method based on the feed current of the DC converter is proposed. The design principle of the active damping parameters is given. PSCAD simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Risk Ranking and Screening of Distribution Network Based on Uncertainty Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of the national economy, the distribution network is becoming larger and larger, and the wiring is becoming more and more complicated. The power supply enterprises and power users are increasingly demanding the reliability of the distribution system. The distribution network is at the very end of the power system and supplies power directly to the power users. According to statistics, about 80% of users' power outages are caused by power distribution system failures. According to the results of risk assessment of distribution network, it is especially important to screen the risk of the most likely failure and prevent and control it to improve the reliability of power supply. The amount of information obtained from the risk assessment calculation is very large. For risk online prevention and control, it is impossible to conduct online risk prevention and control analysis for all assessment results. It is necessary to select the most serious risk information from the massive result data, and then trigger the risk online. Prevention and control measures reduce the risk level to a certain extent. The ranking and screening of previous risk assessment results are based on the performance index method and belong to the deterministic research category. Based on the uncertainty theory, this paper sorts and screens the fault risks to determine the risk with the highest level. For the fault risk of the top sorting, the precaution can be taken before the fault. For example, the power distribution network can be reconstructed, the islands are divided, and the DG is re-scheduled to minimize the loss. Finally, the reliability of the algorithm is verified by actual example analysis.

articleTitle: Study on Efficiency Evaluation of Sampling Strategy for Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution transformer is one of the key equipment for the power grid. It is significant to the safe and stable operation of power grid. During the 13th Five-Year Plan period, the investment of distribution network construction will reach 1.7 trillion RMB, which makes a big market for Distribution transformer. In recent years, the manufacturing industry of Distribution transformer in China develops rapidly with high competition. The quality risk of Distribution transformer cannot be ignored. Sampling inspection has become an important means of quality control for Distribution transformers, but due to the diversity of sampling mode strategy, sampling results vary greatly. It is significant to study on optimization of sampling inspection mode and strategy, which can improve the efficiency, quality level, and the reliability of power supply. The research status and theory of sampling inspection are analyzed. The evaluation index system of transformer sampling efficiency is put forward, including the unqualified inspection rate, the qualified rate of the item, the qualified rate of the product, and the sampling efficiency index. At last the evaluation index put forward is verified by the real example.

articleTitle: An Automatic Test Platform for the Detection of Mass Fault Indicator
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As an on-line monitoring device, the fault indicator can improve the efficiency of operation and maintenance, and can improve the reliability of supply in distribution line. However, there are some problems in the existing fault indicators, and the inspection work is still in the initial stage, it is necessary to establish an automatic and efficient inspection platform for more intensive control of whole process of inspection. Firstly, the whole architecture of the detection platform was introduced in this paper. Secondly, the detection capability of high voltage and big current of the detection platform was explained in detail. And a detection pipeline is developed to save manpower and improve efficiency. Thirdly, a software system of the fault indicator detection platform is introduced to make the whole closed-loop process more automatic.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Decision-Making of GW-Scale PV System Integrated to Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A comprehensive decision-making method is proposed for GW-scale photovoltaic (PV) system integrated to power grid in this paper. A decision-making evaluation index system is established, in which main influence factors considered are security and stability, intermittence of PV, economy, and extendibility. The improved fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) and technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) are applied to decide the weights for indexes and to select the best scheme respectively. The case study of 1 GW coastal mud flat PV system integrated into Shandong power grid indicates that the applying of improved FAHP omits the consistency test, which can take full advantage of the original datas and reflect merits as well as demerits of different schemes visually and rapidly combined with TOPSIS.

Author Keywords: technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS)

articleTitle: Study on Distribution Network Planning Method Based on Reliability of Cost-Benefit Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Traditional distribution network planning method is to minimize the cost of the power network based on certain reliability. The purpose of the planning is to ensure power system reliability, so the benefit derived from the expansion of power network is ignored, thus the optimized social benefit can not be acquired. Through the introduction of outage cost combining the reliability and economy, a new mathematical model and cost-benefit analysis method of power network planning is presented in this paper. The method takes the outage cost as a part of the total cost and quantifies the reliability benefits by the outage cost, and the costs and benefits about power network reliability planning can be evaluated based on a consistence of economy. Through the analysis and evaluation of a planning for a concrete power system, the application of cost-benefit analysis in power network planning is further improved. The efficiency of this method is validated in some test examples.

articleTitle: Analysis of Statistical and Frequency Characteristics of Transient Overvoltage of Hybrid Cable-OHL Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Since increasingly more cables are adopted in distribution line, more hybrid cable-OHL lines are used in distribution network. Due to the difference of impedance and admittance of hybrid line compared with pure OHL, the energy redistribution is affected during line re-energization. This presentation focuses on the transient overvoltage during line re-energization with the use of EMT-type program. Firstly, due to the randomness of closing timings of circuit breaker, statistical distribution of reclosing overvoltage is studied. It is found that most severe overvoltage appears when cable share is 20%. Moreover, the most severe overvoltage can reach up to more than 3p.u, and its dominant frequency is 20.67 kHz. Furthermore, the influence of source network on the characteristic of reclosing overvoltage is studied as well. This work has reference value on insulation coordination and reclosing strategy in hybrid cable-OHL line.

articleTitle: A Design to Improve Efficiency of Capacitive Divider Energy Harvesting Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The capacitive divider energy harvesting power supply has been applied to the detection and protection device of the distribution network, but there are still problems of small output power. In order to solve this problem, a circuit structure combining LC parallel resonance and high power factor AC-DC converter is proposed. The selection of the resonant capacitance and the influence of the transformer parameter design on the output power are analyzed in detail, and the hardware parameters of the circuit are designed. Through computer simulation and experimental test, the output power is increased, and the output power can be 4.9W under the condition that the voltage divider is 3300pF and the transformer primary is 1000V.

articleTitle: Discussion on Security Management and Control Mechanism Based on Power System Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of power grid, a large number of applications of intelligent equipment, and there might be massive, multivariate and complex data during the power grid regulation and operation, resulting in that power grid security control is facing new opportunities and challenges. In this paper, we first applied the data analysis methods such as time series and clustering to make descriptive and predictive analysis of massive data in power system. In addition, we further discovered the data association and potential additional value based on cloud computing technology, realizing real time data information of power system with cloud computing technology and reaching platform integration of “Collection-Identification-Processing-Integration”. Secondly, in order to truly realize the power grid operation under risk control, controllability and long-term in control, based on the integrated platform we explored the establishment of a set “proactive prevention beforehand, active response in the process, and proper disposal afterwards” all-round power grid operation safety management and control mechanism. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed security management and control mechanism was verified by a typical case in Tianjin region.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Monitoring Method of Small Current Grounding Fault in Distribution Line Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings in the existing distribution automation systems, such as the use of feeder terminal devices and fault indicators, and other distribution terminals to achieve remote monitoring and fault location of line operation conditions, a new type of distribution line monitoring method is proposed. And based on the cloud, the computing technology has developed a small current ground fault monitoring system for distribution lines. The monitoring system integrates smart grid sensor, wireless communication and cloud computing technology application platform, making the distribution system transparent and visible, which can improve the economic and reliability of distribution network operation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Method of Annual Power Cut Plan Based on DMODA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to adapt to China's energy transformation, construction ideas of the new generation control system clearly pointed out the need to improve the optimal combination of transmission and transformation equipment, the economy of power cut plan and the intelligence of auxiliary decision making. On the basis of this, this paper constructs the decision model of annual power cut plan, and proposes an improved DMODA method. On the basis of the original multi-objective Dragonfly algorithm, the external archiving maintenance strategy and the niche sharing mechanism under the crowded distance are added to improve the overall Bureau and the distribution uniformity of the original algorithm, so that the annual blackout plan is economical, reliable, and distributed all. Both the balance and reserve are all optimal. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed method can meet the needs of actual power grid outage plan effectively and effectively.

articleTitle: Accurate Measurement of Leakage Current in Distribution Network by Injected Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on that neutral point arc suppression coil series damping resistance is grounded, a method of real-time measurement for leakage current in distribution network was introduced. A accurate measurement of leakage current in distribution network by injected signal was proposed. A specific frequency current signal which is not power frequency was injected into the distribution network through zero-sequence voltage transformer in distribution network. The returned voltage signal was measured by the internal voltage transformer of arc suppression coil. And the leakage conductance in distribution network was calculated. The simulation results showed that the measurement accuracy of the proposed method is high, the measurement process does not need to change the primary-side wiring of the distribution network and does not affect the normal operation of the distribution network, which can eliminate the influence of the damping resistor and the internal resistance of the voltage transformer.

articleTitle: Research on High-voltage Switch Cabinet's Multi-channel Power-on Comprehensive Diagnostic Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the author summarizes four discharge patterns based on the analysis of common high-voltage switch cabinet faults and the causes of insulation faults with highest fault rate. By establishing the high-voltage switch cabinet's multichannel power-on comprehensive diagnostic platform, the author uses the needle plate discharge model to simulate partial discharge source so as to conduct the experimental research and uses four-channel transmission signals' arrival sequence to conduct the partial discharge source positioning. Based on the comparative analysis of partial discharge signals through simulation, the author adopts the anti-jamming technology to conduct the research on internal discharge and external interference signals' pulse wave form. Based on the discharge signals' pulse waveform, the author successfully establishes high-voltage switch cabinet's anti-jamming partial discharge detection system.

articleTitle: Research About Economical Evaluation of Multi Power Quality Indexes of Automobile Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This article analyze the case of power quality in automobile manufacturing processing, there are several indexes exceed the limits, which are caused by the manufacture of automobiles. Then we find out that there are mainly four procedures may cause excess of power quality, which are stamping, soldering, coating and final assembly. On this basis, we aimed at the power quality of these four procedures, we summarize lots of problems that had appeared during all these four nodes. We collect several important indicators of power quality during the process, such as voltage sag and voltage swell, harmonic current, three-phase voltage unbalance, etc. Then we put forward a new method called “Significant indexes rapid economical evaluation” to do the estimation about power quality of the automobile industry. Because the entire car production line is highly integrated, any problems in the process will cause the entire production line to be shut down. By using “Significant indexes rapid economical evaluation” method, we can get the result of economic loss from every procedure of automobile industry. We can also obtain a clear status of economic losses from the evaluation result, then we can give advice to the improvement for the automobile industry production line, so that they can reduce the risk of the whole factory.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Inspection Robot of Power Distribution Network Based on Image Automatic Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: It has an important meaning for promoting development of intelligent electric power supply. In the development process of artificial intelligence, electric power system absorbs relevant technology continually. In this paper, we add an image automatic recognition system based on an artificial neural network algorithm into traditional inspection robot of power distribution network so that inspection robot can discover the malfunction automatically. Experimental data and analysis prove that inspection robot becomes more intelligent by adding image automatic recognition system. It will promote intelligent electric power supply level and timeliness of malfunction repair compared with traditional inspection robot.

articleTitle: Research of Application of Energy Storage Technology on Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Energy storage technology is the key technology of storing and releasing electric energy through certain medium or device. The technology can achieve controllable and stable output of renewable energy, which meets the requirements of large-scale utilization of renewable energy. In this paper, the development status, technical characteristics and application fields of energy storage technology were briefly introduced, and the factors that restrict the development of energy storage technology were discussed. The situation of wind power consumption in Liaoning power grid was analyzed in this paper, and the effect of improving power quality and peak shaving when the energy storage system applied on wind power station was analyzed in depth, which may provide theoretical guidance on the promotion and application of energy storage technology in the field of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Grounding Status of Substation Secondary System and Improvement Measures
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the present situation of secondary system grounding in substation is comprehensively analyzed, some improvement measures are put forward, such as perfecting setting of secondary grounding grid, improving anti-interference ability of secondary equipment, canceling insulated copper bar in cabinet, making clear grounding mode of cable shielding layer, increasing protection of the weak electrical signal cable, have solved the problem of grounding frequently occurring in engineering.

articleTitle: Scheme of East China Power Grid Joint Peak-Regulation Ancillary Service Market to Promote Trans-provincial Regulation of Negative Reserve
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Peak-regulating problems under light load have been a challenge for East China Power Grid (ECPG) because of the income of enormous clean energy from the outer regions and the increase of new energy of the inner region. What's more, it is worse due to the slow growth of off-peak load. A market-oriented mechanism is urgently needed to promote the usage of peak-regulating resources and will contribute to the optimal configuration of them. In this paper, we focus on the market orientation” basic principles and market operation rules of ECPG Peak-regulating Ancillary Service Market. Based on an actual case, we analyze the organization process, settlement method and contribution principle of peak-regulating service for ECPG. The market-oriented trans-provincial regulation mechanism established in our paper is proved effective in promoting the optimal allocation of peak-regulating resources and enhancing clean energy consumption ability in and out of the region.

articleTitle: A Three-Phase Unbalance Adjustment Method Based on Improved K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the distribution network system, the three-phase unbalance is commonly existed, and the harm caused by it is still very serious. The intelligent phase-change switches mainly regulate the three-phase unbalance by transferring loads in real time, but it will lead to frequently operation of the switches as to the rapid change of loads, which may bring about risks of impact and short circuit of the distribution system. Therefore, based on the adjustment mode of existing intelligent phase-change switches, the paper proposed a three-phase unbalance adjustment method based on improved k-means clustering, which firstly employed the Frénchet distance to measure the similarities between different load curves, then the k-means clustering was adopted to cluster the loads with similar change rules, after that, every category of loads was balancedly allocated into the three phases so as to achieve robust three-phase balance. The simulation results in the distribution network showed that the proposed method can effectively reduce the three phase unbalance and achieve a robust three-phase balance state.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Aging Characteristics of FRP Composites Poles and Crossarms
publicationTitle: 2018 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The fiber reinforced polymers (FRP) are increasingly used in poles and crossarms with good insulating and mechanical properties. In this paper, the aging resistance characteristics of various materials with different processing methods were investigated in this paper, including FRP composite poles and crossarms, the modified polyurethane (PU) resin samples bars and PU resin/glass fiber composite samples bars under the multiple environment.
